62de/ glen la rod ngan pa cig 'dug mi'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i spre'u phrug de/shes rig rgyas pa sems chung ba cig 'dug lha ma yin gyi gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i smre'u phrug de/ thu la phrag dog che ba cig 'dug lha'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i spre'u phrug de/ ngang rgyud ring la sems dge ba cig 'dug go /der spre'u phrug drug po de ni pha byang chub sems dpa' spre'us/ nags ma bya tshogs bya ba/shing thog mod pa cig tu bskyal nas lo gsum bzhag go /lo gsum lon pa dang /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' bltar phyin pas/ lal kyi dbang gis sprel phrug lnga brgyar 'phel 'dug go /de nas shing thog rnams zad/ gzhan za rgyu med nas pha mas ci yang ma thos rkyang / pha ci za ma ci za zer zhing / lagu gdengs la nyam thag ste/ dbul phongs so/ /der byang chub sems dpa' smre'u snyam na/nga nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song ba ni min/ 'phags pa'i bka' bsgrubs pas spre'u phrug 'di tsam du song 'dug snyam nas/ skad cig la ri po ta lar phyin nas/ 'phags pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma/khyim thabs 'khor ba'i btson rar ma shes shing / /bud med bdud kyis bslus pa ma shes pas//bu tshas 'khor ba'i 'dam du bdag tshud do//'dod pa dug gi lo mur ma rtogs pas//snying rjes chags par gyur pas bdag bslus so//'dod pas bsdams shing sdug bsngal ri yis non//nyon mongs dug zos las ngan rims kyis btab//sdug bsngal phung pos bdag nyid mnar gyur na//kye ma kye hud byams mgon thugs rje can//da ni ji ltar byas na bu tsha gso//

63'phags pas gnang bas bdag ni 'di ltar 'gyur// da lta yi dwags grong khyer lta bur 'dug /phyi ma/dmyal bar skye bar the tshom med//de phyir bdag la thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol//zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas khyod kyi rigs rgyud rnams ngas bskyang ngo gsungs nas/ 'phags pa yar bzhengs de/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ bra bo/ so ba rnams ri rab kyi khong seng nas blangs te/ sa la gtor — bas yul der ma rmos pa'i lo thog gis gang bar gyur to/ /de nas smre'u byang chub sems dpa' des spre'u phrug rnams der khrid de/ ma rmos pa'i lo thog la gtad nas/ da zo dang byas pas/ zo dang gong po ri yin zer ro/ /de nas spre'u phrug rnams kyis lo thog zos pa/sa tshim par gyur nas/ spu yang thung du song / mjug ma yang thung du song ste/ smra shes nas mir gyur to/ /zas su ma rmos pa'i lo thog za zhing / gos su shing lo gon par gyur/ de4ltar na bod kha ba can pa'i mi 'di rnams pha spre'u dang / ma brag srin mo gnyis las chad pa yin pas/ rigs gnyis su bye yod do/ /de la pha spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su gyur pa ni/ ngang rgyud ring ba/ dad pa che ba/ snying rje che la brtson 'grus che ba/ dge ba la dga' ba/ tshig 'jam pa/ smra mkhas pa de ni pha'i rigs so/ /ma brag srin mo'i rigs su gyur pa ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang che ba/ tshong dang khe spyog la sems pa/ blo 'dod dang 'gran sems che ba/gad mo cher dgod pa/ lus stobs dang snying stobs che ba/ spyod pas skad cig kyang mi tshugs pa/ blo sna mang ba/ byed skyen pa/ dug lnga rgyas pa/ gzhan gyi —skyon thos na dga'/ khro gtum pa de ni ma'i rigs so/ /de'i dus der ri rnams ni shing nags su song / klung thams cad ni chus khengs yod pa/ skong chu

64lag kha phye nas/ chu thams cad der song ste/ skong chu lag tu thim mo/ /de nas thang thams cad la zhing byas/ grong khyer mang po brtsigs/ de nas ring por ma lon par/ rje gnya' khri btsan po bod kyi rgyal po la byon nas/ rje dang 'bangs su bcos skad do/ /bod kyi mi brgyud smre'u dang brag srin mo nas chad pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //brgyad pa/ bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs dang po ji ltar byon pa bston pa'i skor/de nas bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ de'ang / gnam la khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ bar du legs drugs la sde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan gsum zhes pa ltar/ rje gnya' khri btsan po nas/ re re nas bgrang ba'i gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun na/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal byon te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbu brnyes pa yin no/ /de'ang / bka' chems ka khol ma las/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po shākya ri brag pa'i gdung brgyud chos rgyal mya ngan med nas rim par byon pa/ rgyal po skyabs ding dang / dmag brgya pa gnyis lhan du skyes so/ /rgyal srid la ma 'cham pa'i dus su/ dmag brgya pa la bu gsum byung ba'i chung shos/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pa cig /rgyal srid la dbang ma thob par/ lhas lung bstan pa bzhin/ bu mo'i chas su byas te bod kyi yul du sprugs pa yin kyang zer la/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung na/ ko sa la'i

65rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi brgyud lnga tshegs sam/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i rgyud lnga tshigs sam/ yang na bdas la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi bu/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pa cig yin par gsungs la/ gang ltar na yang /rje gnya' khri btsan po yin par don mthun no/ /de'ang bod kyi yig tshang las/dang po lha ri rol po'i rtse la babs te gzigs pas/ gangs yar lha sham po mtho ba dang / yul yar lung bzang bar mkhyen nas/ btsan thang gong ma'i ri la babs pas/ phyugs skyong ba'i rdzi'u rnams kyis mthong ste/ rtsar byung nas gang nas 'ong dris pas/ gnam la mdzub mo ker ba dang / 'di ni nam mkha' nas 'ong ba'i lha sras yin par 'dug pas/ 'o cag rnams kyi rje bcol lo zer te/ gnya' bar khri byas btegs nas 'ong pa na/ rje gnya' khri btsan po zer te/ (sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong song ba na/)bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba de yin no/ /des pho brang 'um bu glang mkhar brtsigs/ de'i sras mu khri btsan pa/ de'i sras ding khri btsan po/ de'i sras so khri btsan po/ de'i sras me khri btsan po/ de'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di yan ni gnam gyi khri bdun zer te/ sras rnams kyis rim pa bzhin chib kha thub tsa na/ yab rnams rim pa bzhin du skyi thag la byas nas/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin 'gro yang zer/ khri bdun bang so nam mkha'i dbyings la btab/ /lha yi lus la ro med 'ja' ltar yal/ /zhes so/ /srib khri btsan po'i sras/ gri gum btsan po/ de la sras gsum byung ba/sha khri/ nya khri/ bya khri gsum yin no/ /rgyal po gri gum btsan po de/ thugs gdon gyis bslus te/ blon po long ngam rta rdzi zer ba cig la/ khyod kyis nga'i 'thab ya byed dgos zer nas/ long ngam na re/ rje ci lags/ nga 'bangs shig gisacwa'i 'thab ya mi 'ong zhus kyang / dbang med du bcol bas 'thab

56par chas/ skar ma sa ga dang sa ri'i nyin 'khrug dus byas so/ — /der rgyal phos/ khyi mo nyan gyi rna gsang ma bya ba'i sprul pa'i khri cig yod pa/ long ngam gyi rtsar nyan btang bas/ long ngam gyis de bzhin ngo shes nas gnangs nyin rgyal pos nged rang gsod du 'odwa ste/ dmag gi 'khor ma khrid par/ rgyal po'i dbu la dar nag gi thod bcing / dpul bar me long btags/ phrag pa g.yas la wa ro bkal/ khyi ro g.yon la bkal/ ral gri glad(glad)la bskor/ glang dmar la thal sgro bkal byung na/ nged rang gis mi thub ces smras so/ /khyi mo des rgyal po la de bzhin du zhus pas/ de ltar byed gsungs te/ gnangs nyin de ltar byas nas/ long ngam gsod du byon/ bso sgra btab pas glang dmar 'grogs te/ thal sgro ral bas thal tshub kyis mig kheng / wa ros dgra lha yal/ khyi ros pho lha yal/ ral gri glad(klad)la bskor bal skyi thag cad/ der blon po long ngam gyis rgyal po'i dpral ba'i me long la gtad nas mda' brgyab pas rgyal po bkrongs so/ /rgyal po'i sras gsum po ni/ kong po dang / nyang po/ spo bo gsum gyi yul du 'bros so/ /der blon po long ngam gyis rgyal srid phrogs nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo la rta rdzi bcol lo/ /der yum btsun mo des rta 'tshor phyin nas/ gnyid log pa'i rmi lam na/ yar lha sham po'i sprul pa mi dkar po cig dang 'brel pa rmis/ gnyid sad tsa na/ sngas mgo nas g.yag dkar po cig long nas song ba mthong / de nal zla ba brgyad song tsa na/ yum btsun mo de la khrug gong po lag mgo tsam 'gul shes pa cig skyes byung ba bskyur bar ni sha nas chad snying rje bar byung / gso ba la ni kha mig gang yang mi 'dug nas/nabrong ru dron mo cig tu bcug gos thung gi ngar pas dril bzhag pas/ zhag 'ga' song dus bltas pas/ khye'u cig byung 'dug de'i ming yang 'jang gi/bu ru la skyes zhes grags so/ /des lo bcu lon dus nga'i pha dang / — pho

57bo rnams gar song zhes/ a ma la dris pas/ a mas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib par bshad pa dang / ru la skyes kyi thabs sna tshogs kyis nyang chu skya mo nas yab kyi pur btsal te/ phying yul dar thang du yab kyi bang so brtsig blorge po long ngam bsad/ pho bo gsum gdan 'dren phyin pas/ sha khri dang / nya khri gnyis gdan ma drangs te/ kong po dang / nyang po'i rje mdzad nas da lta yang gdung brgyud yod do/ /spo bo'i yul nas/ sras bya khri gdan drangs rte/ yar lungs su bzhugs/ sku mkhar bying nga stag rtse brtsigs/ yum gyis sras bya khri la 'jus nas/ lha la dmod bor bas/ nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste/ khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /bu de kun las rgyal zer kyang spu de gung rgyal du grags so/ /rgyal po 'dis rgyal sa bzung ste/ blon po ni ru la skyes kyis byas so/ /rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyi dus su/ g.yung drung gi bon byung ste/ ston pa gshen rabs mi bo bya ba stag gzig 'ol mo'i lung rings su sku 'khrungs/ khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa bon po'i chos thams cad/ zhang zhung gi yul nas bsgyur te/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bon la rigs dgu ru phye ste/ rgyu'i bon po la rigs bzhi/ 'bras bu'i bon po la rigs lnga'o/ /'bras bu'i bon rigs lnga ni/ g.yung drung theg pa bla na med pa la zhugs pa ste/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob par 'dod do/ /rgyu'i bon po rigs bzhi ni/ snang gshen bal thod can/ 'phrul gshen bal tshon can/ phya gshen ju thig can/ dur gshen mtshon cha can no/ /de la snang gshen bal thod can gyis phya dang g.yang 'gug lha dang sman gsol/ dge legs dang dpal bskyed nas mi nor rgyas par byed/ 'phrul gshen bal tshon can gyis mdos dang yas gtong / srid dang rten 'dzugs/ 'phral phugs kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad sel bar byed do/ /phya gshen ju thig can gyis/

58legs nyes kyi lam ston/ yin min gyi the tshom sel/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'chad par byed do/ /dur gshen mtshon cha can gyis gson gyi bgegs sel/gshin gyi dur 'debs/ chung gi sri gnon/ gnam gyi rgyu skar lta/ sa'i 'dre btul ba yin no/ /thams cad rnga shang gi sgra 'khrol ba ste/ chab srid ni sgrung ste lte'u bsgyur ro/ /(bon gyi lo rgyus las/ rje gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su bon dar/ rgyal po gri gum btsan pos bon bsdub/ rgyal po spu de gung rgyal gyi dus su bon dar/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bon bkub/ rting du bon gyi bla ma rnya chen li zho ka ra bya bas/ khams nas bon gyi me ro bslang nas/ dbus gtsang du pheb/ bon chos thams cad gter nas bton/ ri zhing / dar sding / dge sding / na tsa kha/ ba nga ri/ yog thang la sogs pa bon po'i sde btsug /bon rgyas par byas zer/ bon la'ang / bstan pa snga dar/ bar dar/ snyi dar gsum byung ladug/ke gzhan yang shing bsregal pa'i snying po sol ba/ ko ba bzhu ba'i snying po la spyin byung /lcags rdo/ zangs rdo/ dngul rdo gsum rnyed nas/ sol bas rdo gsum bzhus nas/ dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ shing la bug pa phug nas gshol dang gnya' shing bcos//mthun gnyis gnya' ru bsdebs pas thang rnams zhing du rmos//rgya mtsho hūṃr la drangs nas zhing la sa bon btab// de'i gong na zhing la so nam med/ yab gri gum btsan po dang / sras spu de gung rgyal gnyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zer/ steng gnyis bang so g.ya' dang spang la btab/ de'i lag dpon ru la skyes kyis byas so/ / spu de gung rgyal gyi sras/ a sho legs/ de'i sras de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ de'i sras gu ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong zher legs/ de'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams bar gyi legs drug zer/legs drug bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab/ /de'ang spang la 'ja' tshon rgyas pa 'dra/

60gzhon sha can du gyur nas/ dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub ste/ sku lus gcig la sku tshe gnyis thub ces grags so/ /rgyal po des dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin no/ /de yi bang so rang gi yul du btab//yul gyi ming ni phying lung dar thang //bang so de yang sa phung sbra 'dra yod//lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sras khri snyan gzugs btsan/ des kyang gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa byas pas chab srid rgyas par byung ngo //de yi bang so don 'khor mda' ru brtsigs//de yang 'phul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra//de'i sras 'brang snyan lde ru/ rgyal po des dag po'i yul nas mchims bza' klu rgyal/ (klu mo yin/kyebya ba'i btsun rme cig blangs pas/ sras dmus long cig 'khrungs pas/ ming yang dmus long dkon pa bkra zhes grags so/ /mchims bza' klu rgyal de dang po shin tu mtshar ba cig yod pa la/ rting du sngo la rid par byung bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod dang po shin tu mtshar ba cig yod pa la/ na ba ni min nam/ 'di 'dra yod pa ci yin gsungs pas/ nga rang gi yul na zas shig yod pa de/ca 'di ru med pas lan pa 'dra zer bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'o na zas de cis kyang long la zo gsungs pas/ der g.yog mo dam pa cig zas di len btang bas/ der mos sbal pa'i ro mang po mar gyis btsos te/ khal mang po blangs byung bas/ de rnams mdzod du sbal/ mis ma mthong bar byas shing lkog tu zos pas/ sha bkrag sngar bzhin rgyas shing 'od dang ldan pa byung ba dang / rgyal po'i thugs la zas de yon tan can zhig 'dug pa la/ ngas kyang za dgos bsams te/ btsun mo med pa'i shul du/ lde chab

61kyi sgo phyes nas nang du byon pa dang / mdzod nang na sbal ba'i ro mang po mar gyis btsos pa'i rkyal pa mang po 'dug nas rnam rtog skyes te/ rgyal po la bsnyung du mdze byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po yab yum gnyis ka gson por bang sor rībazhugs nas/ sras la zhal chems bzhag pa ni/ yab mes kyi thugs dam gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa gyis/ 'a ci'i yul nas sman pa bos la/ mig phye nas rgyal srid zungs shig gsung ngo / /'brong snyan lde ru'i bang so zhang mdar brtsigs/bablo so'i ming kyang gson chas rlum por grags//zhes so/ /de nas dmus long dkon pa bkras/ gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa phul zhing mos gus byas pas/ sman pa bos nas mig phye bas/ skyi shod stag gi ri la gnyan 'gro ba gzigs pas na/ mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs zhes bu/ba/sa so/ /stag ri gnyan gzigs bzhi bcu lon dus 'das//de yi bang so don 'khor mda' ru brtsigs//gral ni khri snyan gzung btsan g.yon na yod//de yang 'phul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra//stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan yin la/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su/ rgya nag nas sman dang rtsis byung / rgya dang gru gu btul/ byang nas tsha rnyed/ sku mkhar khri brtsigs 'bum brdugs bya ba brtsigs/ chab srid lo drug cu bzung nas 'das so/ /de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs//gral ni khri snyan gzung btsan g.yas na yod//de yang 'phul che rtsig pa bhāg khar yod//

62 ming kyang gangs ri sdog kha lags so skad//ces so/ /de ltar phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi ma/ bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs/ (shes bya rab gsal nas/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo nyis stong dus/ rje gnya' khri btsan po byon/ nyis stong lnga brgya na/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal byon gsung bar 'dug) rje gnya' khri btsan po nas/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal yan la gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun la lo lnga brgya song 'dug par nges zer na'ang / chos dang 'brel pa'i rgyal por mi 'dug pas/ lo rgyus rgyas par ma bkod/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi dus su/ dam pa chos gyi dbu brnyes/ lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ de nas gdung rabs bzhi/ gnam ri srong btsan yan la/ lo brgya dang bcu gcig lon pa yin zhes ka tshigs chen mo na bshad yod do/ /'di dag ni zur tsam bsdus pa yin gyis/ /rgyas par 'dod na ka tshigs chen mo dang / bka' chems ka khol ma/ rgyal rabs dpag bsam smon shing rnams la gzigs shig /bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs dang po ji ltar byon pa bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // dgu pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la 'od zer bzhi 'apos pa las/ chos rgyal 'khyangs pa'i skor/de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bodartekha ba can gyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ sku la 'od zer bzhi 'phros

63te/ de'ang spyan g.yas pa nas 'od zer cig 'phros de/ bal po'i yul du song ba/ bal po'i yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab/ bal po'i rgyal po de ba lha yang 'ong zer gyis khyab par byas/ grong khyer kho bom klu'i pho brang yang 'od zer gyis snang bar byas so/ /de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus nas/rgyal po de ba lha'i btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs so/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ lha gcig khyad du 'phags pa cig 'khrungs te/ lha gcig de ni 'jig rten las khyad du 'phags pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ha ri tsan+dan gyi dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa cig sku 'khrungs te/ de ni bal mo bza' khri btsun 'di yin no/ /yang spyan g.yon pa nas 'od zer gcisku 'phros pas rgya nag gi yul dā song ste/ rgya nag gi yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab par matsad/ rgya rje tha'i dzung rgyal po yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ pho brang zem shing khri sgo yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus te/ rgya rje btsan po'i btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs so/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ lha gcig khyad du 'phags pa cig sku 'khrungs te/ lha gcig de ni 'jig rten las khyad par du 'phags pa/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ut+pal rdzon po'i dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa cig 'khrungs te/ de ni rgya mo bza' kong jo 'di yin no/ /yang zhal nas 'od zer cig 'phros te/ bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su/ brag la chu rgyag pa'i 'phrong la phog pas/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i gnyen po gsang ba 'bru drug chos sku'i rnam par gyur te/ de ni yar 'phrang gi yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /yang thugs ka nas 'od zer cig 'phros te/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su song / bod kha ba can gyi yul

64 thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ yang bsdon sbra stod tshal yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling yang 'od zer gyis khyab pan+d+ra mdzad/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan kyang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus te/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi btsun mo 'bri bza' thod dkar ma'i lhums su zhugs pa dang / bkra shis pa'i ltas kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur to/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ sras khyad par du 'phags pa cig me mo glang gi lo la/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku bltams te/ dbu la sangs rgyas a mi de ba bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing du yod pa cig bltams so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste/ so yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de yang mthong phywags rnam pa gsum du byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi snang ba la/ri 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs des/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas/ bod kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams smin grol la bkod nas/ mtha' 'khob kyi yul 'dir/mun pa'i rum du sgron me sbar ba ltar gyur te/ rin po che'i gling du gzigs so/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams chos la bkod pa'i phyir du/ sprul pa'i rgyal por sku sprul nas/ gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag tha mal ba rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po la sras 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ngo mtshar ba cig 'khrungs par mthong ngo / /der rgyal bu de nar lon dus/ bzo dang / rtsis dang / sgyu rtsal dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing yon tan dang ldan par gyur pas/

la ga (5(5blon po rnams na re/ 'o cag tsho'i rje 'di ni yon tan du ma dang ldan te/thugs shin tu sgam mo zer bas/ mtshan yang srong btsan sgam po zhes grags so/ /de nas rgyal po de dgung lo bcu sum lon dus/ yab 'das te/ rgyal sar byon pa yin no/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa 'ab bdag gis kha ba can 'dir sems can gyi don byed pa la/sa phyogs gang du phyin la bsgom snyam pa dang / bdag gi yab mes lha tho tho ri snyan shal/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa des/ lha sa dmar po ri'i rtse la bzhugs 'dug pa/ bdag gis kyang yab mes kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i sa cha/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i sa gnas der phyin la/ sems can gyi don byed par dgongs te/ der yar bsdon sbra stod tshal du dgongs man la/nang par gro bteg ste/ yar 'phrang yi ge drug pa'i drung du khal phog khal ma rnams bzan la skyel nas/ der gro btab po/ /de nas rgyal pos chab la sku khrus gsol/ chu'i nang na 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa cig khru cam me 'dug pa blon po sna chen pos mthong nas/ rgyal po la zhus pa/ rje ci lags/ chu'i nang du 'od zer 'di lta bu 'ong ba shin tu ngo mtshar che lags zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas zhang blon chen po nyon cig /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'dir sems can thams cad smin grol la 'god pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ phan bde dang yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i gnyen po/ kha ba can pa'i chos skal/ yang snying 'dus pa'i snying po/ gsang ba 'bru drug chos kyi sku'i yig 'bru/ gsung mchog yi ge drug ma cig brag 'di la 'byon par 'dug 'dis kyang sems can mang po'i don byed par 'dug go gsungs te/ brag de la mchod pa phul ba dang / brag de las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te/ pha rol

(sta(sta —sku — —— gyi brag de la phog nas/ phan tshun 'ja'i mdangs su 'brel pas na/ grong de'i ming yang 'ja' mdangs bya ba yod de/ brag de la'ang / (spyon ras gzigs kharlu pa ṇi/ dpal rta mgrin la sogs pa/ rting du bal po'i lha bzo bas 'bur du bkaus/)lha'i sku rang chas su byon yod do/ /de nas byon te dmar po ri'i steng du pho brang btab nas bzhugs so/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la 'od zer bzhi 'phros pa las/ chos rgyal 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //bcu pa/ blon po thon mis rgya gar nas yi ge bsgyur ba 'a sa/ rgyal pos dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas pa'i skor/de nas chos dge ba bcu la brten pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' ba/ 'dod yon lnga spel ba/ phan tshun du skyes bskur ba/ mnga' 'og gi 'bangs rnams la chos kyi bka' bsgo ba la/ bod —na yi ge med pas/ blon po dbang po rno ba bdun rgya gar du yi ge slob tu btang pas/ mtha' 'dre rnam pa gsum la thug nas log pas/ de nas thon mi a nu'i bu/ thon mi saspyo ṭa zhes pa yid gzhungs pa dbang po rno ba/ yon tan du ma dang ldan pa cig yod pa la/ gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar du yi ge slob tu btang ngo / /der blon pos rgya gar sto phyogs su phyin te/ yi ge'i sgra la mkhas pa bram ze li byin zhes bya ba yod zer ba thos nas/ bram ze ga la ba der phyin te/ gus par phyag bca la te gsol ba/thugs rje rab rgyas rnam 'phrul lha yi rigs// yon tan ldan pas bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs//tshe sngon yon tan sbyangs pa song d+ngha'i mthul//

67lung rigs yi ge'i sgra la phul du phyin//mkhas grub rig 'dzin bram ze chen po khyed// cung zad bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsol//bdag ni mtha' 'khob bod kyi blon po yin//bdag gi rgyal po thugs rje chen po lags//bcu gsum lon nas rgyal sa rab bzung ste//rin chen khri yi steng du bzhugs pa'i dus//'khor 'bangs rnams la chos kyis tshim pa dang //dge ba bcu yi rgyal khrims bca' ba la//bdag gi yul na yi ge'i srol med pas//bdag la phyag rten rgya chen bskur nas ni//khyed kyi yul du yi ge slob tu btang //mkhas pa khyed kyis sgra tshad yi ge'i tshogs//ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol//zhes zhus nas/ gser rnams phyag tu phul ba dang / bram ze chen po des/gser phyag tu bzhes nas lan mdzad pa/legs par nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu//thon mi zer ba'i blon po rig pa can//bden gnyis don rtogs blon chen khyed la ni//yi ge'i sgra dang snyan ngag la sogs dang //gzhan yang yon tan ngo mtshar can rnams kun//blon chen khyed la bdag gis bslab par bgyi//khyod kyis mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams su//

skye8'gro ba rnams la yi ge'i sgra tshad dang //lung rig man ngag rnams kyis tshim par mdzod//ces smras te/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du khrid nas yi ge'i 'bru bstan pas/ der blon po thon mis rig pa'i rtsal phyes/ shes rab kyi sgrin me btag nas yi ge bslabs pas/ na ga ra'i sde tshan/ ga ta'i sde tshan rnams mang du yod pa/ bod la mi 'gyur bas dbyangs yig la bkod/ lāchi lha'i yi ge/ /wa rtu la klu'i yi ge/ lhun grub tshang ma bodartekyi yi ge la bkod/rgya yi yi ge lnga bcu ni//yi ge gtso bo sum cu la//'phul yig bcu dang mtha' rten bcu// rgya yi yi ge re re bzhin//rang gang spyod pa ma gtogs pa//kun la khyab pa cig kyang med//de dag thams cad khong du bsdus//de la dpe byas bsdus pa ni//bod yig sum cu gtan la phab//yi ge'i 'bru ni re re bzhin//bzo'i rnam 'gyur legs par bcos// yi ge'i gtso bo nyi shu la//ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a/ med kyang rung ba'i yig 'bru gcig/ wa/ 'phul yig lnga dang / ga da ba ma 'a/ mtha' rten bcu/ga da ba ma 'a nga na ra la sa/ shin tu gces pa'i yi ge lnga/ ga da spro ma 'a /rkang ba can gyi yi ge dgu/ ka ga ta da na nya zhu sha ha/ rgya la med pa'i yi ge

69drug /ca cha ja zha za 'a/ yi ge bu ni bcu drug la/ ka ga nga da ta na pa ba ma ca ja nya tsa dza la ha/ yi ge ma ni bdun du bcos/ ka ga ba za/ kun gyi ma ni/ ra la sa/ ('dog thams cad kyi ma gsum/)la la sgos su ma bzhi yod/ ka ga ba za la'i ma/ (yig 'bya bzhi po 'di la/ la kho na 'degs/)la la sgos su bu gnyis yod//ca dang ha gnyis la yi bu//tsa dang dza gnyis ra yi bu//'phug dang mtha' rten mi byed cing //ma bu gnyis ka mi byed pa'i//rang sa 'dzin pa'i yi ge bcu//kha cha tha pa tsha wa zha ya sha a/ ga ba yi ge kun tu rgyu/ (ma dang bu gnyis ka byed/'phul dang mtha' rten gnyis ka byed/) steng na zha ltar lding ba gsum// na ro gi gu 'greng po ste//'di gsum yi ge kun la khyab//'og na gdan ltar mdzes pa gsum// ya ta ra ta zhabs kyu ste// ya ta 'dogs pa'i yi ge bdun//kya khya gya pya phya bya mya/ ra ta 'dogs pa'i yi ge bcu gcig yod/ kra khru gra pra phra bra ma sra sha dra hra/ zhabs kyu'i yi ge kun la khyab/ kyu khyu kru khru/ ya ta ra ta gnyis la'ang khyab/ 'dogs dang sdeb sbyor blo la shar ro/ /gzhan yang lāsmi lha'i yi ge 'dra/(ha dang 'a gnyis kyi yi ge'i bu byed pa dang / na log/ sha log /tha log byed pa sogs ni/ sa kro ta'i skad/ bod du gzungs sngags su 'gyur dus/ yi ge'i rnam

70dargyad la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍita rnams kyis rting du bcas so/)de la dpe byas nas yi ge dbu can du byas/ wa rtu la klu'i yi ge 'dra/ de la dpe byas nas yi ge zur can du byas so/ /'di ni zur tsam yin gyis/ rgyas par 'dod na thon mis/ dang po yi ge'i rnam 'gyur gyi bzo brtsam/ ka smad sum cur bsgyur/ sdeb sbyor bsgrig pa'i gzhi ma/ thon mi mdo ji'i sgra mdo bya ba yod kyis de dag la gziṭa shīg /gzhan yang blon po thon mi des/ pash+lauta lha rigs seng ge la/ sgra bstan bcos thams cad bslabs nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur te/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog /mdo za ma tog /spyan ras gzigs kyi lado rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bod du bsgyur/ lo rgyus cig na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa yang bsgyur zer ba'ang 'dug /mdor na blon po thon mi de/ bslab shes kyi yon tan du ma la mkhas par gyur to/ /de nas blon po bod du byon pa'i dus su/ bram ze la gsol ba/thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras//bka' drin che'o ngo mtshar che// byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can// rig pa dri med kyi nam mkha' la//thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar//smon lam dag pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs//sgra tshad yi ge'i nyi zla shar// 'gro ba ma rig mun pa sel//bde gsal yid kyi rgya mtsho la//rig pa blo yi chu bran 'khor// smon lam dag pa'i chu bya 'ding (sding)//

71sgra tshad yi ge'i hātre/ra bu bzhugs//'gro ba'i dbul phong sa sel bar byed//sgyu lus dri med sding po la//thabs shes gnyimu/ kyi yal ga rgyas//bslab shes yon /tan me tog shar//sgra tshad yi ge'i ‘sdibras bu smin//bdag cag blon 2/ thon mi la//ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags//rgya gar yul du : )na pa yin//mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin// dzeyon tan gzhi ma yi ge yin//ma lus khong du theṭ+wāṃ da pa yin//bod yul dbus su 'gro ba yin//rgyal pos dga' ston mdzad pa yin//rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin// —rgyal pos dbu mdzad blon 'bangs la//sgra tshad yi ge spespru ba yin//kun la rgyas par byed pa yin//thugs la btags/ so rgyal ba'i sras//zhes/ brjod de/ zhabs spyi sgyusgos blangs/ theg pa chen po'i chos du ma dang bcar te bod du phebs/ bsu ba dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sardo byon pa la/ blon po thon mis/ na ro/ gi gu/ zhabs kyu sogs sde tshan du byas te/ yi ge'i phud phul ba/

72 zhal ras gsal la ngang mdangs gang ba bzang //gdams ngag zab la ma chad tha dad dang //las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa//'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa la//bde gshegs bden nges ye shes te//ting 'dzin zhi nyid rig cing gzigs//nyon mongs tshogs bcom mgon po mchog /dug gsum bdud 'dul kun tu thul// (thon mi'i mi gi'i phud 'di/dzin khog sna rdo'i lha khang la brag la brkos nas yod do/3spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi sras//srong btsan sgam por mtshan gsol ba'i//chos rgyal khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa dang / rgyal po shin tu dgyes nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs nas/ bkur sti dang phu dud du mdzad do/ /rgyal pos blon po la yon tan che ba'i bkur sti mdzad pa dang / blon po gzhan rnams phrag dog gis kun nas bslangs te/ rje yis 'bangs la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti mi 'os so zhes dril bsgrags pa dang / blon po thon mis de dag gis(gi)'gran sems gcog pa'i phyir du/ 'di skad zer ro//nga drin chen gyi blon po— thon mi ngas//lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du//l+yas tsha grang che yang dka' ba spyad// khong mkhas pa bram ze li byin la//yid gus pa'i tshul gyis mos gus byas//

73nor rin chen ba/ser gyi phyag rten phul//don rnyed par dka' ba'i yig 'bru bstan//blo the tshom sel ba'i mdzub khrid byas//tshig dbyangs yig rnams la mkhas par bslabs//rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa de// bod yig sum ri /ra gtan la phab//rang mkhas pa'i nges shes blo la shar//'phral yon tan thams cad khong du chud//dus da lta dga' la phyi ma skyid//yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir//mi mkhas pa che/ba pa'i snga ma yin//nga mun pa sel rnga/'i sgron me yin//rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs//grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med//bod kha ba can rnga 'i mi rnams la// nga thon mi bka' drin mi che'am// (thon mi'i nga rgyal zer/)zhes zer bas/ blon rnga/ rnams gcig la gcig lta zhing / 'gran sems med par gyur to/ /dus de tsa na/ yang grags kyi blonari po sum brgya la/(snyi nang bar gsum gyi blon po 'di rnams kyi ming thang yig chen mo nas bsdus/)ming chen gyi blon po bcu drug yod/ med thabs mengakyi pa'i blon chen bzhi/(ces pa3rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs kyi zhabs tog /phyi nang bar gsum gyi bya ba byed pa'i blon po/ byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud blon po bcu drug gi thog drangs pa'i blon po sum brgya yod do/ /de'ang phyi blon btsan po drug/ nang blon bzang po drug /bka'i

74 'phrul blon bzhi'o/ /de la nang blon bzang po drug ni/ 'phrul gyi sna chen rig bzang / (khru 'brug/)zhang po rgyal gyi khrum bzang / (horayin/)cog ro rig pa'i skad bzang /(cogaro/)lhar gzigs shog po bstan bzang /(khams pa/)ka'i gnyaṭa ston 'phel bzang / (rgya mayar ston/3sbas lcang dpal gyi leṭa bzang / (spas kyi skyed thag ring mo'ang zer/)la sogs te/ blon po brgya tham pas/ rgyal po'i sku'i zhabs tog dang // nang gi dzo ba thams cad byed do/ /phyi blon btsan po drug ni/(byang gi khyung po na/)khyung po sbu na bzang btsan/ (mar stod pa/kyelam khri bde lhag khri btsan/ ('phan yul rgyal ba/3mu khri rdo rje gnam btsan/ ('jad pa)mthing gi byang chub mchog btsan/(mchong rgyas ba/)thar pa klu'i dpal btsan/(yar lung son pa/)rong po 'phrul gyi sde btsan la sogs pa'i blon po brgya tham pas snyi blon byed/ shar rgya dang / mi nyag gi yul nal bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe blangs/ sto phyogs rgya gar gyi yul nas dam pa chos kyi sgra bsgyur/ nub phyogs sbog po dang / bal po'i yul nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter mdzad/ byang phyogs hor dang yu ge ra'i yul nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blang / mdor na phyogs bzhi la dbang bsgyur zhing longs spyad nas/ 'dzam gling phyed kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po mdzad do/ /thon mi sasto ṭa/ (thod lur(thon lung)ra ga ba/3mgar srang btsan yul bzung / (stod lung ram pa ba/)'bri se ru gong ston/ ('bri khung ba/)nyang khri bzang / (nyang ser ba/)yang ston la sogs pa blon po brgya tham pas bar gyi khod stoms/ rgyal pos bka' stsal pa bzhin/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bca' ba ste/ bzang la bya dga' ster/ngan pa la chad pa gcod/ mtho ba khrims kyis gnon/ dma' ba thabs kyis skyong / sku bsrung sde bzhir spyad/ phu chu rdzing du bskyil/ mda' chu yur bar drangs/ bre srang gtan la phab/ zhing la lhu ru spyad/ mi la yi ge bslabs/rta la mdongs su bris/ legs pa'i dpe srol btsug ste/ 'thab mo byas pa la

75chad pa/ bsad pa la che chung gi stong byed pa/ brkus pa la brgyad 'jal ngos dang dgu/ byi byas pa'i yan /lag gi phran bcad nas yul gzhan du sprugs pa/rdzun byas pa'i lce gcod pa'o/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing / dad pa dang mos gus bya ba/ pha ma la drin du gzo zhing bkur sti bya ba/ mi drin chen dang pha /ṭī rgan gsum gyi yi mi gartsad cingartse/ bzang po'i lan byed pa/ mi ya rabs dang rigs btsun pa la mi rgol cing dang du len pa/las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lha chos dang yi ge la blo 'jug cing don shes par bya ba/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing /mi dge ba 'ba' zhig la 'dzezu/ pa/ mdza' bshes dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dog cing gnod sems mi bya ba/ gzhi drang por bya zhing blo sems dpang du 'jog pa/ zas chang la tshod redzin cing khrel yod par bya ba/ bu lon dus su 'jal cing / bre srang la g.yo zol mi bya ba/ ma bskos shing ma bcol ba'i bya ba la rtog 'jug mi bya ba dang / gros kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan cing rang tshugs 'dzin pa/ yin ཿ/na gyis ma tshang ba byung na/ yul lha bstan srung dpang du btsugs nas mna' ཿ)da pa la sngogal te/ dge ba bcu la dpe byas nas/ bod khrims nyi shu/ /) zhod/ sho ma ra ru gtan la phab ste/ rje blon kun gyi phyag rgyas btab ste/ /) zla'i 'od lta bur khyab par mdzad do//de ltar mdzad nga/sa rje btsan 'bangs rnams skyid//bstan pa rgyas hā/nga rgyal srid phyogs bcur 'phel//chos kyi bka' / mas mdzad pas 'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/mi rje lha yis mdzad pas rgyal khams thams cad skyid// pho dpa' rta makru/gas longs spyod lha dang mnyam//blo gtad chos 'a/ byas pas 'di gyi gnyis kar skyid//

76 'thab dang rtsod pa spangs pas thams nyad pha mar shes//kun la yi ge bslabs pas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar//mi dge'i bshes gnyen med pas dge bcu'i nor bu rnyed//kun gyi gtsug tu khur bas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar//thams cad sprul pa yin pas khrul dang 'u lag med// nam mkha'i mthongs la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad shar//dog mo'i sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad skyes//bar gyi ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang //ljon shing thams cad dga' ba'i tshal du 'thibs//bya rnams kun kyang ca co du ma sgrogs//sa rnams kun kyang rnam pa drug tu g.yos//lha rnams kun gyis me tog char pa phab /bkra shis nyams su dga' ba'i brag lha'i tshal//ljon shing star kha sdong po'i bsil grib la// chos rgyal chen po khri yi steng na bzhugs//dpa' mdzarngos 'asbul ldan blon po'i tshogs dang bcas//bod 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pas mtha' ma bskor//kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa 'ja' yi gur//rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mkha' la gdugs ltar 'khyil//bu ram rgun 'brum ka ra zhal zas sogs//ro brgya ldan pa'i zas kyi tshogs rnams kyang //rgyal pos gsol zhing 'khor rnams tshim par byed//chos rgyal chen po'i sku yi skyo sangs la/

— 17 'bag dang seng ‘go g.yag seng stag seng dang //rnga bro mkhan dang gar mkhan la sogs kyis//re re bzhinadzadu rngakar dang rtsed mo 'bul//lha yi rnga bo che nga/ nga spa wang dang //rol mo sil snyan rnams kyis mchod pa dang //sman mchog a ga ru dang tsardon dang // — dri zhim bdug spros rnams ni rlung ltar g.yo// gdugs dang rgya'/ mtshan ba dan lhab lhub dang //sna tshogs dar gyis nam mkha' gang bar mchod//yid 'ong mdzes pa'i bu mo bcu drug gis//— mdzes pa'i rgyan bcas me tog thogs nas ni//glu dang gar gyis rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed//dga' bde skyid pa'i bka' khrims mdzad pa'i tshe//bod 'bangs mi nges rta re zhon nas rgyug /shing re'i rtse la dar re phyar gin bzhag /dam pa chos kyi rnga chen dam pa brdung //dge ba bcu la rnga/nyun pa'i rgyal khrims bcas// 'dod yon lnga dang bstun pa'i longs spyod spel//kha ba can pa'i rgyal khams 'di nyid du//dge bcu'i rgyal khrims mkha' la nyi zla bzhin//bod yul gangs can khrod 'dir khyab par mdzad//blon po thon mis rgya gar nas 6/ ge bsgyur ba las/ rgyal pos dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //

78 bcu gcig pa/ rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi lha rgya gar dang / bal po'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i skor/ de nas sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag gis mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ sems can gyi don byed pa la/yi dam gyi lha cig bzhengs dgos te/ de'i rgyu ni rin po che gser dngul las byas na ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sems can bsod nams ngaman pas dus kyi tha ma la bshigs pa'i dogs yodan sa dang rdo las byas na ni rgyu ngan/ shing gi rigs las byas na ni 'gas/ bdag gi yi dam gyi lha bzhengs pa'i rgyu gang leṭa dgongs te/ 'phags pa la gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangarnga/ kyi dus su sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa thams cad sprin 'dus pa ltar/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas/ 'phagal pa 'jam dpal dang / 'phags pa kun tu bzang po gnyis kyis/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba phyag ṣ+pe bzung nas/rgyal po la dbang bskur/ sku khrus gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis sprin gyi gseb nas lus phyed thon tsam byas nas/ lha'i rol mo sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byed cing me tog gi char phab bo/ /de ma thag tu rgyal po'i sku la 'od zer sna tshogis pa cig 'phros nas/

79mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul :/mas cad 'od zer gyis khyab par byas nas/gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa re res sems can gyi don byas nas/ mtha' 'khob de yang rin po che'i gling 9lta bur gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu rgyal po la 'di skad ce sa zhus so/ / sprul pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems//mgo nag yongs sdi/ rje khyed kyis//mos gus bsod zu/ mas bsags pa'i rten//yi dam lha cig spyan 'dren na// rgya gar yul gyi sto phyogs su//siṅga la yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram// rang byon kharla pa ṇi'i rgyab//glang chen nyal ba'i bye ma'i 'og /tsardon sbrul gyi snying po las//grub pa'i rang byon spyan ras gzigs//ngo mtshar can cib/ de na bzhugs//de ni rgyal po'i yi dam yin//zhes zer te/ mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ yi dam gyi lha de spyan 'dre'e/ pa la/ mis mi rnyed pas/ sprul pa cig btang dgos dbongs pa dang / de ma thag tu rgyal po'i smin ma tshams kyi mdzod spu nas/ sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shrī la zhes pa/ dbu 9ra sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa cig sprul nas/ yi dam de spyan 'dren pa la btang ngo / /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya gar sto phyogs su byon pa dang / grong khyer dbus 'gyur bya bar slebs te/ de na rgyal po ut+pal

80ge sar zhes pa/ rgyal po de gdung brgyud nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa la/phyis phyi pa mu stegs pa'i chos lugs bzung nas/ nyin re la ra lnga lnga bsad nas/ dbang phyug chen po'i rten la mchod do/ /rgyal po'i pho brang de'i g.yon na/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis rab gnas mdzad pa'i mchod rten pad+ma'i 'khor lo can bya ba bzhugs so/ /der sprul pa'i dge slong des/mchod rten de'i bum pa'i thad kyi nam mkha' la skyil krung mjod cing bskor ba mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi yang thog nas gzigs pas ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ rgyal pos sprul pa'i dge slong de pho brang du gdan drangs pa dang /dge slong 'byon du ma gnang ste/ nan gyis zhus pas/ dge slong gi zhal nas/ngas ji ltar ther ba'i kha la nyan na khyed kyi pho brang du 'ong / mi nyan na mi 'ong gsungs pas/ rgyal pos dge slong ji ltar gsungs pa la nyan par mdzad nas/rgyal po'i pho brang du byon nas mchod gnas mdzad do/ /der dge slong gi zhal nas/ khyed sngar nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin par 'dug pa la/ phyi rol pa'i chos lugs 'di bsgyur nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs su gyis la/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal pos de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes so/ /yang dge slong gi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyis lha dzang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs shig lha khang de rnams kyi nang du tsardon sbrul gyi snying po dang / tsanan gor shi sha'i sku brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ tsardon sbrul gyi snying po ni 'og min na yod pas nga la len pa'i mthu med/ tsardon gor shi sha ma la ya'i byang phyogs na dug sbrul gdug pa can gyis 'khril yod pas/ ngas lan(len)mi nus/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pas chog zer ro/ /yang dge slong gi zhal nas/tsardon sbrul gyi snying po nga la rgyus yod pas len du 'gro dgos/ khyed kyis

81'khor g.yog lag cha dang bcas/ pa thong cig gsungs pas/ der rgyal po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa siṅga la'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram du byon pa dang / rdo'i kharma pa ṇi rang byon de'i sku rgyab na glang po che mang po nyal 'dug go /der dge slong gi zhal nas/ glang po che 'di rnams kyi nang nas kha shar du lta ba/sna dmar ba/ 'jing khung na gi wang gi zar bu yod pa 'di'i 'og na/ tsardon sbrul gyi snying po yod do gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ glang po che'i 'og tu tsardon 'ong ba ci lags zhus pas/ dge slong gi zhal nas/ dbyar tshad pas gdung ba'i dus su tsardon tha/ra yod rnams bsil ba yin zhing / tsardon gyi lo mas kyang tshad pa'i sdug bsnga(5 sel ba yin pas/ glang po ches tsardon gar yod ngo shes nas tshad pa byung tshe de'i steng du nyal ba yin gsungs so/ /der glang po che de rnams dkrogs narnga// /de'i 'og gi bye ma brkos pa dang / tsardon sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong po cig 'dug go /der yangadze rgyal po'i zhal nas/ mi'i yul na tsarnan sbrul gyi snying po mi 'ong ba la/ 'dir 'ong ba ci lags zhus pas/dge slong gi zhal nas/ sngozho sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su/ nyan thos dasnga/ bcom pa cig gis rdzu 'phrul gyis 'og min du byon nas/ tsardon sbrul gyi snying po'i gang bu cig blangs byon pas/ de'i nang na 'bru bzhi 'dug pa la/ 'bru gsum sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig la phul/'bru gcig jo bo kharla pa ṇi la phul nas dbu'i spyi gtsug tu bzhag pas/rlung gis bskyod de sku rgyab tu lhung / de sas non pa'i thog tu tshes bco lnga'i nub mo zhig /mkha' 'asngo/ ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi pho bas brlan nas myu gu byung / sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rterna du byon tshe me tog rgyas/ sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byozukyi tshe 'bras bu smin/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon nas sdong po chen por gyur yod pa las/ shākya thub pa mya

8lhangan las 'das tshe/ sdong po de 'gyel nas bye mas non pa yin gsungs so/ /der bye ma'i 'og nas sdong po de bton nas/ yal ga rnams bcad/ sdong po de la spub bzhir 'dug pa la/ de nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas nas/ slar sdong po de la thim pa dang / dal bus chod cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /der sdong po de tshal pa bzhir gshags pa'i nang na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhal bcu pa/ zhi zhal gsum/ khro zhal bdun/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las 'grub pa/ de'i steng na a mi de ba bzhugs pa/ rtsa phyag bcu po phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ 'od dang 'od zer phyogs7bcur 'phro ba cig byon no/ /tsarnan de la tshal pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas/ sku brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs te/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du bzhugs so/ /de nas yang tsardon gor shi sha len pa la/ dus skabs dang bsdun te gla rtsi bstan nas gor shi sha blangs/snga ma ltar byas so/ /de nas dge slong gis mchod rten pad+ma'i bum pa'i nang nas/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ring bsrel bre gang bsnams nas slar rgyas btab bo/ /de nas rgya mtsho'i gling la byon pa dang / 'jag ma re re'i steng na/sangs rgyas re bzhugs par gzigs nas/ 'jag ma phon cig kyang bsnams so/de nas chu bo rna rāji ra'i 'gram du byon pa dang / bye ma 'bru re'i steng na sangal rgyas re bzhugs par gzigs nas bye ma bre gang yang bsnams so/ /de ltar tsardon sbrul gyi snying po la byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ tsardon gor shi sha byang chub kyi ljon shing gi yal ga chu bo rna rāldi ra'i bye ma/ ku sha'i 'jag ma phon cing/ dben gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa la sogs te/ rgya gar gyi rdzas yi dam gyi lha la sogs pa dge slong gisarnaspyan drangs te/ bod du byon nas rgyal po la phul bas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas yang rgyal po'i thugs kyi

83dgongs pa la/ da rung sto bal gyi phyogs na/ sbas pa'i sprul sku/ phyi rabs sems can gyi don byed pa'i rten ngo mtshar can yod dgongs nas/ yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ rngeri nga byon de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer cig 'asbos te/ bal po'i yul du song ngo / /de la gtad nas gzigs pas/ rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams kyi nags khrod chen po cig na/ tsarnan ha ri'i sdong po 'odi zer phyogs bcur 'asbo ba cig slo rang byon mched bzhi byon par gzigs/ de nas yang sprul pa'i dge slong de rten de rnams spyan 'dren du btang ngo / /der dge slong gis mang yul gyi grong du byon pa na/ yul de na yams nad kyis mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong / de nas byon pa na/ grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal bya ba na/ mdze nad kyis mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong /de nas byon pa na rgya gar dang ba/la po'i mtshams na steng gdon cig gis glo bur du mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug ba:ci la mthong / de'i nags khrod na/ rdzi bo cig gis ma he mang po skyong gin 'du ga cipas/ ma lha las dang skal bar ldan pa zhig gis/ nyin mo'i rigs kyis nab/sa khrod der phyin nas/ tsardon ha ri'i sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba :ga 'dug pa la bskor ba byed cing nu ma gtor bas dgongs mo rji bo la/ ma he bdag pos na re/ khyod kyis nga'i ma lha'i 'o ma bzhos 'dug zer ba la/ rdzi bo na re/ ngas ni ma lha'i 'o ma bzhos pa med/ma lha ni nyin mo'i rigs la nags khrod ya gir 'gro yi'adug go ther ro/ /de'i sang rji bo dang / ma he'i bad/na po gnyis kyis 'grogs te/ nags khrod der bltar phyin pas/ ma lha de tsarjen ha ri'i sdong po 'od zerasgyuphyogs bcur 'asbo ba cig la skor ba bskor nas/ nu ma gtor gin 'dug pas ngo mtshar du byas so/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des rgyal po'i thugs dam tsardon gyi sku de las 'byon par mkhyen nas/ tsa/rdon de sta res bcad pa dang / sku bzhi las

84 gsung byung ste/ stod kyi de na re/ dal bus chod la nga mang yul gyi grong du zhog cig bya ba'i sgra thos/ de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa wa ti zhes bya ba cig byon no/ /de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal du zhog cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa dbu gang zhes bya ba cig byon no/ /de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams su zhog cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa lja ma li zhes bya ba cig byon no/ /de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i yi dam la 'gro'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de nas 'phags pa wa ti ni mang yul gyi grong du bzhugs/'phags pa dbu gang ni grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal du bzhugs/ 'phags pa lja ma li ni rgya bal gyi mtshams su bzhugs so/ /sku de gsum bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ grong tshan so so'i dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa gsum las thar ro/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des 'phags pa lo ke sha ra 'di da ltar po ta la'i rtse la bzhugs/ khaso pa ṇi spyan drangs te/ bod kyi yul du pheb nas chos gyel srong btsan sgam po la phul bas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes par gyur nas/ yi dam gyi lha dang mjal bas/ da ni sems can gyi don byed pa la tshegs med do dgongs so/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong a kar ma ti shrī la zhes bya ba de'ang / slar 'od du zhu nas/ rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim par gyur to/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi lha rgya gar dang / bal po'i yu9 nas spyan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //

ri — — /skyi//bye/bcu gnyis pa/ bal mo bza' khri btsun gad‘ na drangs pa'i skor/ de nas yang sprul pa'i rgya spru po de'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag gis kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gcig rgya gar na bzhugs/ gcig bal yul na bzhugs/ gcig rgya nag na bzhugs/ sku de gasru/ma gang na bzhugs pa'i yul der/ theg pa chen po'i chos dar yod pas/ sku de gsum gang rung cig ji ltar byas la gdan 'dren dgongs te/ tsardon gyi sku rang byon de la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis 9smuphros te/ gcig shar du song / gcig nub tu song / nuspu tu song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/ nub phyogs bal po'i yul na rgyal po de ba lha zhes pa la/ sras mo lha gcig khri btsun zhes pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ha ri tsan+dan gyi dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa cig bzhugs par gzigs/ de spyon drangs zu bcom ldan 'das dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos :/mal cad bod du gdan drangs par gzigs so//shar du song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/ shar phyogs rgya nag gi yul na/rgya rje tha'i dzung rgyal po bya ba la/ gras mo lha gcig kong jo bya ba/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chagab/ pa/ zhal nas skut+pal sngon po'i dri bro ba/

86rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa zhig bzhugs par gzigs so/ /de spyan drangs na bcom ldan 'das dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad bod du spyan drangs par gzigs so/ /de nas rgyal po de 'jig rten las khyad du 'phags shing / thugs sgom pas rmi lam du byung ba ltar mdzad de/ nang par blon po thams cad rgyal po'i drung du phyag byed du byung ste/ btsan po'i sku la bsnyung mi mnga' lags sam sku zo mdog legs la/ thugs bde ba dang ldan lags sam zhes mgrin gcig tu zhus pas/ shin tu'ang bde ba dang ldan te/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs nas bal rje'i sras mo bu mo mdzes ma cig dang / shar phyogs nas rgya rje'i sras mo bu mo mdzes ma cig dang / 'di gnyis nga'i khab tu byung ba rmis so gsungs pas/ blon po mgar na re/ rgyal po'i mnal lam du byung ba'i lha gcig de gnyis nged blon po rnams kyis spyan ci drangs byed pas/ mnal lam de gzhan la mi gsung bar zhu zhus so/ de nas blon po mgar na re/ nged rang phyi nang bar gsum gyi blon po/ gtso bo mi drug gi 'tshogs rten gyi zas chang /sha gzugs re dang bcas pa khyer la/ sang snga bar brag lha'i de'u thang la/ljon shing star ga sdong po'i rtsa rgyal po'i khri'i drung du 'tshogs shig ces smras so/ /de'i sang blon po gtso bo drug po 'tshogs pas/ 'tshogs rten gyi sha gzuḍa drug byung ba/ gnyis la rkang ba re/ gnyis la lag pa re/ gcig la brang so/gcig la dal mo rnams byung ba bsgrigs pas/ sha khog ma nyams pa cig byung ba dang / thon mi na re/ rten 'brel legs/ da lan gyi 'dun gros 'di la gros ma byas par blo mthun par byung bas/ gang bsam thams cad 'grub par 'dug /'dun ma rgya ma chung cig zer ro/ /mgar na re/ 'dun ma rgya mi chung bar byed do/ /nged rang tsho'i rje 'dis dgung lo bcu drug snabazhes/ gzhan du mi rung

87bas rgyal srid 'dzin pa la bal /sbyal na/ bal rje sras mo mdzes ma cig yod par 'dug pa de dang / rgya nab/ gi rgyal po la sras mo mdzes ma cig yod pa de gnyis 'dir btsun mo la spyan 'dren pa yin no zhes smras pas/ thams cad kyis legs so zhes kha mthun par byas so/ /de nas mgar gyis rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ snga sor bal yul gyi lha gcig de spyan 'dren pas/ bka' gnang bar zhu byas pas/ rgyal pos ga rtser gyi dong rtse lnga bskur nas/ 'dis zhu rten gyis shig gsung ngo / /rin po che beḍūr+ya'i rmog la/ pad+ma rā ga'i phra rgyab pa cig bskur nas/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du phul cig gsung ngo / /rgyal po des bka' lung mi 'dra ba gsucha/ btud mar gsungs 'ong gis/ de'i dus su 'di gsum ma nor bar re re bzhin du phul cig gsungs nas/ bka' shog gi sgrom bu gsum bskur/ 'phral gyi zas gos rgyan la sogs pa bskur te/ rta dang drel/ rnga mo la sogs kyi khal mang po brdzangs so/ /lam 'phrang gang du'ang / jo mo khro gnyer can la gsol ba 'debs kyin song zhig gsung ngo / /de nas blon po mgar gyis rje la phyag byas te/ rdzong dang yo byad rnams khyer/khal rnams ded nas/ blon po rta pa brgya tham pa bal yul du chas so / /der bal yul rin po che'i gling / grong khyer kho bom klu'i pho brang / rgyal po de ba lha bzhugs pa'i sgo drung du slebab/ so/ /der rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba btang ste mjal ba la/ gser gyi dong rtse lnga po zhu rten du phul/ rin po che be+ether+ya'i rmog la/ pad+ma rā ga'i phra btab pa de rgyal po'i drung du bzhag nas/ mgar na re/ rgyal po chen po/ rin po che baiḍūr+ya'i rmog 'di/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan te/ mi nad phyugs nang/ byung ba'i dus su rmog 'di gon nas grong khyer gyi mtha' bskor na mi nad phyugs nad thams cad chad/ sad ser byung dogs pa'i dus su 'di gon nas zhing rnams mtha' bskor na sad dang ser ba thub/ 'khrug

88 ri pa byed pa'i dus su 'di gon nas 'thab na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'jom bu'i gling na rmog 'di las lhag pa'i nor med pas/ gang(gong)thang dpyad kyis mi chod/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du 'bul lo/ /khyed kyi lha gcig mdzangal ma de/ nged bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo la bka' gnang bar zhu byas pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed bod kyi rgyal po de snying gdon gyis bslus sam/ sems 'khrul pa cig 'dug /nga ni sangs rgyas 'od srung nas ding sang phan chod la rgyal brgyurda ma chad pa yin/ khyod dang gnyen zla min te/ 'on kyang khyod sa thag ring nas sleb 'dug pa/ khyod rang gi yul du log la/ khyod kyi rgyal po de la/ chos dge ba bcu dang bsdun pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' nus sam mi nus dris shog de nus na lha gcig ster/ mi nus na mi ster gsung ngo / /—der mgar gyis bka' shog gi sgrom bu gsum yod pa'i dang po de/ rgyal po'i phyag tu phul bas/ de kha phyes nas gzigs pas/ mthing shog7la gser gyis bris pa/ bal po'i yi ge 'dug pa 'di ltar ro/ /khyed bal po'i rgyal po la dge ba bcu'i khrims yod/ nga bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/rgyal po khyod khrims yod pa la dga' nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi sprul pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i khrims snga dro gcig la 'cha' nus par byed do/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyod gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/grong khyer thams cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /rgyal po de skrag kyang mi skrag pa ltar byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po de kha tsho shin tu che bar 'dug khyod kyi yul na gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa yod dam med dris shog de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster gsung ngo / /yang mgar gyis bka' shog gi sgrom bu bar ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul

89nas/ rje gcig lags/ 'phrin re la bal bod kyi lam thag ring la yar 'gro mar 'gro byas na/ lha gcig gaḥkyi na drongs pa'i thabs med/ khyed kyi gsung de'i lan du/ bka' shog 'di ‘sprugs pa gzigs par zhu byas pas/ der rgyal pos gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ /khyed bal po'i rgyal po la gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa yod/ nga mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyod lha khang brtsig pa la dgak+ṣ-isgyu nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du bzhengs te/ sgo thams cad khyod kyi phyogs su bstan la bzhab/ go /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ sprul nga/'i dmag khri phrag lnga der btang nas/ khyod gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/ grong khyer thams cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /rgyal po skrag kyang mi skrag pa ltar byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal /sgo de kha tsho shin tu che ba cig 'dug ste/ khyod bod kyi yul na 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod rgyu yod dam med/ de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da nga)na song la dris la shog zer bas/ yang mgar gyil sgrom bu tha ma de rgyal po'i ṣ+ṭa/ga tu phul nas/ 'phrin re re la yul du log pa mi 'ong bas/ rgyal po khyed /) gsung de'i lan 'di lags pas gzigs par zhu byas pas/ der rgyal pos kha phyes nas gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ / khyed bal po'i rgyal po la longs spyod snathad/ nga bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyed tākyi ra longs spyod yod pa la dga' nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ rin po che/ gser/ dngul/dar zab gos dang rgyan/ bza'i btung la sogs kyi longs spyod dpag tu med pa byed cing / khyad par phyogs bzhi nas las sgo phye ste/ mtha'i nor thams cad nga'i sgo drung du 'ong zhing / longs spyod dang ldan par byed do/ /de ngo

90mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga der btang nas/ khyod gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/ grong khyer thams cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de'i thugs la rgyal po smra ba lan gcig yin pa/ de bzhin du bden srid snyam nas/ shin tu thuḍa ma bde bar lha gcig bod la brdzangs par dam bcas te/ zhal ngo nag par bzhugs pa dang /lha gcig na re/ yab ci nyes zhus pa dang / yabu rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod bod rgyal po'i btsun mo la 'gro dgos par 'dug gsungs pas/ lha gcig na re/ yul ngan pa chos dang longs spyod med pa pha ming dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring sa der mi 'gro zer bas/ yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod de skad ma zer 'gro dgos/ bod kyi rgyal po de sprul pa'i rgyal po mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan pa cig yod par 'dug ngas ji skad smras kyang / blon po des yul du ma phyin par yi ge'i lan yod gin 'dug pa khyod mi 'gro ba de shes nas/ sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga 'ong ste/ nga gsod/ khyod phrogs/ yul khams grong khyer thams cad 'joms par 'du7pas 'gro dgos gsungs so/ /der lha gcig gis bsam pa la/ nga rang gi yul 'di bzhag nas/ bod mtha' 'khob yul ngan pa/ chos med pa/ pha ming dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring po der 'gro dgos pa/ yab kyi bka' ni bcag tu med bsams nas/ lha gcig gis mchi ma bton ne+enas/ yab la 'di skad ces zhus so/ /kye ma yab gcig rgyal po chen po lags// kha ba can ni mtha' 'khob kla klo'i yul// dam chos ma dar bod yul mun pa'i gling //mi ni rigs ngan gdol pa sha za'i rigs//bkres shing dbul ba yi dwags rgyal khams 'dra//

91r+sha de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo 'gro dgos na//yab kyi mchod gnas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i lha//mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab//jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bdag la zhu//thub pa'i rgyal tshab byams mgon rin po che// mtshan dpes rab brgyan phan bde 'byung ba'i gter//byams pa chos kyi 9dikhor lo bdag la zhu// tsardon jo mo sgrol ska thugs rje can//'gal rkyen bar chod sel phyir bdag la zhu//rin chen stag sha je/ dang rat+na de//bod yul dbul ba sel phyir bdag la zhu// ririn chen 'dod da gu 'byung ba'i longs spyod dang //zas skom bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod pa'i gzhi// be+eḍūr+ya yi lhung bathed bdag la zhu//kha ba can ni bkremu/ shing skom pa'i gnas// rin chen bang mdzod mang po bdag la zhu//kha ba can ni bsi'/ zhing grang ba'i yul// tshe gcig dros pa'i gos kyang bdag la zhu//de ltar mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams der//bdag gi spyod lam bya ba ji ltar bya// yab gcig rgyal pos bdag la bka' stsol cig / ces gdung ba'i skad kyis mchi ma phyung nas zhus pas/ yab kyi(kyis)thugs kyi dkyil du brtse ba'i tshig phyung nas gsungs pa/ —

92nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod//bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul//ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul//bsil la mdzes7pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang //ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi//chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags spus mdzes//'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung //rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod//rgyal po lha yin 'khor rnams byang chub sems// dam chos med kyang rgyal po'i bka' khrims yod//de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song shig /bdag gi yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje dang //rje btsun byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo 'di//'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo nyi khri'i dus//rgya gar chos rgyal kṛ kṛ'i thugs dam du//rin chen sna tshogs 'dus pa'i phung po la//sangs rgyas 'od srungs dag gis rab gnas mdzad//sprul pa'i lha bzos lugs su thugs pa las// thog mar byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo bzhengs// de yi rjes la mi bskyod rdo rje ni// ngo mtshar dpag med mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras//phan bde'i 'byung gnas dad ldan rten du bzhengs//mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab//

93sa steng 'gran zla kyan dang bral ba 'di//ma 'ongs sems sgyu5na bsod nams bsag pa'i phyir//lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po de'i// dgung lo brgyad ཿ 'i tshad du lung bstan mdzad//de yi dus su 'od gyis 'jig rten khyab// lha rnams kun gyid+dha/ me rtog char pa phab de ltar yon tan skyo/na pa'i rten ma chog 'di//bdag gi mig gi gebras ltar gces na yang //mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//rje btsun byams nga/ chos kyi 'khor lo 'di//'gro kun dge la bkod phyir bdag gis brdzangs//tsardon jo mo sgrol ma rang byon 'di// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs bar du gcod pa rnams//nye bar zhi nas daḥn legs rgyas pa'i phyir// mdzes pa'i bu mo skyod la bdag gis brdzangs// rin chen stag sha /de dang rat+na de// dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel phyir khyod la bskur //rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i longs spyod gter//be+eḍūr+ya yi lhung ba da chen po 'di//zas skom bdud ciṇi'i char pa 'bebs pa dang //bkres skom sdug rnga sngal sel phyir khyod la bskur//rin chen gser dngul dar zab rgyan dang bcas//glang chen rnga mo drel dang bcas pa'i khal//

94 gzhan yang mkho ba'i yo byad zas gos rnams//gang la ci 'dod bu mo khyod la bskur//rigs bzang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i bu mo bcu//khyod kyi skyo grogs byed pa'i 'khor du brdzangs// e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod// gtam gyi rting ma yin no yid la chongs// kha ba can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang der// blon po bod 'bangs rnams dang 'grogs pa'i dus// khyod kyi spyod lam bya ba 'di bzhin gyis//gsungs te/ /'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bablab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la gnang sbyin dang / dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pa mjod do/ /jo bo dang byams mgon gnyis ni shing rta byas na lam bgrod par dka' bas/ /khal gyi steng du bzhugs par 'dod pa la/ gang gis kyang ma khyag nas/ sprul pa'i mdzo mo dkar mo gnyis kyis khyag par gyur nas/ jo bo dang / byams mgon gnyis mdzo mo re'i steng du bzhuṭa/rin po che'i khal du ma dang bcas/ lha gcig khri btsun kyang dre'u dkar mo cig la chibs/ mdzes ma'i bu mo bcu/ bod blon dang bcas pas bskor te bod du chas so/ /bal po'i blon po 'khor g.yog rnams kyis mang yul gyi grong bar du skyel thung byas so/ /brag dang chu 'thab pa'i 'phrang la khal rnams phog rin po che rnams phreng skyed byas/ lha rnams zhabs thang du byon kyang zer/ de nas drel dang / rnga mo/ glang po che sogs la khal bkal/ lha rnams rang rang gi khal la chibs nas byon te/ bod kyi yul du chag phebs so/ /der bod blon dang bod 'bangs rnams kyis rol mo du ma thogs te/ bsu ba rgya chen po pyis so/ /de

95nas rgyal pos dga' ston gyi gang/ na sar byon te/ lha gcig khri btsun dang mjal ba la mthong lugs gsum du byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis mdzad pa bcu ga nyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'arnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal po srong btsan sgam por sku sprul/ jo mo khro gnyer can bal mo bza' khri btsun du sku sprul nas/sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis skyems la gsol res byed pa dang / skudacipa 'khel res byed pa'i snang ba /rgyang ngo / /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa pho/ brang du bzhugs pa la/ rgya' po ni yi dam lha'i drung nas phyir mi 'byon par/ mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam 'debs so/ /der lha gcig khri btsun /gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ rgyal po 'di rigs gzugs dpal gyis mdzes shing // yon tan du ma dang ldan pa cig 'dug pa la/phyi rol du ye mi 'byon pa 'di/ mtha'i dmag la 'jig pa yin thag chod/ de la mi 'jig pa'i thabs cig byed dgos/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed la gsol ba btab na/ zas chang dzi pag tu med pa 'ong bas/ bod 'bangs rnams la byin nas las la bskul te/ mkhar las rgya chen po cig bya dgos bsams te/ der rgyal po la'ang zhus/ phyi nang gi blon po bka' la gtegs pa thams cad la'ang gros byas te/ be+eḍūru 'i lhung bzed zas sna mang pos bkang / rin po che'i khri la bzhag nas gsol ba btab pas/ zas chang ci 'dod pa byung ba dang / bod 'bangs rnams la byin nas/ shing mo lug gi lo la mkhar las kyi rmang 'ding / mtho dmazu/ gyi tshad la gyang skor sum cu brtsegs pas mtho zhing rgya che ste/ logs re la dra spyong grag re yod pa sgo mo che lho phyogs su bstan

96pa/ mkhar dmar po dgu brgya/ rtse mo rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang stong tham pa/mkhar thams cad kha bad rin po che'i rgyan/ mda' yab/ pu shu/ dril bucigayer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/ de'i bkod pa mdzes shing / legs pa'i dbang du byas na/ lha'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang 'dra ste/ blta bas chog mi shes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas brgyan te yid du 'ong ba'o/ /'jigs pa'i dbang du byas na/ srin po'i grong khyer laṅka pu ri dang 'dra bar mkhar thams cad kyi rtse la mtshon cha dang mdung dar dmar po bcu re phyar te dar yug gis sbrel ba'o/ /btsan pa'i dbang du byas na/ mtha'i dmag dpung byung yang / mi lngas bsrungs pas thub pa'o/ /gzhan yang rto phyogs kyi lcags ri la/ zabs su 'dom bcu'i dong brus nas/ de'i steng du spang leb bsgrigs/ de'i steng du so phag bsgrigs pas/ de'i steng du rta gcig gis rgyugs kyang / rta bcus lhan du rgyugs pa lta bu'i sgra 'ong ba'o/ /lho phyogs su so phag gi mkhar la dpe blangs nas/ brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yas khang bya ba/ khri btsun rang gi sku mkhar dgu thog yod pa cig brtsigs te/ mtha' gru che zhing mtho la legs pa/bkod pas mdzes pa cig brtsigs so/ /rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang / btsun mo'i sku mkhar gnyis kyi bar lcags zam gyis sbrel te/ de'i 'og na/ dar dang /rnga yab dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/ rgyal po yab yum phar gshegs tshur gshegs mdzad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i pho brang 'gran zla dang bral ba ngo mtshar che zhing mdzes pa cig legs par tshar nas/ rje blon kun gyis dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad do/ /bal mo bza' khri btsun gdan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // —

97bcu gsum pa/ rgya cho bza' kong jo gdan draphas pa'i skor/de nas yang blon po mgar gyis/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin te/ rgya nag gi lha gcig de'ang gdan 'dren pas bkasmi gnang bar zhu zhes zhus so/ /yang rgyal pos gser gyi dong rtse bdun bskur nas/ 'di la zhu rten gyis shig gsungs so/ /rin po che'i khrub la pad+ma rā ga'i phra brgyab pa cig bskur nas/'di lha gcig de'i rin du phul cig gsungs so/ /gser phye bre gang bskur nas 'di gar dgos su thong cib/ gsungs so/ /rgyal po de bka' lung mi 'dra ba lan gsum btud mar gsung du 'ong gis/ de'i dus su 'di gsum re re bzhin gtod cig gsungs nas/ bka' shog gi shog dril gsum bskur ro/ /'phral gyi yo byad gos dang rgyan la sogs pa/ rnga mo dang / drel la sogs pa la bkal ba'i khal mang po brdzangs so/ /nyirna mtshan dang lam 'phrang gang du'ang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs gin song cig gsungs so/ /de nas mgar gyis rgyal pos bskur ba thams cad khyer khal rnams ded/ blon po rta pa brgya dang lhan du me pho spre'u'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang 'dzom par rgya nag tu chas so/ /der rgya nag zim shing / bkra shis khri sgo/rgya rje tha'i dzung bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi sgo drung du slebs so/ /de na ni mi khyim 'asgam tsho tsam yod pa/ slogs re lgo nyin lam rne skyod pa sgo mo che bzhi yod

98 pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis sngangs zhing 'jigs pa cig 'dug go /der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya tham pa/ rgya mo kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rte pa brgya yang kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /bha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya yang kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ ci /mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i gnye bo rta pa lnga brgya rgya rje'i drang du dus gcig la slebs so/ /der rgya gar ba rnams shar sgo na yod/ ge sar ba rnams lho sgo na yod/ stag gzig pa rnams nub sgo na yod/ hor rnams byang sgo na yod/ bod blon rnams byang shar mtshams su bsdad do/ /der blon po gzhan ma rnams kyis zhu rten phul te mjal phrad byas so/ /bod blon rnams kyis mjal bar zhus pas/ sgug tu bcug zhag bdun song ba dang / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa pho brang gi phyi rol du byon ba la/ mgar gyis gser gyi dong rtse bdun po de/ zhu rten du phul/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i khrub la pad+ma rā ga'i phra brgyab pa rgyal po'i drung du bzhag ste/ mgar na re/ rgyal po chen po rin po che zaḍūr+ya'i khrub 'di/ yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ mibyund phyugs nad byung ba'i tshe khrub 'di gon nas grong khyer la bskor ba byagan nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ sad dang ber ba byung ba'i tshe 'di gon nas zhing bskor na/ sad dang ser ba thub/ 'khrug pa byed pa'i tshe 'di gon na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling na khrab 'di la gong thang dpyad pas mi chod/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du 'bul lo/ /khyed kyi lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ nged bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo la gnang bar zhu byas nga sa/ rgyal po des mgar la mig phur tshugs su gzigs nas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis mi 'os pa'i khrel gad chen pos bgad de/ rgyal po de'i zhal nas mi srid pa'i ga/tam shin tu mtshar

99che/ nga ni rgya nag spyi bo rgyal 1 4 nas deng sang phan rgyal brgyud ma chad pa cig yin/ khyod bod kyi rgyal pos ngaci 'i stobs dang mnga' thang gi dod mi pher te/'on kyang khyed rnams thag ring na sa phebs 'dug da lan phyir log la/ khyod rang gi rgyal po de la dge ba bcuji dang ldan pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' dzo.e nus dris la shog de nus na bu mo ster/ mi nus na mi ster gsungs pas/ blon po mgar na re/ 'phrin re re la/ rgya bod kyi bar la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas na/lha gcig spyan drangs pa'i thabs med/ khyed kyi gsung de'i lan du/ nged bod kyi rgyal pos 'di bskur ba lagamu/ zer nas/ shog dril dang po de rgyal po la phul bas/ rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigs pas/ mthing zhog la gser gyis bris pa/ rgya nag gi yi ge 'dug ste/ khyed rgya nag gi rgyal po la khrims yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la chos khrims med de/ rgyal po khyed dge ba bcu'i rgyal khrims yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ dge ba bcu'i khrims nyi ma gcig la 'cha' nus pa byed do//de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyed gsod/ lha gcig phrogos/ yul khams thams cad bcom la bzhag go zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur te/skrag kyang mi skrag pa ltar byas na/ / khyed bod kyi rgyal po de kha tsho shin tu che bar 'dug khyed bod kyi yul na gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa'i stobs yod dam med/ de bzhin yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da lan song la dris la shog gsungs pas/ yang mgar gyis bka' shog gi shog dril bar pa de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/ 'phrin re re la bod du 'gro ba mi 'ong bas/rgyal po khyed kyi gsung de'i lan 'di lags pas gzigs par zhu byas pa dang /rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigs pas 'di snar ro/ /khyed rgya nag gi yul na chos

10dzidar/ gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i stobs yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa med de/ rgyal po khyed gtsug lag khang brtsig pa la dgyes nas/ lha gcig ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs la/ sgo thams cad khyed kyi phyogs su bstan no/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyed gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/ yul khams thams cad bcom la bzhag gi ther ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /der skrag kyang mi skrag pa khad byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po de kha tsho shin tu che bar 'dug khyod kyi yul na 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod yod dam med/ de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da lan song la dris la shog zer bas/ yang mgar gyis shog dril tha ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/ 'phrin re la rgya bod bar la 'gro ba mi 'ong / rgyal po khyed kyi gsung de'i lan 'di lags pas gzigs par zhu zhes zhus pas/ der rgyal pos kha phyes nas gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ /khyed rgya nag gi rgyal po nor longs spyod yod/ nga phod kyi rgyal po la longs spyod de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyed nor longal spyod yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ gser dngul gyi longs spyod/ 'bru dang / dar zab dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / zas kyi longs spyod rnams lha'i longs spyod la 'gran nus pa tsam byed la/ gzhan yang phyogs bzhi nas las sgo re phyes nas/ khyed mtha'i nor rdzas thams cad kyang dbang med du nga'i sgo drung du 'du zhing / longs spyod dang ldan par byed do/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang lha gcig mi ster na/ ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/khyod gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/ yul khams thams cad bcom la bzhag gi

101bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de ཿ cir bas kyang skrag par gyur te/ rgyal po de'i thugs la nga'i bu mo 'di 'dod mkhan mang yang / phugs su bod kyi rgyal po 'di la ster dgos pa 'dra bsazu zhing / thugs ma bde bar pho brang du byon no/ /de nas yab rgyal po dang / yum btsun mo dang / sras rgyal bu dang /lha gcig rnams gros byas pas/ yab na re/ chos rgya gar nas byung ba yin/khong drin che bas rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po la ster gsungs so/ /yum ser sna che bas stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po la ster zer ro/ /rgyal bu lus rtsal bzang ba la dga' bas/ hor la ster zer ro/ /lha gcig rang skye gzugs legs pa la dga' bas/ mi tshe gyil por 'the/gas pa'i rten grogs gal che zer nas/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal po la mos pa byung ngo / /der bod la dga' ba gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed gnye 'o(bo)rnams la nye ring med/rig pa gang rno ba cig la ster nga/sa/ rig pa 'gran zer ro/ /rgyal po de'i bla g.yu bzhag sgor mo bya ba/ che chung ni phub chung tshad tsam pa/ bkrag che ba/mig gcig mtha' na yod pa/ mig gcig dkyil na yod pa/ nang gi mig kyang phug gi spa rim lta bur yod pa ཿdi dang / dar yug gcig blon po tshan lnga po la gtad nas/ g.yu 'di'i mig dropyi — dar yug 'di sus tshud pa la/ lha gcig ster zer ro/ /der blon po gzhan ཿ/ mas dbang che bas/ sngon la khong tshos g.yu khyer te/ thabs sna tshogs byas nas/ nyi ma mang po lag 'grim gyis brgyus pas/ sus kyang ma tshud nas/ blon po mgar la gtad de/ nged rnams kyis ni ji ltar byas kyang ma tshud/ khyed rang e tshud stos shig zer nas/ g.yu dar yug dang bcas pa gtad do/ /der mgar rig pa can des/ sngar nas rgya'i grog ma gcig zan dang 'o mas gso ga te/ mtheb mo tsam du song ba dang / de'i sked pa la dar skud btags te/ dar yug gi spyi bo bsdus nas btsem ste/

102 grog ma de g.yu mig tu bahūṃd do/ /dar g.yu de lag tu blangs nas phu btab pas/ rlung gis ded nas/ mtha'i migi tu thon byung ngo / /de nas grog ma'i rked pa nas dar skud dkrol te/ nur gyis 'then pas/ g.yu mig tu dar yug tshud do/ /nged kyis 'di bzhin thong yod pas/ lha gcig zhu byas pas/da rung rig pa 'gran no zer nas/ bod la brnyas pa byas ma byin no/ /yang de'i sang lug lnga brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams sang gi nyi ma la bsad zin pa/bshas zin pa/ sha zos zin pa/ pags pa mnyes zin pa la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /der bod blon rnams kyis mi res lug re bsad/ so sor bshas/sha logs shig tu spungs/ pags pa logs shig tu spungs te/ sha snang mo tsam re tsha la bsgres shing sgrin la skyur te/ zar bcug pas/ zos zin to/ /pags pa rnams gral mgo nas phur ba re byas btang bas/ gral gzhug tu snum 'jug ran par byung / yang 'og ma des snum byug ste phur ba re byas pas gral 'gor thul lo/ /gzhan ma rnams la bltas pas gang yang ma zin par 'dug go/ /nged kyis 'di bzhin byung yod/ gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pa/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas ma byin no/ /yang chang ben brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams sang gi nyi ma phyed tshun la 'thung zin pa/ ma bo ba/ma bzi ba su byung ba la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang mgar gyis bod blon rnams la sgod chung chung re btsug /nyung re drangs te/ thog mar hub re 'thung cig byas pas/ 'thung zin pa/ ma bo ba/ ma bzi ba byung nas/ gzhan rnams la bltas pas/ phor pa chen po chang gis bkang ste/ 'thung ma zin dogs nas khrog rgyab pas/ bzi zhing skyugs te bo 'dug go/ /yang nged kyis 'di bzhin byung yod/ gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pas/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas/ bod la brnyas pa byas ma byin no//

103yang rta ma brgya/ bu brgya gtang/ nas/ 'di tsho ma bu phyogs gcig tu ngo shes pa la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes/ mgar gyis rta ma bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bzung nas zhag gcig tu rtswa byin cing chu ma byin no/ /de'ijisang rte'u rnams kyi khrod du btang bas/ rang rang gi ma gang 'dug rtsa nas 'o ma 'thungs so/ —/der ngo shes/ nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan rnams kyis ma shes pas/ lha gcig zhu 'o byas pas / da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas ma byin no/ /yang de'i sang bya ma brgya bu brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams ma bu phyogs gcig tu su(sus)ngo shes pa la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes/ mgar gyis thang yangs /ṭ+wāṃg la/ sbang ma gtor nas bzhag ste/ der bya rnams kha gtad do/ /de ga stes gnyis lhan du zos so/ /ske'i 'og nas za zhing spyod pa 'tshub pa 'di rnamaru/ bu yin/ de min rnams ma yin no byas pas ngo shes/ nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan gyis ma shes pas/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran ze nga nas ma byin no/ /yang gsam gyi shing sdum po brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams kyi mgo gzhug sus shes pa la ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes so/ /mgar gyis shing de rnams chu 'gram du khyer nas chu la bskyur bas/ rtsa ba lji ba/ga thur du song / rtse mo yang bas gyen du lus si/ /nged kyis ngo shes/ gzha 5 gyis ma shes pas/ lha gcig zhu byas pas/da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas zu byin no/ /der dgongs(dgong)cig pho brang nas rnga bo che brdung ba dang / blon po gzhan rnams pho brang du song / bod blon rnams kyi gnas mo de na re/ blon po gzhan rnams pho brang du song / khyed catho tsho yang mi 'gro'am / phyin pa legs so zer bas/ mgar na re/ nged la shog kyang mi zer/ rnga de ci yizu/ cha med byas tres gnas mo na re/ blon po gzhan rnams song ba na/ khyed r+sā/ shog mi me+erdo kung / 'ugro g.yin mod zer ro//

104 — der blon pos rnga de la skyon can durtego nas blon po rnams khrid/ sgortere re bzhin 'dren gin/ sgo la rams dang tshos kyi khu bas mtshan ma 'debs gin pho brang du phyin no/ /pho brang na blon po gzhan rnams 'tshogs 'dug go/ /der rgya 2 pos/ de dgongs(dgong)blon po thams cadartel ston mo cig byas nas/srod kyi mun nag la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed rang blon po thams cad phyir song la/ rang rang gi khang pa rnyed pa gyis shig /de sus rnyed pa la bu mo ster gsungs so/ /der mgar gyis pho brang nas mar me g.yar te/ sgo re re bzhin dren gin/ sngar gyis (gyi)mtshan ma rnams blta'i phyin pas/ rang gi khang pa rnyed do/ /sang nam langs pa dang / blon po gzhan rnams bltar phyin pas/la la gzhan gyi khyim du tshud/ la las sgo ma rnyed nas rgya srang na nyal 'du—ga go/ /yang mgar gyis nged kyi khang pa rnyed/ gzhan rnams kyis ma rnyed par 'dug lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin shar sgo'i thang la/ bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya rgyan gyis brgyan nas gral byed/ de'i khrod du lha gcig 'jog pas/ de ngo su(sus)shes pa la bskur ba yin gsungs so/ /de nas mgar gyis gnas mo de dang lus 'brel shing mthun par byas/ zas chang gis mgo bskor te dgo' ba'i gtam smras nas/ nged blon po rnams kyis rgya nag tu sleb nas lo gcig 'gro/ rig pa de nged rno/ lha gcig 'di nged kyis thob pa la brnyas pa byas ma byin/ lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo 'di ma mthong ba la sgra che ba g.yu 'brug sngon mo dang 'dra ba cig 'dug lha gcig de dang khyod gnyis shin tu mthun par yod 'dug pas/ khyod kyis ci 'dra cig legs par ston dgos/ da ni shin tu gal che bar yod do/ /da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin kong jo bu mo sum brgya'i dkyil du gral bsgrigs nas/ shar sgo'i thang la 'jog pas su(sur)thob pa la ster ba yin gsungs te/ blon po

105gzhan rnamasatsho dbang che bas sngozu/ la khong tshos 'dom du 'ong / khong tsho gang rung gis ngo shes nas khyerabyulas che/ snged la thob par dka'/ gal te khong tshos ngo ma shes par 'dug nas/ nged kyis ngo shes na'ang / brnyas pa byas mi bskur las che/ gzhan yang las kyi dbang gis thob kyang / ci 'dra cig yod ma shes pas/ khyod kyis legs par ston dgos/ ngas khyod rang gi khyo byas la 'dir sdod/ lha gcig blon po gzhan ma rnams la bskur bas chog byas nas/gser phye bre gang po de brngan pa la byin no/ /der gnas mo na re/ khyed bod blon rnams bden/ rgyal pos spre ring ches/ rgyal po gcig po min te/ khyed bod la dga' ba mi gcig kyang mi 'dug bod yi dwags kyi rgyal khams yin zer gyi 'dug lha gcig 'di blon po gzhan rnams kyis thob tu re 'dug cing / khong tsho rig pa lan gcig rno /mang ster bar 'dug lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo 'di/ nga'i dpon mo yin pas rgyus nga che ste/ rgya nag rtsis la mkhas pas/ rirtsis kyis ngo shes na/ nga gso/da 'ong bas/ ngas 'chad mi nus zer ro/ /der mgar na re/ rtsis kyis ngo mi shes pa'i thabs nga la yod zer nas/ khyim gyi nang du sgo bsdoms te/ skyed respro chen po gsum btsugs/ de'i steng du zangs chen po chus bkang ba gcig ji/zhag chu de'i steng du bya sna tshogs kyi spu gtor/phub dmar po cig gis kha bca da/ de'i steng du gnas mo bzhag gnas mo'i mgo la rdza ma g.yogs/ rdza ca/'i mgo la dra bas g.yogs/ rdza ma la bug pa phug bug pa dang dra mig gi zu/ nga du zangs dung bcug nas/ 'di nas tshur bshad pas rtsi sa kyis zin kyang yid ches mi 'byung bas/ khyod kyis legs par shod cig byas so/ /der gan sa mo na re/ blon po chen po legs par yid la zungs shig / dzelha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de3/ —
