106 bu mo gzhan pas che rgyu merdo//skye gzugs gzhan pas legs rgyu med//rgyan gos gzhan pas bzang rgyu med/de la mo yi khyad chos ni//sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa cig yod/ zhal nas ut+pal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ lus dri zhim pas g.yu'i sbrang ma gcig 'khor gin yod/ mkhur tshos g.yas pa'i steng na cho lo ris/ g.yon pa'i steng na pad+ma ris/ dpral ba'i dkyil na sisnu ra'i thig le'i steng na/ ār+ya tā ra nas tsam cig yod/ so la so zho yod/ og ma la og zho yod/ lha gcig kong jo de/ bu mo sum brgya bsgrigs pa'i tha mar yang mi 'ong / dkyil du yang mi 'ong / rgeyon dral (gral)nas bsgrigs pa'i drug gi gong du 'ong / lha gcig de lus dang gos la gya bsrung ste/ lus dang gos la reg sa med pas/ mda' gsar pa cig la dar le brgan khagang thogs la/ lha gcig gi rtsar sleb pa dang / mos dar gos sham bu lnga brtsegs steng na dri ma lcam me ba cig gon yod pas/ de'i gong ba nas mda'i stong gis bzung la 'then cig zer ro/ /der mgar gyis/ chas de rnams bshig lus sems dga' bdes khyab par gyur ṅkas/ nged bong blon rnams sngon chad kyang mgo thon/ da rung mgo thon pa cig dgos so/ / nged tshos rgya nag tu tshong la 'ongs pa yang mirtsa no/ /bshes gnyen skyong du 'ong ba yang min no/ /lha gcig 'di spyan drongs na/ nged rna mas mgo thon pa yin pas/ brtag pa legs po byed dgos so/ /da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin bu mo sum brgya'i dkyil nas/ sus ngo shes pa la ster bar thag chod 'dug pas/spyang glen ma nor ba cig byed dgos zer ro/ /de nas zhag gsum gyi nyin par bu mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa sum bgrergya shar sgogyithang la bsgrigs so/ /rgya nag gi

107mi thacha/sa cad ltad mo la 'tshogs/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po rnams sngar gyi go rim bzhin bdoms shig gsung ngo / /der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ gral gyi dkyil nas bu mo chas bzang zhing mdzes pa gnyil khrid nas gcig min kyang gcig yin te 'ong zer nas/ 'u sgra dang bso sgra 'debs kyin song ngo / /de'i rjes la stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ sdo/ mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas sngar ltar byas nas song ngo / /de'i rjes la ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nab// snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo / /de'i rjes la bha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas snga ma ltar byal nas song ngo / /der blon po mgar gyis bltas pas/ de rnams thams cad min par shes te/ rab tu dga' nas 'dzum mul gyis shor ro/ /der mgar gyis mda' de lag tu khyer/ bod blon rnams khrid de/ g.yon gral du gtad phyin nas/ gral gyi mtha' ma'i bu mo de la/ mgar na re/'di ni bshan spre/'i bu mo 'dra//lag pa 'di yi dmar lugs sam//de yi gong na 'dug pa de//rdza mkhan cig :/ bu mo 'dra//lag pa'i ser /gyu mang lugs sam//de yi gong na 'dug pa de//shing mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra//gos log 'di /) skya lugs sam// de yi gong na 'dug pa de//khrub mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra//

108 steng gos 'di yi sgum lugs sam//de yi gong na 'dug pa de//phyis mkhan cig gi bu mo 'dra// 'breng bu 'di yi mang lugs sam//de yi gong na 'dug pa de//mgar ba cig gi bu mo 'dra//gos kyi thu ba'i nag lugs sam//de yi gong na 'dug pa de//dar 'thag bu mo yin pa 'dra//dar zab lus la gon lugs sam// de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /lha gcig kong jo yin pa 'dra//sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags//zhal nas ut+pal sngon po mnam//dri zhim g.yu yi sbrang ma 'khor// mkhur tshos cho lo pad+ma ris//dbral ba rje btsun sgrol mas mtshan//so tshags dam zhing so zho can// 'phrul chen bu mo gzhan bas mdzes//zhes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brjod nas/ lha gcig gi gos kyi gong ba nas/mda'i ltong gis bzung nas 'then pas/ lha gcig ngu zhing blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /der lha gcig bshum pa la/ blon po mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs te/ thon mi saspyoṭa dang / 'bri se ru gong ston gnyis

109kyis ram bu bteg nas 'di ske/da do//e ma ngo mtshar che//lha gcig kong tsheju khyed// bdag gi chig kha gson//bkra shis nyams su dga'//bod kyi rgyal khazusprus na// rin chen lnga lasna5 grub//rgyal po'i pho bra/pa na// mi rje lha yis ca/dzad//srong btsan sgam po de//rigs gzugs dbal(dpal)gyis bajid//mthong na sems yid 'phrog/thugs rje chen sdo lags//rgyal srid chos /spruzhin bskyangs//— 'bangs rnams bka' la nyan//rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams//dga' skyid glu ju len//chos kyi nyi ma tsa/ra// dpal gyi sgron the bteg/ri la shing sna zu nga //sa gzhi yangs pa la /'bru sna lnga yi zu:gas// go mtshams meḥkyi par skyes//

110gser dngul zangs lcags sogs//rin chen du ma yod// gnag rta lug gsum rgyas//dga' skyid de ltar yod//e ma ngo mtshar che//lha gcig kong jo gson//zhes glu blangs pas/ —lha gcig gi bsam pa la/ de ltar bden na nga rang gi yul dang 'dra ba ra 'dug bsams nas/ mchi ma phyis te/ blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /blon pos rta la bskyon te/ khrom bskor nas/ rgya hor gnyis las lhag pa nged bod yin/ lha gcig nged kyis spyan 'dren pa yin pas/thams cad khar mdzub mo chug la sdod byas so/ — /der rgya nag gi mi rnams kyis smre sngags bton te/ nged kyi lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ bod ngan pas khyer zer ro/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas blon po gzhan rnams la'ang / khyed rnams kyang nged rgya nag pa'i gnyen zla yin pas/ khyed rang tshos 'doms pa'i bu mo rnams khrid la/ so so'i yul la song shig gsung ngo / /der blon po mgar gyis lha gcig la/ da ni bod du 'gro thabs gyis shig byas nas btang ngo / /der lha gcig gil pho brang du phyin pas/ yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ lha gcig na re/ chos med pa/yul ngan pa/ pha ming dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring der nga mi 'gro zer/ yab kyi zhal nas/ khyod de skad ma zer 'gro dgos/ bod kyi rgyal po de mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs dang ldan pa cig yod par 'dug /ngas ji skad smras kyang / khos bod yul du ma phyin par/ lan yi ge'i nang du 'ong gin 'dugakhyod mi 'gro ba khong gis shes nas/ dmag khri phrag lnga tsam 'dir byung nas/

1two1nga bsad/ khyod khyer/ yul cha/khar thams cad bcom na ji tshug byed/ blon rngo de'i byed lugs la stos dang / de bas phyin pa legs so gsungs pas/der lha gcig gis yab la phyag 'tshal te gsol ba/yab gcig rgyal pos bka' gnang ngam//a ma yum gyis ཿnanang lags sam//jo jo ming pos tshig shor ram//ye ma mi srid ngo mtshar che//bod kyi yul der bdag gtong na// kha ba can gyi yu9 phyogs der//bsil zhing grang la sa rong rtsub/ lha klu 'dre srin /gdug pa mang //gangs ri gcan gzan mche ba 'dra//brag ri 'brong gi rwa dang 'dra// nyams mi dga' zhing blo mi bde// tsho 'bru sna mi 'khrung la mu ge'i gnas//gdol pa sha zan srin po'i rigs༈/ spyod pa rtsing ba tā/ klo'i mi// mtha' 'khob saḥspras rgyas zhabs ma bcags//chos med ma rib/ mun pa'i gling // mchod pa'i rterna dang gnas med cing //bsod nams ba treg pa'i rten med pas// —de 'dra'i yul du 'gro dgos na// yab kyi mchod ga/nas yi dme lha/rte d+ngha ri byā rngo

112 shākya mu ne+e bdag la zhu// kha ba can ni bkres pa'i yul// rin chen bang mdzod bdag la zhu// kha ba can ni bsil la grang // tshe gcig dros pa'i gos cig zhu//bod ni gdol ba gtsang btsog med// g.yog mo'i skyo grogs bdag la zhu//de ltar mtha' 'khob yul phyogs der//bod kyi mi dang 'grogs pa'i dus// bdag gis spyod lam ji ltar bya//zhes mchi ma phyis nas zhus pas/ yab kyis thugs brtse ba'i bka' gnang ba/nga yi mig dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod//bod —ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul//yul las khyad par 'phags pa de yin te//gangs ri rang bzhin mchod rten grub pa'i gnas// cimatsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkramabyupa 'dra//ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling //bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang //chu bo bzhi 'bab shing rtsi nags kyis mdzes//'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung //rkang bzhis kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod//de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog der//rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i pho brang na//

— 113mi rje lha yis ma:ri da pa'i rgyal po de//'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos su 'dug/thabs mkhas thub/sa rje ldan pa'i rgyal po yin//— mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu'i khrims la gnas// mnga' thang dpa'/ 'byor 'dod dgu'i dpal la spyod//yon tan mtha' sprus rgyal po lha yi sras/ dpa' mdzangs //na 'dzom 'khor rnams byang chub sems//de 'dra'i gnas rgya bu mo khyod song shig/mdzes ma khyod kyi bsod nams bsags ba'i rten//bdag gi mchod gnas ston pa'i sku gzugs 'di//yon bdag lha dbang brgya byin khong gis mdzad// rgyu ni rin chen ཿ/ ma pa bcu las grub//'di yi bzo bo bai shā karmas mdzad//rab gnas sang rgyas nyid kyis mdzad pa lags//de ltar 'gran med rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di//mthong thos dran reg gsol ba btab gyur pas//sangs rgyas myur ju thob par rgyal bas gsungs//de ltar phan bde 'byung ba'i jo bo 'di//bdag gi snying dang 'dra bar phongs na yang //mdzes pa'i bu smyo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//rin chen bang ma/dzod mang po nor gyi gter//bdag la gces pa'i rin chen mang po yang //mdzes ma'i bu snasgo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//

114gsere g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshang chen mo dang //gtsug lag yi ge sum brgya drug cu dang //gser g.yu rgyan gyi rnam pa mang po yang //mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gil brdzangs// g.yos sna zas kyi rnam pa mang po ding //btung ba skom gyi sbyor thabs mang po dang //gser sga g.yu yi ka leb can la sogs//mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//za 'og stan thul seng ge bya brgyad ma//ljon shing cho lo nor bu ris su bris//rgyal po ngo mtshar skye phyir khyod la brdzangs//rgya yi gab tse gtsug lag sum brgya po//legs nyes ston pa'i las kyi me long yang /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//bkod pa'i rig byed mdzes par byed pa yi//yid 'ong rgyan gyi khyad par 'phags pa dang //bsgowaṃ rig byed drug cu tham pa yang //mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman//brtag thabs brgya dang dpyad lnga sbyad(spyad)drug dang //sbyor risde bzhi la sogs pa bdag gis bskur//tshe gcig dros pa'i dar gos za 'og sogs//kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa'i rgyan gos kyang //

115stong phrag nyi shu bu/ mo khyod la brdzangs//sdegs gzugs lta/ na sdug cing mdzes pa yi//bems mthun skyo grogs byed pa'i bu mo yang //nyi shu rtsa lnga khyod kyi 'khor du bajings //e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod//brtse ba'i snying gtam yin pas sems la zhog/kha ba can gyi mi dzo dims 'dul don du//khyod kyis bya ba :/da lam 'di bzhin gyis// lta ba yangs shing spyod lam zhib bar mdzod/phyi nang bya ba kuzho la mkhas par mdzod//ngag 'jam smra mkhas gzhi ma legs par mdzod// — rje la gus shing ‘sgyukhor la byams par mdzod// khrel yod ngo tsha bag dang ldan par mdzod//ces pa la sogs pa 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /yab kyis ba/ga nas 'jus shingardzo'abral mi phod pa ltar yod na yang / bod du 'gro dgos par dgongs te/ lha gcig la rdzong bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ / de nas lha gcig g.yog mo de dang 'grogs te/ blon po mgar gyi rtsar byung nas/ blon po chen po khyed kyi yul du jo be+e shākya yang gdan 'dren/ nor dpag tu med pa'ang khyer nas khyed kyi yul du 'gro/ khyed kyi yul na sa kham pa yod dam/ rdo srin zan yod dam/ shing se ba yod dam/ rtsa dred ma yod dam/ yung ma yojikyi dam/ zor ba la/ mgar na re/ gzha na rnams yod/ nyung ma med byas nas/ la nyung gi sa bon khyer/ de nas shing rta'i 'khor lo byas/ de'i steng du jo 4 shākya bsgyesgos/ 'khor lo de rgya nag na

— 116 stobs che ba'i gyad lha dga' dang / klu dga' gnyis la 'dren du bcug go//gzhan yang rin po che dang / dar dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / 'phral gyi yo byad rnams bkal ba'i rta dang / dre'u rnga mo la sogs pa mang po brdzangs so/ /bod blon rnams la'ang ston mo gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /der lha gcig kong jo yang rin po che'i rgyan mang pos brgyan nas/ mdzes pa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi rta la chibs nas/ yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas skyel thung byas/ yab yum gnyis kyi thugs la 'phreng bzhin du/ 'jig rten mi chos la phan pa'i bslab bya gal che ba dpag tu med pa mdzad nas bod du chas so/ /der skyel thung la byon pa'i gral la/ blon po 'bri se ru gong ston zer ba des/ blon po mgar la phrag dog byas nas/ 'dir lha gcig gi tshab tu/ blon po rig pa can cig bsdad na/ rgya bod gnyis mthun 'ong zer nas/ blon po mgar la mig cer te bltas pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ khyed bod kyis thob pas nga la mi tshab tu mgar sdod dgos gsungs so/ /der blon po mgar gyis kyang / se ru gong ston gyis phrag dog byas par go nas/ rgya bod gnyis mthun pa ngas byed do zer nas sdod par byas so/ /der mgar gyis thon mi dang nyang gnyis zur du khrid nas/ nga rgya nag tu zla ba lnga las mi sdod/ de'i bar ngan 'khyol tshad skyel/ khyed rnams kyis rdzus ma'i spang po cig nga'i rtsar thong byas so/ /der blon po thams cad jo bo dang lha gcig la bskor te bod du song ngo / /der rgya nag tu mgar gcig pur lus te/ rgyal pos mgar la bud med cig blangs/ gzhi ma rab cig phog nas bzhag go/ /de nas mgar yang shin tu skyo zhing / blo ma bde bar gyur nas bud med de'i rtsar ma phyin/sto yang ma zos te/ lus sngo la rid par byas/ mal 'og tu ko ba rul pa

tsho117bzhag nas/ lus la dri mi zhim pa yod pa byas/ 'gram pa g.yas su mtshal bcug g.yon du rams bcub/ nas/ mal gyi snyi rol rnag khrug gi lud pas bkang ste bzhag go/ / der chung ma rgya mo de na re/ blon po chen po khyed kyi lus la dri mi zhim pa yang sdom gyin 'dug mdog kyang sngo bar 'dug pa ci nyes zer ro/ /blon po na re/ nga la tshad pa'i nad byung ba khyod kyis ma tshor ram zer bas/ der mos rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po yang thugs ma bde bar/ blon po'i rtsar byon te/ blon po chen po ci byung gsungs pas/ blon po na re/ bdag tshad pa'i na/da kyis thebs gda'acalags zer nas ludar+ṣapa cig bskyur bas rnag khrug gi mdog ri 5 'dug lus kyi dri mi zhim pa yang tshor te/rgyal po'i zhal nas/ sang sman pa mkhas pa cig yod pa khrid la 'ong cig gsungs nas bzhud do/ /de’ri chung ma rgya mo de la/ blon po na re/ khyod bud med grib che/ sang sman pa byung tsa na/ nga'i rtsa mi rtogs pas/ khyed rang khyim tsher(mtshes)gyi gan du nyol bar song cig byas nas gtong ngo / /de'i shul du/ blon pos sa phag gi /sgo mthon po cig brtsigs nas/ gdung ma la thi gu btaṭa/ pho mtshan thi gus bcings te/ spyi bo sa la btsugs nas rtsa thams cad 'khrug tu bcug go/ /de/re sang rgyal pos sman pa khrid byung ste/ sman pa mkhas pa des rtsa bltas pas/ sman pa na re/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad 'khrugs par gyur pas na brtag par dam/'a sto/ rlung las gyur pa yang ma yin/ mkhris pa las gyur pa yang ma yin/ rngasnad kan kyang ma yin/ 'dus pa'ang min te/byis pa'i gdon chen bco brgya5rdo kyi nad kyang ma yin/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i nad kyang ma yin te/ 'byung po'i gdon gyi nad kyang ma yin/ sems ma bde ba snying gi dkyil du phob/ pa'i gcong cig 'dra te/ sman dpyad rim gro gang gis kyang phan par dka' zer ro/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ sman pa

118de la sang gnang lan re shog la stos shig gsungs so/ /yang sang sman pa byung dus/ blon pos mchan du zhim bu bcug /de'i lag pa la thi gu btags/thig sna la rtsa bltar bcug pas/ gcan gzan tha ma cig gi rtsa las mi 'dug zer te song ngo / /yang blon pos/ de'i sang bya pho cig mchan du bcug nas/de'i lag pa la thi gu btags/ thig sna la rtsa bltar bcug pas/ 'dab chags tha ma cig gi rtsa las mi 'dug zer ro/ /de nas rgyal po yang thugs shin tu ma bde bar/ blon po chen po khyed rang rig pa can yin pas thabs e yod/ de'i thabs gang 'grub byed gsungs pas/ blon po'i bsam pa la/ da ni glags rnyed par 'dug bsams nas/ rgyal po chen po nga'i nad 'di khyed kyis nga bzung bas/ bod kyi lha grungs ma dga' ba yin/ nga bod kyi ri mthong ba'i ri mtho ba cig gi khar phyin nas lha gsol na phan/ de'i rdzas la/ dar zab bsregs pa'i thal ba rkyal pa gang / lug bsad pa'i mcher pa'i khrug grod pa gang / sol ba'i mdung shing gas chag med pa 'dom gsum/ rta mog ro mgo dmar cig rnams dgos/ de rnams ni rnyed par dka' ste mi 'dzom/rgyal po yang gsan par dka'/ lar deng nga 'chi las che/ shi bas mi skyog par nga'i rjes su lcas ngan pa bco brgyad 'ong / rgya bod gnyim 'brel chad/ bod kyi rgyal po la mngon shes yod pas nga shi ba mkhyen nas/ dmag btang nas rgya yul thams cad phung bar 'ong / sa thag ring sa 'dir sleb/ grogs blon po rnams kyis bskyur/ lus la nad kyis thebs/ nga rang rgo rgyal po dang / nye du mdza' bshes rnams yid la dran kyang bya thabs med par song /rang ga nor rdzas bza' btung longs spyod kyis phan par dka' ste/ tshe 'odi yang rmi lam lta bur 'dug go zer nas/ mgo hril gyis gtum nas nyal song ngo / /der rgyal po yang shin tu skrag par gyur nas/ khyed la phan pa'i thabs

119gang 'grub byed/ stod de nyo ge cig gsungs nas bzhud do/ der rgyal pos nags thams cad la me brgyab nga/sa/ sol ba'i mdung shing kyang ma byung / dar zab thams cad bsregs pas/ thal ba rkyal pa phyed kyang ma byung / lug thams cad bsad pas mcher khrug phor pa phyed kyang ma byung / rta mog ro mgo dmar de rnyed do/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rdzas gzhan rnams ni ma rnyed/rta mog ro mgo dmar de rnyed tse/da do gsungs pas/ blon po na re/ rdzas gzhan rnams ma rnyed na thabs rnga/da/ rta mog ro mgo dmar la nga'i ro rta gyis la nga bskyon/ rgya yul na bzang ba'i rta cig la nga'i ro zas dang / ro gos bkal nas bod kyi ri mthong b.ri sar lha gsol du 'gro'o zer ro/ /der lha gsol bar 'gro ba'i grab(grabs)byed gin yod tsa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/blon po chen po nam zla dpyid rka/ra song / so nam byed ran pas ji ltar byas na legs/ khyod rig pa can yin pa sa ston cig gsungs so/ /der blon po na re/ nga'i bod yul na sa bon thams cad slang nga'i nang du ser tsam brngos nas btab pas/ lo tshan che ba/ gzugs ring ba/ zla ba gsum song dus smin 'ong zer bas/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bod kyi lugs su gyis shig gsungs nas/ khrims kyi rnga bo che brdungs te/ thams cad kyis nas brngos nas yos zhing la btab bo/ /der blon 2/sa rang gi lus gud pa de sos/ lha gsol bar 'gro ba'i grabs byed gin yod dus/ bod blon rnams kyis rdzus ma'i sprang po cig btang byung ngo / /der blo rna pos log pa'i skud byas te/ thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes mi bya'o/ / kha rog sdod la ku co thong // nag mo lcags mkhar thug nas yod// lung pa phu bathub/ mda' brdugs shā//

120 thu ru co brags khong la zhog/ dar dkar dril la dar nag bskyod// zla bas nyi ma'i rtsa ru sleb/zer nas/ der sprang po de log go/ sprang po des khong rnams la bshad pas ma go bar/ rgya mo kong jos go nas 'di skad zer te/ blon po des rgya nag tu ngan chen po byas yod par 'dug thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes ma byed zer ba de/ khong rang rgya bo sma ra can la lab ma shod bya ba yin/ da len kha rog sdod la/ bod blon rnams la shod bya ba yin/ nag mo lcags mkhar thug nas yod zer ba de/ sa bon yos su brngos nas 'debs bcug bya ba yin/lung pa phu brdugs mda' brdugs su/ /thu ru co brags khong la zhog bya ba de/dong par mda' mang po chug bya ba yin/ dar dkar dril la dar nag bskyod bya ba de/ nyin mo bsdad gin mtshan mo 'ong zer ba yin/ zla bas nyi ma'i rtsar sleb zer ba de/ ngas khyed rnams kyi rtsar mgyogs par sleb bya ba yin zer ro/ /der blon bo mgar bod kyi ri mgo mthong ba'i sar lha gsol du 'gro ba'i chas la rta mog ro mgo dmar la zhon/ rta gzhan zhig la rgyags dang gos bkal/ sha skam la tshwa chu byugs pa mang po khyer/ rgyal po'i(pos)blon po bod du bros dogs nas/ gyad mi bzhi bsrung bye btang ngo / /der mgar med pa'i shul du/ rgyal po na re/ nga'i lha gcig de ston mkhan zhig yod thag chod pas/ rtsis gyis shig gsungs so/ /der rtsis byas pas 'di skad zer/ri gsum gyi steng na mtsho chen po cig 'dug mtsho de'i nang na bya sna tshogs 'dug de'i steng na thang dmar cem me ba cig gi kha na/ bud med yin pa la mgo dang lus mnyam pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ zangs kyi mchu yod pa cig gis bstan 'dug zer bas/ rgyal po thugs ma ches par rtsis

121yig thams cad me la bsregs/ spor thang khrirgyad cu skor ni bod du bskur nas med do/ /der blon po bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sa ru sleb/ skog tu chang mang po nyos nas sbas/ sha skam kyang zhim po byin nas/ nga'i nad la phan pa yin pas zo cig byas te/ lha gsol lo/ /de nas gyad bzhi pos kha skam nas bzod thabs rmed par byung ba dang / chang mang po byin pas/ khong rnams ra ro ste dbang po med par gyur pa dang / blon pos khong bzhi po'i rta'i sug pa brags/mtshon cha bcag /khong rang rtse/ mog ro mgo dmar la zhon/ rta gzhan de khrid nas 'di skad zer ro/ / dar zab me la rngasnasregs pa'i thal ba de//rgyal po nye ring 5na de'i na bza' mdzod//snyi ma 'bru med thal ba nag po de//btsun mo ser sna can de'i rgyags phye mdzod//nags la me brgyab sol ba'i mdung shing de//rgyal bu lus rtsal can de'i mdung shing mdzod//lug la mcher khrug med par bsad pa de//lha yi drung du sdi na bshagaso smon lam bya//lus la nad medazhimal du nyal ba la// sngas mgor sman pa bos nas ci zhig bya//kho bo mi sdod raḥci gi yul du 'gro// zer te/ rta la lcag brgyab ste ro/nga ngo / /der rgya yul du snye nag mo shar ba dang / rgya rnams na re/ snyi ma'i nang na 'bru mi 'dug blon po ngan pa des/dar zab thams cadajibasreg tu spresnacug lug thams cad gsod bcug nags thams cad la me brgyab/ sa bon shams tsade brngo su bcuge nas btab pas/

122 da ni 'bru mi 'dug lha gcig mdzangs ma de bod kyis khyer/ jo bo shākya ni bod kyis gdan drangs/ ngan 'di tsam zhig byas/ kye ma kye hud da ni ji ltar bya/ da kho 'dir 'ong ba mi srid do/ /bod du bros pa srid zer ba'i gtam rgyal po'i snyan du thos so/ /de bden par nges sam snyam nas/ rgya'i rta pa rtsal che ba brgya them(tham)pa 'dzin du btang ngo / /der gyad bzhi po yang bzi sangs te 'di snyam du bsam mo/ /rta zhon rgyu med/ mtshon cha yang mi 'dugayul du log na ngo tsha la/ rgyal po'i chad pa yang byung dogs nas/ blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /der rgya chu khug pa'i rtsar sleb dus/ rgya nag gi 'ded mi rnams kyis kyang nye bar sleb bo/ /der blon pos gyad bzhi po bran du bskul nas/ rgya chu khug pa'i 'gram du rta'i sbangs dang / rta rjes kyis bkang /gna' ba'i rwa me la bsos nas/ gzhu bcos/ gyad bzhi po mda' rgyag bcug pas/ mda' sgro mtshams bar phud bzhag go/ /de rnams 'ded mis mthong nas 'di skad zer te/ kho la bsu ba'i rta pa mang la rtsal che ba byung 'dug nged rang rnams kyis mi thub/ log pa 'thad zer te/ de nas log go/ /de'i bar la rgya mo bza' la sogs pa'i bod blon rnams kyis lhan ma brag0rtsar phebs nas/ brag la byams pa khyu bdun pa cig dang / bzang spyod gnyis bkaus mar bzhengs/ der zla ba gcig bsgug der yang blon po ma byon/ phung po ri la chag phebs/ la la 'phred lam bcos/ ri dwags bzung nas 'o ma bzhos/ der yang blon po ma byon/ khams kyi pad+ma shang du chag phebs/zhing btab/ rang thag chu bskor btsug der zla ba gnyis bskug der yang blon po ma byon/ de nas sgo dong sgo mo'i rtsar phebs/ rgya nag gi phya g.yang nyams pas/ rgya nag gi lha srung rnams kyi mthus sgo mo 'gags pas der zla ba gnyis lus/ der blon pos slebs so/ /de nas sgo dong sgo mo 'gags pa de/

tsho 123rgya nag gi lha srung ma dga' b.ru len par shes nas/ shing sna'i dud pa chen po btang / zas chang gi phud gtor nas 'di ltar byas so/ / 4ba/ro/slob 'o/ ba/soslob 'o/ zhwasti slob ba/ro/slob//rgya nag rgyal po'i lha la gsol//grong khyer zim shi'i lha la gsol//rgya rje btsan po'i lha la gsol// rnga kra shitha / sgo'i jilta slob ba/sokhu///nags ma gyen la long du gsol//bod blon rnams /kyi lha la gsol//kha ba can pa'i lha la gsol// rgya mo kong jo bsu ru shog / —ces gsol mchod di ri ri byas pa'i nub mo nags thams cad gyen la longs te 'gro thub pa byung ngo / /de nalhas bye ma'i la dgu 'khyags kha bskor/ mun pa'i rum du mar me bteg se:sngu ldeng gi nags ma g.yas su longs/ gla ba'i nags ma g.yon du longasau / bo/da du gegs med par sleb byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i drung du bang chen btaḥsngu ste/ 'di ltar nged blon po rnams kyis/jo bo shākya dang / lha gcig kong jo la sogs pa gdan drangs nas smreb gin yod pas/ bsu ba dga' ston rgya chen po zhu zhus so/ /der rgyal po'i zha la nas/ 'phags pa sgrol ma'i spru9/ pa lha gcig de yin par 'dug pas 'phrul che bas/ phyogs gang nas 'ong ngo mi shes pas/ bsu ba legs po gyis shig gsungs so/ /der phyogs bzhi kha ru mthong snang gi sprul par byung ste/ shar phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gci/na ni shar phyogs nas byon/ de'i rgyu rkyen/ rab kyi ming kyang rgya mo rab bya ba yo da zer༈ lho phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig

124 ni sto phyogs nas byon te/ grib kyi phu'i 'khyag rom la/ dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra zer ba de dus byung zer/ nub phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig ni nub phyogs nas byon te/ sbal pa tshal gyi brag la phag pa'i sna 'dra bas/mgon po cig bzhengs zer ba de dus yin zer/ byang phyogs pa rnams na re/lha gcig ni byang phyogs nas byon te/ lha gcig dang jo bo la bsu ba byas pas/ grong gi ming kyang lha bsu bya ba yod zer/ don dam par byang phyogs sgo la nas byon nas/ ra mo che'i thang la phebs so/ /der ra mo cher shing rta bye ma la bying nas/ gyad lha dga' dang klu dgas ma drongs par lus so/ /der jo bo'i phyogs bzhir ka ba bzhi btsugs/ dar dkar gyi yol bas bres nas mchod pa byas so/ /dekhri sang nyin lha gcig kong jo dar sna tshogs kyi gos gon/ gser g.yu'i rgyan du mas brgyan nas/ mdzes ma'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga yang dar zab dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ pi wang rol mo dang bcas te/ brag lha'i ne+e'u thang la gzigs mo la phebs so/ /der blon po bod 'bangs thams cad ltad mo la 'tshogs nas/ glu gar rtsed mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas so/ /der brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yas khang rtse nas/ bal mo bzas gzigs pas/ rgya mo bza' dpon g.yog rnams rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ brag lha'i de'u thang la 'dug pa mthong / chags sdang gi phrag dog bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig skyes nas 'di skad zer ro/ /kye ma rgya mo kong jo khyod//de na g.yog 'khor bcas te 'dug/ dka' las byas te snye bos bkug/sa thag ring kyang bod du sleb//rgya rje'i sras mo yin lags kyang //

125nga dang khyod gasnyis khyad par che//nga ni them pa snga brgal yin//bal rje'i sras sbya nga yang yin// rje yi sku mthong nga snga bas//chen ma che— rgyu btsun rgyu yin// chen ma mi che mi btsun na// 'jig rten chos lugs mi bden rdzun// chen ma rgyal po'i btsun mo yin//chun ma btsun rma'i g.yog mo yin// 'on kyang rje la ཿsgesam nas 'ongs//chen chun gnyis po 'gran no ang // —dkon mchog da rgya 'phang bstod par 'gran// chos dang dkon mchog bzhugs pa'i gzhi//gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs par 'gran// yar la rje yi zhabs tog 'gran// mar la ngan long skyong ba dang ༈/dad pas dam chos bed(byed)par 'gran// thad kar skal nor bsog pa dang //zhing la so nam dra/da par 'gran//yul gyi pha ming dzo tse chung dang // rang la skal brdzangs ci yod 'gran//de rnams 'gran pa ra ma nus na//khyod kyang rje la zu re zhig / d+ngha

126 btsun mo'i rang mthong ma che cigachenaci ma che rgyu'i lha khang ni//bre tshad tsam cig ma brtsigs par//chun ma chung rgyu'i lha khang ni//phul tshad tsam yang ma brtsigs shig/zer ba dang / rgya mo bza'i bsam pa la/ lar skyon che/ rang gi pha ming dpal 'byor longs spyod rnams gyeb tu bskyur/ yul thag ring nas 'ongs/sleb ma thag yin pa/ sdod pa'i gnas ma rnyed/ bsten pa'i sa ma rnyed/ rgyal po'i zhal ma mthong / btsun mo'i ming ma thob/ phyi nang gi blon po rnams dang ma 'dris pa'i gang 'dir/ phrag dog gi 'gran tshig 'di bzhin byed pa 'dra mo min/ nged rang gnyis ka sa thag ring nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo la 'dir lhan du 'dzom/ gcig snying gcig la gtad skyid sdug bsres nas/ blo sems gcig tu dril te rje'i zhabs tog /'bangs kyi skyodzo bran/ chen chun gyi 'grogs lugs/ phyi nang gi bya ba kun la thob rim bzhin byas na/ tshe 'di'i spun dang 'dra ste/ de bzhin med par sleb ma khad/ phrag dog gi 'gran tshig 'di bzhin yin na/ nged rang gnyis pha ming / skal brdzangs rang sgo/'jig rten gyi bya ba/ gang dang spyi rnams ci'istaphyir mi mnyam bsams te/ lan smras pa/ e ma ngo mtshar che ste dgod re bro// kho mos sdod pa'i gnas kyang ma rnyed cing //rkang pa gnyis kyi them pa ma brgal bar// rje yi zhal yang mig gis ma mthong bar/btsun mo khyed kyis 'gran tshig sngas pa yin//

127'dab chags mkha' la lding ba'i rtse sgro dang //rlan drod sa la skyes pa'i smyug ma gnyis//rang cha dgos /pa'i go gnas mnyam lags kyang //las kyi dbang :)sa mda' mkhan rtsa ru 'dzom//steng 'og byung ཿzu ming gi khyad par yin//phu gsum spang spru skyes pa'i me tog dang //mda' gsum ://ma rar skyes pa'i ha lo gnyis//mtshar sdug blta/ ba'i cha nas mnyam lags kyang //rten 'brel dbang gis lha yi drung du 'dzom//snga rting byung ya/nga ming gi khyad par yin//bal yul mthi'/ nas byung ba'i khri btsun dang // bu mo rgya nas 'o nga ba'i kong jo gnyis//pha ming skal ba/ ra ngas thams cad mnyam lags kyang //smon lam dbaji gis rgyal po'i drung 'dir 'dzom//chen chun byung ‘zu ming gi khyad par yin//snyan dan tshag / 4 mo dang chen chun sogs// mthun por 'gro/gas na tshe 'di'i spun las lhag/chags ldang byed na rang mgo su drung yin//rgya dang bal yu/spru sa thag ring ba na//yab gcig rgya' po gnyis ni so sor bzhugs// yul gyi pha ming ngom na'ang 'gran pos skyog/phan bde'i dge legs thams cad 'byunge ba'i gzhi/ /mthong thos dran reg yoṅka tan bsam mi khyab//

128jo bo rnam gnyis ngom na'ang 'gran pas chog/ rin chen gser dngul dar zab sna tshogs dang // rta dang rnga mo drel la sogs pa yi//rang gi skal brdzangs ngom na'ang 'gran pas chog/'jig rten bya ba bzo'irnam 'gyur dang /rgyan gyi bkod pa zas kyi g.yos sna dang // —phyi yi so nam bkal thag yon tan sogs//mdzangs ma'i lag rjes ngom na'ang 'gran pas chog/ces zer ro/ /der blon po mgar gyis kyang / rgya nag rgyal pos nye ring byas pa/ lha gcig kong jos bod la log lta byas pa/ rgya yul du dka' las chen po byung ba rnams yid la dran te/ zla ba gcig ma lon bar du/ kong jo dpon g.yog rnams la 'khor mkhan mi gcig kyang med pa byas so/ /der rgya mo'i 'khor rnams na re/ bod yi dwags kyi rgyal khams yin zer ba bden par 'dugabaza' btung longs spyod ni mi 'ong bar 'dug zer ro/ /de thos pa dang /rgya mo bza' yang sems la ṭ+wāṃzod thabs ma byung bar blon po mgar bos/ blon po chen po khyed rang ji ltar gsungs pa la brten nas 'ong ba yin pa/ khyi bos nas ma brdung / khrel med gdong chung mi byed par/ nged dpon g.yog rnams la brgyags dang gos skyol/ nged rnams sa thag ring nas smreb pa yin pas nyon mongs par yod par byas pas/ mgar na re/ nga la zas skom skyel ba'i dbang yang med/ rgyal po dang mjal ba'i dbang yang med/ ci byed bal mo bza' dbang che ba yin/ khyed rang mo la de skad gyis zer te/ kho log song ngo / /der rgya mo bza' yang yi chad/ yul gyi pha ming dang longs spyod rnams yid la dran te/ 'gyod kyang bya thabs med par song nas/ mi wang la ram 'degs

— dzha 129bcol nas glu blangs so/ /bu mo mi sdod sdi 5la la 'gro// jo bo shākya rdzokhubyu sa su byon// gtsug lag rtsisna5 kyang rdzongs su byon//rin chen dar ba rdzongs su khyer// 'o ma zho ru bsgyur gin 'ong //zho la mar du 9didon gin 'ong // da ra thud du ba/sgyur gyin 'ong // se ba zhib par 'thag gin 'ong // gres ma thag pa sdo 'chos kyin 'ong // kham pa rdza ru ཿsgasgyur gyin 'ong // rang 'thag chu bskor 'dzugs kyin 'ong //nyung ma'iri sa bo / khyerī nas 'ong //rgya nag yul du phywa g.yang nyams//bod du bde skyid phun sum tshogs//bu mo a ma'i the na ma ngangs// —go rgas sems kyi nad du che// bod kyi yul du khyim la 'ong //khyi mo nang du jo/sa nas brdung //bod la khrel ga/dong mi 'dug go /gri chung yu ba'i rtsa na no/ glu chung rang 'a rug go na snyan// bu mo ā ma'i be/sto na mdzadas//dzha

130 rje kha blon pos bsgyur gyin gda'//skyes kha mo yis bsgyur gin gda'//thag kha spun gyis bsgyur gyin gda'// tsho zhing ngan ram pas bsgyur gyin gda'// bu mo nga la sdod thabs med//blon po mgar gyis r+ṣal med byas// zhes ther te/ jo bo shing rta'i steng du bzhugs/ rta dang drel rnga mo la sogs la khal bkal/ bod ngan pa'i bya ba mthong bas shes zer te/ 'gro ba'i grab(grabs)byas dus blon po mgar byung nas/ khyed khyim nas pha ming gi yul du log pa mi 'thad/ ngo yang tsha/ rgya yul du 'gro ba'i lam yang mi shog bod du 'ong dus kyang nga med par lam du lus 'dug nas lam ma zhog par 'dug pa/ da ngas bal mo bza' 'a 'ang gros 'debs/ rgyal po la'ang zhu shig zer te/ khos mjal bar zhus nas/ rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sar byon te/rgya mo bza' kong jo dang mjal lo/ /dir yang mthong lugs rnam pa gsum du byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyibyusnang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyil sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang ba la/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal po srong btsan sgam por skur sprul/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma rgya mo bza' kong jo ru skur sprul nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag slo mal pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis skyems la gsol res byed pa dang / skud pa 'khel res byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po yang kong jo dang zla ba gcig gi bar la ma mjal ba des/ thugs shin tu 'gyod par gyur nas/ kong jo'i sems

131gso ba'i phyir/ kong jo khyod 'o ma brgyal lam/ nyon ma mongs sam bar chad med par bod du slebs pa ngo mtshar che/ jo bo ji ltar byas la gdan drangs/ la 'phrang chu gsum k+ṣ-ispru ji ltar byas gsungs/ lha gcig kong jo na re/jo bo shākya shing rta'i steng du rnga/zhugs/ gyad lha dga' dang / klu dgas 'khor los drangs/ brgya chu khug pa gru yis bcad/ lam sa thag ring yang thabs kyis byon/ bye ma'i la dgu 'khyags kha bskor nas 'ong / mun pa'i rum du mar me bteg nas 'ong / sepo ldeng gi nags ma g.yas su bsgrol nas 'ong /gla ba'i nags ma g.yon du ba/skyel nas 'ong / rgya nag yul du phywa g.yang nyams//bod du bde skyid phun sum tsho/gas/ bod la khrel gdong mi 'dug go/ /zer te bshums so/ /der yang blo/na po tshos sleb tsa na/ shags che/ yus che ba byas te/ blon po mgar na re/ spyir rgya nag gi mi thams cad kyis brnyas pa byas/ gnas mo rgya mo gcig min pa/ sems mkhan mi gcig kyang ma byung /sgos su rgya nag rgyal pos nye ring chen po byas/ lha gcig kong jo khyed rang yin kyang bod la mi dga' ba ji tsam byas zer bas/ der rgya mo bza' skyengs te smra rgyu ma byung ngo / /rgya mo bza' kong jo gdan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // bcu bzhi pa/ maba' 'dul lang 'dul gyi lha khang dang/ 'phrul snang ra mo che rnams legs pazari bzhengs pa'i skor/de nas lha gcig khri btsun gyis/ rgya rma bza' rtsis la mkhas par shes

132nas blon po mgar la ngo chen bcol te/ g.yog mo la gser phye bre gang yon du bskur nas/ lha khang brtsigs pa'i sa cha gang bzang brtsi ba la btang ngo / /der rgya mo ribazas kyang spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi gab rtse bting nas brtsis pas/kha ba can bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i gzugs su shes/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrug tu shes/ ri gsum po 'di snying gi rus par shes/ sa cha 'di srin mo'i snying thog rang du 'dug pas/mtsho 'di bsu bas pa'i steng du lha khang 'di brtsig dgos/ 'di na ngan song gi sgo cig kyang 'dug ra mo che'i 'og na klu'i pho brang 'dug ste/ jo bo bzhugs pa 'dis non par 'dug go / /klu phug na klu bdud nag po'i nyal sa 'dug pa lha khang brtsigs la phrogs shig /lho nub zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gi sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa ba na the'u rang dang / mi ma yin gyi 'dus sa yod pa gtor cig grib gyi phu nas nyang bran phu ru/ btsan gyi rgyu srang yod pas bar chu khar mchod rten chen po bzheng sa shig shar phyogs na chu srin de'u la 'dring pa lta bu'i sa dgra yo da pa lam grum pa ri yin/ de la dung g.yas su 'khyil pa cig gi kha ston/ shar lho na srin mo mdoms bzed pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod pas/ byang stod seng phug yin/ de la dbang phyug chen po'i kha ston/ sto nub na sdig pa nag po bzan la rub pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ yug ma ri'i shar ri 'di yin/ de la bya khyung ke ru cig gi kha ston/ nub na bdud nag ngo/ bya ra byed pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ shun gyi brag rtse 'di yin/ de la rdo'i mchod rten cig gi kha ston/ byang na glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ nyang bran dge te gnyis kyi dbus ri yin/ de la rdo'i seng ge cig gi kha ston/ des nye ba'i sa dgra thams cad non pa yin no/ /de ltar sa dgra thams cad mnan pa dang / yon tan thams cad phyogs gcig tu tshang ste/ shar na ri

138 mchod rten 'dra ba yod/ ban khesgos bang ba ri yin/ sto na rin po che spungs ba 'dra ba yod/ grib kyi rgyab ri kha di yin/ nub na ri ca/ñdzi'i steng na dung phor bzhag pa 'dra ba chad/ stod lu/nga brang bu'i ri yin/ byang na ri pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba yod/ dge te lha phu'i 5sdi yin/ gzhan yang nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la dbu la gdugs/ mal grong gi rgyab ri la spyan la nya/ mdangs mkhar gyi brag la ljags la pad+ma/ grib snyekyi 'khyag khrom la gsung la dung / rdzong btsan gyi ri la mgul la bum pa/ yuḥn ma'i ri la thugs dpal be'u/ 'phan dkar gyi ri la sku lus rgyal mtshan/ stod lung brang phu'i spang la phyag zhabs 'khor lo ste/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgya/da tshang yod do/ /gzhan yang gar pa'i jo mo ze ze la lcags kyi gter kha/ ra ga brag la zangs kyi gter kha/ la dong gi brag la dngul gyi gter kha/ lcags kha ri'i brag la gser gyi gter kha yod do//shar na stag skya bo dga' mo ga/dong 'og ma/ sto na g.yu 'brug sngon mo chu/nub na bya dmar po shun gyi bratha/ dmar rte'u'i gdong yin/ byang na rus sbal nag po nyang bran pha bong kha yin/ de ltar srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'itshoyan lag dang srin lag rnams non rnga 4ra byed pa la/ mi 'gyur ba'i gzer bcu gnyis zer te/ de yang mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ g.yo ru na khru 'brug /spu ru na ka stsal/ g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang sga lha khang / gtsang na grum pa rgyang gi lha khang / des ma thub na/ yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi brtsigs/ kong po bu chu'i lha khang / mkho mthing gser gyi lha khang / byams sprin dge rgyas kyi lha khang / spra dun tse'i lha khang / des ma thub na/ ru non gyi lha khang bzhi rtsigs shig de yang / khams su klong thang sgron ma/ bum thang skyer chu'i lha khang / mtshal ri/gas shes rab sgron ma'i lha khang / tshangs pa rlung non milha khang / de rnams sngon la bzhengs shig ma grub na'ang sa phur thob

134 cig de ltar byas na/ khyod kyis gtsug lug khang bzhengs pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad med do/ /genam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/ sa yul 'di srin mo'i snying thog rang du 'dug gong gi rten 'brel de rnams rim pa bzhin du mdzod/ mtsho bsubs pa'i thog ma la/ra dkar mo la sa khol la bsubs shig de'i steng du lha khang legs par bzhengs shig brag dog gi log lta ma mdzad cig ces rgya mo bzas bal mo bza'i g.yog mo la legs par bslabs so/ /der g.yog mo des khri btsun gyi rtsar/'phrin gong 'og dzol te/ gong gi skyon sel ba/ sa dgra non pa/ yon tan yod pa/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhengs nas/ thabs rten 'brel legs par bshad pa rnams brjed/ der lha khang bzhengs pa'i sa cha gang bzang bar 'dug dris pas/ phyogs mtha' dag rnams su sngon la lha khang bcu gnyis brtsig dgos zer/ ra la sa khol la mtsho bsubs/ de'i steng du lha khang bzhengs zer gyi 'dug byas pas/ khri btsun the tshom du gyur te/ 'on kyang g.yog mos zer ba bzhin/ ra la sa bkal nas mtsho bsubs pas/ bye ba stong gi cha yang zub ma 'dod do/ /der rgya mo bzas ngan bslabs par go nas phrag dog skyes/ shin tu ma dga' bar gyur nas/ rgyal po la yang ma zhus par/blon po 'ga' zhig gi kha la nyan nas/ la dong gi ni'u thang la sa'i dpyad bzang bar shes nas/ lha khang rmang bting pas/ nyin par brtsigs pa thams cad nub mo lha 'dres rjes med par bshig 'dug pas/ khri btsun yi mug cing sdug bsngal bar gyur nas/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod sdug bsngal bar ma byed/ nga la gros 'dri sa cig yod do gsungs te/ de'i mtshan mo rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ yid dam gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer cig 'phros nas mtsho nang du thim par gyur to/ / der rgyal po'i

135thugs la mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du lha khang bzhengs na bzang bar dgongs nas/khri btsun la rgyal po'i zhal nas/ chibs sga stod cig sang nged gnyis skyo sangs la 'gro'o gsungs so/ / de'i mu/nga rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis mtsho 'gram gyi de'u thang la skyo sangs la byon te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khri btsun la/ khyod rang gi sor gdub phud la nam ca/kha' la gtor cig de gar babs pa'i thang du lha khang brtsigs pa yin no gsungs pas/ der khri btsun gyis yi dam gyi lha la smon lam btab ste/ sor ga/ni ba nam mkha' la 'phangs pas/ 'od zer gyi gang bur 'dril nas mtsho rnang du lhung bar gyur to/ /der khri btsun gyi bsam pa la/ mtsho'i steng du lha khang rnga/rtsig dgos na/ skye ba 'di la grub pa mi srid snyam nas/ rta kha nas babs te sdug bsngal bar byas pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod ma ngu bar mtsho nang du stos shig yon tan du ma dang ldan par 'dug gsungs so/ /der khri btsun gyil mchi ma phyis nas bltas pas/ mtsho'i nang na 'od zer sna tshogs las grub pa 'i mchod rten khri 'phang dgu yod pa cig mthong ngo / / de la brten nas mtsho nang thams cad 'od zer gyi dra bas 'brel te/ lha khang gi ri mo lta bur 'dug pas/ khri btsun yid ches te/ rgyal pos kyang lha khang brtsig grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i sang rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas rol mo dang bcas te/ tsardon gyi sku rang byon gdan drangs te mtsho 'gra ma du byortsa no/ /der mtsho'i phyogs bzhir sa phur gdab bo/ /dar po che phyar te smon lam btab/ der khri btsun gyis baiḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed la gsol ba btab nga /sa zas chang dpag tu med pa byung ste/ bod 'bangs thams cad las la bskul/ skye chu sbo ba gdong la bsgyur/ mtsho'i phyoṭa bzhir rdo bskyed du bcug nas/ mtsho gru bzhir spuco sa so/ /mtsho'i phyogs bzhir rdo dpe chen po mtsholanab ṅge lhags ba ba bgi byas shing / r+ghaṃl pos

136 rdo dpe de rnams kyi steng du byon nas/ mtsho'i dkyil gyi 'od zer gyi mchod rten de la dmigs te smon lam btab/ blon po rnams kyis yi ge drug pa'i sgra dang bcas te/ rdo rnams mtsho nang du bskyur bas/ri rgyal po'i smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas/ mtsho de'i dkyil nas rdo'ikhyimachod rten khri 'phang gru bzhir yod pa cig rang thag gi lte ba lta bur lhun gyis grub ste/sna sra zhing brtan la mi 'gyur bar 'dug pa rgyal po yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas legs par gzigs pas/ thams cad khrid ches shing mos par byas so/ /de nas shing shug pa'i sdong po sbom la ring ba bcu drug bcad nas/ rtsa ba phyogs bzhi'i rdo dpe chen po rnams la gtad/ rtse mo mtsho'i dkyil gyi rdo'i mchod rten rang byon la gtad de/ gdugs kyi rtsib ma bzhin du byas so/ /de'i steng du shing gla ba'i sdong po sbom la ring ba mang po bcad nas/ de'i steng du mig mangs ris su byas so/ /de yang sprul pa'i dge slong ma kar ma rti ṣ+ka las/ klu'i yul du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te/ rdo rje'i 'jim pa blangs shing rnams la byugs pas/ bskal pa'i bar du chu nang na gnas kyang mi rul cing / mes kyang mi tshig cing /bcad kyang mi chod do/ /de'i steng du spang leb bsgrigs/ de'i steng du so phag bsgrigs te khro chus bsdamase/ de'i steng sa khod stoms par byas nas/ de ltar sa pho khyi la 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs pas legs par tshar te/ chos rgyal dgung yo nyi shu rtsa gsum gye steng du/ lha sa'i rtsig rmang bting pa legs/ sa mo phag la lha khang meng bting / rked pa tsam brtsigs tshar nas thams cad dga' bar gyur pa dang / sang nyin lha 'dres bshig 'dug go /yang khri btsunarisdug bsngal bar gyur nas/ rgyal po'i drung du byung ste/ rgyal po chen po mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du lha khang brtsig mi btub par 'dug pa/ bdag gi lha khang la gzigs dang zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod sdug bsngal ma byed cig /nga la

137gros 'dri sa cig yod do gsungs so/ /der rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol —ba btab pas/ nam mkha' nas gzugs med pa'i sgra zhig byung ste/ rgyal po khyed rang gi sku 'bag jo bo bzu gcig zhal cig bzhengs na/ khyed kyi lha khang bzhengs pa la 'gal rkyen mi 'adh+ra/nga bar 'gyur ro zer te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas bal po'i lha batho ba la/ khyod kyis nga'i sku 'bag tu ming btags pa'i/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal cig —bzhengs nus sam gsungs pas/ nus lags zer te/ be 'i bzo rgyu la tsardon sbrul gyi snying po'i dum bu/tsardon go sna sha'i dum bu/ byang chub shing gi yal ga rgya mtsho gle'i 'jag ma/chu bo ni raldi ra'i bye ma/ dben gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa la sogs pa rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i ngo mazu5ra che ba'i rdzas mang po bsag ste/ logs par brdar nas/ ba dmar po'i 'o ma dang / ra dkar mo'i 'o ma la sbyar te/'jim pa'i phung po chen po cig byas/ rgyal po rin po che'i khri'i steng du gzims pa'i dbu sngas su bzhag ste/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab nas/ nga'i yi dam gyi lha 'di la/ spyan ras gzigs la rigs mang po yod pa ji lta bu cig bzhengs dgongs pa dang / de rnams kyi nang nas bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ lhag pa yin pas bzhengs dgos dgongs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad nyi zer gyi rdul tsam du lhags te/ 'jim pa'i phung 2 / la thim pa rgyal pos gzigs pas/ rgyal po'i thugs la/ nga'i yi dam 'di la byin rlabs can cig 'byon par 'dug go dgongs nas/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du gzims so/ /nang par gung langs pa dang / bcu gcig zhal yid ba/rgon gyi nor bu rang byon du snang ste/ lha bzos bzhengs ma dgos so/ /de la rtsa ba'i zhal gsum dkar po rab tu 'dzum pa zhi ba'i phrin las/ de'i steng sgozhali gagyuṭā ga ra gyi mdog rnga mas pa'i khro zhal

13skye rgyas pa'i phrin las/ de'i steng gi zhal gnyis byi ru'i mdog bzhad pa'i khro zhal dbang gi phrin las/ de'i steng gi zhal gnyis nag po khros shing gdangs po'i khro zhal drag po'i phrin las/ de'i steng du a mi de ba li khri'i mdog can a mi de ba man rgyal po'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa/ chos sku'i rtsa ba'i phyag bcu'i phyag mtshan ni/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na bgrang phreng / gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bzhi pa na mchog sbyin/ lnga pa na 'od dpag med bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na rin po che/ lnga pa na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o//(sprul pa'i rgyag rnams lha batho bas bzhengs/ rang byon du byon dus/ rtsa phyag bcu bo las mi 'dug/)longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag sum cu so brgyad yod pa ni/ g.yas phyogs kyi phyag bcu dgu'i rim pa bzhin du/ dang po ni rin po che/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ gsum pa na lhung bzed/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ lnga pa na rdo rje/ drug pa na me shel/ bdun pa na chu shel/ brgyad pa na gzhu/ dgu pa na lhug ma/ bcu pa na rnga yab/ bcu gcig na phub/ bcu gnyis na bum pa/ bcu gsum na dgra sta/ bcu bzhi na phreng ba/ bco lnga na pad+ma sngon po/ bcu drug na spyi blugs/ bcu bdun na nyi ma/ bco brgyad na chu skyes dkar po/ bcu dgu na 'bras kyi snyi ma 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi yan lag ban dgu'i rim pa bzhin du/dang po na sprin dkar/ gnyis pa na spyi blugs/ gsum pa na pad+ma/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ lnga pa na dung / drug pa na thod pa/ bdun pa na phreng ba/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na rdo rje/ bcu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu gci ga pa na 'khar gsil/ bcu gnyis na sangs rgyas sprul sku/ bcu gsum na lha khang / bcu bzhi na glegs bam/ bco lnga na 'khor lo/ bcu drug na sangs rgyas kyi sku/bcu bdun na shing thog /bco bgyod na pad+ma ge sar/ bcu dgu na rin po che

139bsnams pa'o/ /sprul pa'i nying lag stong tham pa rab spya mdzes pa/ phyag re re'i mthil na ye shes kyir+ṣaspyan re re yod pa/ phyag dang zhabs la gser gyi gdu gu dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro zhal rnams ni spyan gsum re dang ldan pa/dbu skra kham pa gyen la 'khyil ba/ sku lus la rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer phyogal bcur 'phro ba/ sku stod la ri dwags kyi pags pas g.yogs nas nu ma g.yon / 4 bkab pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad zus brgyan pa cig 'od du khrong nge byon 'dug pa rgyal pos gzigs pas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i 6/la nas/ bal po'i lha batho ba la khyed kyi rten 'di/ ngo mtshar che la mgyogs pa cig bzhengs tshar 'dug na'ang / — rgya ga ra nas byon pa'i tsardon gyi sku rang byon 'di dang / sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ribai bsrel rnams rten 'di'i thuḥnas kar bzhugs 'jug rgyu yin pa la gsungs pas/ lha bzo ba na re/ rten— 'di bdag gis bzhengal pa ma lags/ rang byon du gda'o zhus spu dang / de ma thag tu sku g.yos par gyur te/ zhabs g.yon pa'i sham thabs pus mo'i gong du brjes/ thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang / tsardon gyi sku rang byon rnams spyan drangs te/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /a mi de ba g.yon phyogs su cung yo ba dang / sham thabs kyang bus mo'i gong du lus pa rnams/snyi rabs su yang de ltar du yoji/ do/ /de la tsardon sbrul gyi snying po de dbu'i srog shing du gyur/ byang chub kyi shing gnyis zhabs kyi srog shing du gyur/ sngar gyi rdzas rnams la sku lus su gyur te/ me tog gtor ro/ /de nas bal po'i lha bzos 'khor rnams bzhengs pa rno/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / kharma pa ṇi dang / khro gnyer can dang / /la ma dang / 'od zer can dang / dbyangs can ma dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / dpas rta mgrin rnams bzhengs so/ /

1‘0der bkra shis pa'i ltas kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur nas/ sa yang rnam pa drugatu g.yos so/ /der rgyal po yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ mchod rdzas du ma thoḍa te/ smon lam btab bo/ /de nagargyal po'i rten de'i drung du/ lha khang brtsig pa'i 'gal rkyen bzlog cing / mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i gsol ba 'debs kyin yod tsa na/ nub phyogs zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gi sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa na/ 'dre srin dang mi ma yin mang po 'tshogs nas/khong rnams na re/ srong btsan sgam po zer ba'i mgo gnyis yod pa 'dis/ nged rang tsho'i 'dus sa bshig /rgyu srang bkab/ nged rang tsho yang kho'i lha khang brtsig tu mi 'jug /dge ba byed pa'i srog gcod/ sad ser ba dang / nad yams gtong zer gin 'dug pa/ rgyal pos mkhyen nas 'phagagapa la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ 'phags pa bzhad pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba me ru gyur/ khros pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gnyis su gyur te/ khro bo gnyis ye shes kyi me dang bcas pas zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gi sdong po la brgyab/ sran phung dkyil du thog babs pa bzhin byas te/ 'dre la la ni brgyal/ la la ni bog la la skad ngan 'don par gyur to/ /der khro bo gnyis kyis ye shes kyi me dang bcas pas de rnams ded de/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la bsgral nas phyir mi ldog pa byas so/ /der ye shes kyi me zla ba tshal gyi brag la photra/ pas brag de la khaso pa ṇi rang byon du byon par gyur to/ /de'i sang rgyal po blon po'i tshogs ngang bcas pas rang byon de'i drung du byon te/ mchod pa phul zhing smon lan btab nas/ bstod pa mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon//thub pa'i dbang pos spyi gtsug brgyan//

141sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri 'dra// ston mongs ma gos pad+mo bzhin// thugs rje che zhing mthu ldan pa//sems can nyam rdzo/ga phongacha/ dgu yi//nad dang sdug ba: cil zhi mdzad pa//mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs so/ /rang byon /de brag la gsal bar byon na'ang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can bsod nams bsog pa'i phyir du/ bal po'i lha bzos gsal bar brkos so/ /de nas lha kha/rnga brtsigs pa la bgegs med par dgongs nas/rje blon kun gyis mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du byon/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs nas thig gdab bo/ /de'i dus su klu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku mdog dkar po sbrul gyi gde/rngas ka can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa byon te/rgyal po la sbrul zhags dkar po cig phul nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la stong chung ngu'i bar gyi gnod pa byud na ngas srungs shig nga'i gzugs cig mardzad cig zer ro/ /yang klu'i rgyal spretre/ dga' bo byung nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la stong bar ma'i bar du gnod pa byung /na ngas srungs shig nga'i gzugs cig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang klu'i rgyal po nye dga' byung nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la stong gre/sum gyi bar du chu'i gnod pa byung na ngas spungs shig nga'i gzuṭa cig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yajici srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu byung nas/rgyal po la gser gzhong pa gang phul nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la me'i gnon pa byung na ngas srungs shig jici 'i gzugs cig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang gnod sbyin na ga ku be ra byung nas/ gsir gyi thags bzangs shig phul nas/rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shig nga'i

142 gzugs cig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang ma hā kā la byung nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la mtharme dmag dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shigangari gzugs cig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang dpal ldan lte mo byung ste/ lcags kyi bre ba cig phul nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi lha khang 'di la mi dang ma mo'i gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shig nga'i gzugs ci ga mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang bla ma rnams byon te/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di bla ma'i tshugs su bzhengs shig gsung ngo / /yang sngags pa rnams byung ste/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di nged sngags pa'i lugs su bzhengs shig zer ro/ /yang bon po rnams byung ste/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di bon po'i lugs su bzhings shig zer ro/ /yang bod 'bangs rnams byung ste/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di bod 'bangs kyi lugs su bzhengs shig zer ro/ /der rgyal po shin tu dgyes nal thams cad zhal gyis bzhes so/ /der rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams la zas chang gis tshim par byas te las la bskul nas/ la las so phag btang / la las rtsig pa byas/ la las 'jim pa btang ste/ 'og khong(khang)gi rtsig pa zin par byas so/ /(lha sa'i rtsig ming bting pa man/ mtshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes rab byung mdzad pa yan la lo bdun brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga 'gro ba rtogs ldan rjo nyal ma gsungs/) de nas shing shug pa'i sdong po mang po bcad nas/rgyal pos sku lus kyi sprul pa brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad de/ lha khang gi sgo bsrung ste/nang du shing bzo ba ste'u thogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad du sprul nas shing bzo mdzad/bsang bu yang bal mo bza' min pa gzhan gyis mi skyel lo/ /dus nam zhig khri btsun yi dam la mchod pa 'bul ba dang dus 'dzom nas/ rgyal po'i bsang bu g.yog mo la bskur ro/ /g.yog mos sgo phyes nas phyin pas/ rgyal po med par shing bzo ba cha lugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i ste'u thogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad du 'dug ste/ seng ge brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sna'i bzo byed gin 'dug pas/ bsang

143bu gang ‘5 'dren ngo ma shes par /gir log nas/ bsang bu bal mo la gtang do/ /der g.yog mo'i bsam pa spru/ rgyal po 'dis sprul pa mkhyen zer ba de e bden bsams nas/ khri btsusko rgyal po la bsang bu 'dren song ba'i rjes 'a /g.yog mos sgo phag nas bltas pas thams cad sprul par 'dug pa/ he he zer bgad pas/ rgyal po spyan yengs pa dang ste'u kha 'chor bas shing bzo ba thams cad kyis ste'u kha 'chor nas/ seng ge rnams sna chad do/ /der yang la las ka ba bcos/ la las gdung ma /nathog la las lcam gru bzhir bcos/ yang la las ka ba btsug la las gdung bkal/ la las lcam bsgrigs/ la las spang leb btang / thog phub nas mdzes par byas so/ /(jo bo rje'i gter mig chen mo na/ lha sa'i 'ogakhang la nyin zhag ga/stes la zin pa byas zer bar 'dug lta/ thog phub pa der 'dug/3 de ltar rgyal pos sprul pa mdzad pas/ rtsig pa la nyin zhag bzhi/ shing bzo la nyin zhag drug thog 'bung/ pa la nyin zhag gnyis/ dril bas nyin zhag bcu gnyis la/ ra sa'i 'og khang yongs su rdzogs par zin par byas so/ /de yang sgo bzhi dkyil 'khor ris su byas pas bla ma dga'/ ka ba phur pa ris su byas pas sngags pa dga'/ zur bzhi g.yung drung ris su byas pas bon po dga'/ re'u mig ris su byas pas bod 'bangs dga'/ gyis zer ba'i gzugs thamalamyocad byas pas/ chos skyong klu dang gnod sbyin srin po la sogs pa rnams dga'o/ /de yang dgadzosgru bzhi 'phyal gyi lha khang gi sgo yang nub phyogs bal po'i yul du gtad do/ /de'i 'phro la khri btsun gyis bal po'i yul nas rig byed la mkhas pa'i bzo bo mang po bos nas steng khang bzhengs so//(lha sa'i ltang khang dang / ra mo che gnyis la ba bcu gnyis ri 'gor te lhan du tshar ro//) de dang dus mnyam du rgya mo bzas kung rgya lhul nas shing bzo ba dang / lha bzo ba mang po bos nas/ rgya stagi ra mo che'i lha khang bozhengs te/ lha khang gi sgo

144shar du bstan no/ /de'i bar la rgyal pos sprul pa mdzad nas mtha' 'dul dang / yang 'dul dang / ru 'dul gyi lha khang bzhengs pa ni/ srin mo'i dpung pa g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ sbya ru ka rtsal mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang bzhengs/de'i lag tu gser shang gi rti'i lha khang bzhengs/ /de'i sgrub pa rtse no gdong gi brag phug tu byas so/ /dpung pa g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ g.yo ru khru 'brug bkra shis byams stoms kyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i lag tu tsan thang gi lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa phug mo cher byas so/ /dpyi mgo g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/g.yas ru gtsang 'brang byang chub dge gnas kyi lha khung bzhengs/ de'i lag tu dge drung gi lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa tse'i brag phug tu byas so/ /dpyi mgo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir du/ grub pa rgyal dri med rnam dag gi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i lag tu 'bre'i lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa rgyang gi brag phug tu byas so/ /de nas yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi brtsigs pa ni/ gre mo g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ sharatsastag gi mgo steng du/ kong po bu chu'i lha khang bzhengs/ gre mo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ lho 'brug gi ze steng du/ sto brag mkho mthing gi lha khang bzhengs/ pus mo g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ nub phyogs bya dmar po'i sgalasteng du/ byams chen dge rgyaspokyi lha khang bzhengs/ pus mo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ byang rus sbal gyi dbral steng du/ pra ngan tse'i lha khang bzhengs/ des kyang ma thub dogs na/ ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi bzhengs te/lag mthil g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ — khams su glang thang sgron ma'i lha khang mi nyag gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ lag mthil g.yon pa'i phyir/ lho phyogs su bum thang skyer chu'i lha khang tho dkar gyis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/rkang mthil g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ nub dpal kha che'i gnas su/ mtshal rig shes rab spron ma'i lha khang bal pos lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ rkang

145mthirme g.yon gnon pa la/ rdosgyung phyogs su tshangs pa rlung non gyi lha khang hor sba dpal dbyangs kyis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs so/ /gzhan yang shar du ka chu/ kang chu/ gling chu gsu spru/ nyi zla gza' skar gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir du bzhengs so/ /sto ru snyal snang gro lha khang / gling thang gnyis/ me lha drang srong bsgrubs te me'i kha ga ༈na du bzhengs/ /nub tu gu lang shing khun gnyis/ bal bod kyi so mtsham bsrungs te chu'i kha gnon du bzhengs/ byang du dge ri dang dpal ri gnyis/ lha klu 'dre srin dam la btags te rlung gi kha gnon du bzhengs/ de rnamalhas bzhengs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams zil gyis mnan te/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la/ 'gal rkyen bar chad med par lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de nas khri btsun dang kong jo gnyis kyis/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyisna kyi ri mo gang dang spyi yongs su rdzogs pa rnams la zla ba bcu gnyis re 'gor te lhan du tshar ro/ /rgyal pos kyang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams yongs su rdzogs pa tshar te/ slar khru 'brug tu phebs nas/ sang 5 rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bkur sti dang /phu dud du mdzad nas/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags yod pa tsam la yang / mgo'i thod ltar du khur zhing gus par / snyeg byed la/ nga'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gyis shig gsungs te/ phyi rol du byon pa dang / sbrul bsad pa'i sdig bshags su bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rtse lnga de'i drung na/ sprang ban rgan po cig bla gos rgyal po cig bting nas shigi thu gin 'dug pa rgyal pos gzigs pa dang / sprang ban de la rab tu byung ba'i rtags 'dug par mkhyen nas/ rgyal pos phyage mdzad do/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bdag ni rgyal khams la dbang thob rnga ri rgyal po cig yin na'ang mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi

146 —ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu cig byed par 'dod nas/ gtsug lag khang mang po brtsigs/ de rnams kyi nang du sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhengs nas mchod pa byas/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags yod tsam la'ang phyag byed par dam bcas pa yin pas de ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs pas/ sprang ban de langs te bla gos rgyal po de dpung pa la gozar nas/ rgyal po khyed sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas rab tu byung ba la mos gus mdzad de/ bdag sprang ban la phyag mdzad pa de ngo mtshar che ste/nga'i 'di'ang ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs nas/ mchod rten rtse lnga de lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga'i steng du blangs te bskor ba cig byas so/ /der rgyal po cung zhig skyengs par gyur nas/ dbu'i la thod phud de/ a mi de ba'i zhal bstan nas/ khyed kyi de ngo mtshar che ste/ nga'i 'di'ang ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs pas/ yang spang ban des brang sgo phyes/ mtshon chas brang gshags te/kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha thams cad byang(brang)/rag nang du bzhugs pa bstan nas/ rgyal po khyed la lha gcig las mi 'dug /nga la 'di tsam yod/'di ngo mtshar mi che'am ther bas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes shib dad par gyur nas mchod gnas su mdzad do/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rab tu byung ba rnams ni bla gos rgyal po'am cha lugs dang sbyod lam ci 'dra na'ang / slog par lta ba ma byed par mos gus gyis shig /dper na 'di lta bu'o zhes zhal gdams so/ /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi lha khang dang / 'phrul snang ra mo che rnams legs par bzhengs pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //

147bco lja pa lha sa gnyis dang / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang tshar nas rab cu gnas nga/ra mdzad pa'i skor/ de nas khri btsun dang kong jo gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang legs par bzhengs pas yongs su rdzogs pa pa tshar te/ rgyal po spyan drangs nas/ po ta la'i rtser phebs so/ /de'i sang khri btsun gyis gtsug lag khang gzigs par 'bul ba la/ spos dang rol mo’sna tshogs pa dang bcas te/ rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'phrul snang du spyan drangs so/ /der khri btsun gyis lha khang gi sgo phyes nas/ rgyal po na/pa du byon par bzhed pa la mthil gyi zha la chu'i mdog lta bu/ steng phyogs kyi nazugs brnyan thams cad de la shar ba gzigs pas/ sngar gyi mtsho 'di brdol dzosgyudug dgongs nas/ nang du 'byon ma nus pa dang / khri btsun gyis sor gdub phud de gtor bas/ khyag thog khar rde'u bskyur ba bzhin khrol gyis song ba dang / rgyal pos gzigs pas thugs ches te nang du byon no/ /der khri ཿsnatsun la khyed4 kyi lha khang 'di 'phrul du snang ngo gsungs/ dang po ra la sa bka'/ nas mtsho bsrubs/ de nas rgyal pos 'phrul du snang ngo gsungs pas/ ra ba/ 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang zhes yongs su grags so/ /de ltar rgyal pos lha khang nang gi ngo mtshar che ba rna mas gzigs pas/ 'di lta ste/ ngo mtshar 'gran rme/da rgyal ba'i gzhal yas khang //

/// — rigayon tan mtha' yas rab tu mdzes pa ste //gzhi ma gru bzhi lhun gyis grub pa la//zur chen bzhi ni g.yung drung ris su byas//sgo yi ri bzhi dkyil 'khor lta bur bzos//mthil gyi zha la be+ezurnga yi mdog/steng gi ri mo nya dang chu srin rnams// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ci bzhin no//steng 'og gnyis kyi ka ba thams cad ni// snyorab tu mdzes pa rdo rje phur pa'i bzo//ka zhu gdung dang gdung khebs mchod rten brtsegs//bzo yi rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar 'gran zla med// phyi nang gab spangs ka zhu thams cad la // sngon gyi sgrung brgyud gsal bar 'bur du brkos// steng 'og gnyis kyi mthongs kha'i lcam sna la//seng ge dkar mo g.yu ral rgyan dang bcas//brgya rtsa brgyad ni mchong ba'i tshul du gzigs//de mi sting du mu tig dra ba can/ /g.yu bad sngon po in+d+ra nī la'i mdog/steng gi rtsig pa pha gu dra phyed dang // mda' yab pu shu rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes//'od zer stong ldan gser gyi gasdi ra//sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan du ma dang //rnga yab dril bu g.yer kha'i rgyan dang bcas//

149khor yug kun tu snags kyi thag pas sbrel//de ltar ngo mtshar dpag med rgyan bkod pa'i// 'og gi btsan kharnga dbus ma'i gzhal yas na// 'gro ba skyob mdzaḥshe skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can// (de dus kyi gtso bo de sangs rgyas mi 'gro gsung byon min/kyematshan dpes rab brgyan tshogs gnyis dpal gyis brjid//sangs rgyas mar 3/ mjod ni sprul sku la// 'khor ni nye ba'i trīs brgyad bzhengs pas bskor//khro bo gnyis kyis sgo shāng mdzad pa gzigs//btsan khang g.yas na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med//li khri'i mdog cazu/ mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can//ngo mtshar dpag zusgod mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis mdzes//spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob la sogs//nye ba'i sras brgyang 'khor gyis bskor ba ni//pad zla'i gdan 'a rdo rje phyed krung bzhugs//sgo 'gram g.yas sne gsang ba'i bdag po ni//nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje mkha' la phyar//sgo 'gram g.yon zu/ khro rgyal smre brtsegs ni//byi ru'i mdog caca/ grib sel tshul du bzhugs// —btsan khang g.yon na rje btsun byams pa ni//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyag rgya can//gur gum mdog rgyu na mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis bajid//snyi nang mchod pami lha mos bskor ba ni //

160ngo mtshar dpag med rab mdzes 'gying ba'i tshul//pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje phyed krung bzhugs//btsan khang sto na mi bskyod rdo rje ni// mtshan dpes rab brgyan sa gnon mnyam gzhag can//'od stong 'bar ba gser gyi lhun po ltar// rab tu brjed pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ni//stong chen rab 'joms zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma//so sor 'brang ma zhal gcig phyag drug yin//gshin rje mthar byed zhabs drug brkyang bskum tshul //sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug shin tu khros//phyag drug mtshon cha du ma bsnams pa'o //shes rab mthar byed sku mdog dkar po ste// zhal bzhi phyag brgyad brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs//pad+ma mthar byed pad+ma rā ga'i mdog/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab tu khros pa'i tshul//bgegs mthar byed ni mthing nag rngams pa'i tshul//zhal gcig phyag bzhi bgegs dpung 'joms por mdzad//sgo 'gram gnyis na rnam sras jom bha la// sku mdog ser po dbul phongs sel ba'i phyir//phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon na ne+e'u le 'dzin//phyi sgo'i 'gram gyi klu yi khang pa na// klu chen gsum ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis te//sbrul gyi gdengs ka sems dpa'i skyi4 ñtsang bcas//

151sku mdog dkar ngakyi nga dmar dang dmar ser yin//sgo 'gram g.yas /kyi gnod gin khang pa na//srin mo laṅka mgrin bcu dbu dgu ste// rta mgos spangs tred ska mdog mthing ga'o//sna ra gnod sbyin dri za gnyis ni sku mdog dmar//zhal gsum phyag ‘bzhi sems dpa'i skyil krung bcal//sgo khang steng na sangs rgyas rabs bdun ni//mtshan dpes rab brgyan spruspu sku'i tshul du bzhugs//'og khang logs ‘spru rgyal ba'i sku gzugs ni//lho yi ri mo gang la ci 'dul gling //thugs rje chen po 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang //'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor lnga yi zhing bkod dang / bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pi gzigs//sto nub g.yu rung khug na rigs gsum mgon//nub phyogs ka tshigs rgyal ba rigs lnga dang //'gro don mtha' mas rgyal po'i mdzad pa bris//dus gsum sangathe/ rgyas 'khor gyis bskor ba ni//nub byang g.yu ru/pa khug gi ri mo yin//byang dang byang shaziri mtshams kyi ri mo la//thub pa'i mdzad / 4 bcu gnyis rdzogs par yod//shar gyi logs la sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs//thub pa bdud 'a/ni la sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas// shar sto g.yu rung khug gi ri mo la// tsho

162 bcom ldan sman gyi rgyal po'i lha tshorges bzhugs//sgrol ma rta mgrin dkar po la sogs pa'i//bar khang nang gi ri mo phal cher ni//be bum brgya dang rtsa brgyad ji bzhin bris// sna tshogs tshon gyi ri mo khru ba sogs//de rnams rgyal pos gzigs pas dgyes par gyur//shar sto'i ltog la seng gi gru skas byas//g.yung drung khug der dpal lha'i rten cig btsugs// tsho btsan khang byang ma ngo mtshar mdzes pa la//de na lha yi bdag bzung mi 'dug pas// sprul pa'i rgyal po de yi dgongs pa la /po ta ri nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal//shing rtar spyon drangs rol mo'i rgyan dang bcas//btsan khang byang mar bzhugs dgos dgrongs pa la//de yi nub mo rang byon gtso 'khor rnams//lha yi rol mos bsu ba byas nas ni//rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mkha' la gshegs nas kyang //btsan khang byang mar gdan khri med par bzhugs//'jig rten dbang phyug rgyan gyis mdzes pa dang //jo mo khro gnyer can dang dbyangs can ma//bdud brtsi 'khyil ba sgo 'gram g.yas su bzhugs//khaso r+pā ṇi mgrin pa sngo ba dang // lte rje btsun sgrol ma lha mo 'od zer can//

163 rta mgrin rgyal /pre sgo 'gram g.yon du bzhugs//de yi mod la ri dang bcas pa yi//rgya mtsho'i gos can rnam pa drug tu g.yos//lha rnams kun /)sa me tog char pa phab//de nas rgyal po yab yum blon po'i tshogs//dad pa'i shugs kyis mchi mas gdong g.yogs shing // rang rang mchong pa'i yo byad thogos nas ni//rab gus gdung bas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul//thun mong mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur//'di yi gzhi bdag bstan pa bgrung ba la// klu rgyal dga' bo dang ni nye3dga' bo //srin po'i rgyal spre / lang katsamagrin bcu dang //gnod sbyin dri 'i tshogs dang ku be ra//ma hā kā la dpal gyi lha mo sogasi// lha khang bstan / 4 srung ba'i bdeg por bskos//zhes so/ /de nas rgya mo bzaḥ kyang / /rgyal po ra mo cher gdan drangs te/lha khang gzigs su phul bag gin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos 'phrul snang dang / ra mo che gnyis la rab tu gnas pa mdzad par dgongs nas/ dga' ston gyi chas rgya chen po dang / mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams te/ gdub/sa dang rgyal mtshan dang / rol mo sna tshogs pa dang brtsos nas/ de nas rgyalartepos dkyil 'khor gyi steng du byon/ phyag tu me tog bzung / thal mo sbyar te bden pa'i tshig brjoca— pa ni / rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang shāspya'i sras//

164 grangs med sprul pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// ston pa bde bar gshegs pa la sogs pa'i//phyogs bcu'i sangs gyes rnams kyis bdi legs stsol//thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i chu rgyun gyis//gang la gang 'dul smin cing grol bar mjod//rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs pa//byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bde legs stsol//rnam dag dri ma med pa rgyal ba'i bka'//bsdu ba rnam bzhis dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i// rgyal sras gnas brtan rab 'byor la sogs pa'i//'phags pa'i nyan thos rnams kyis bde legs stsol//gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad na//'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi//sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis//gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol//zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ dam pa chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad nyi zer gyi rdul tsam lhags te/ sprin dang na bun bzhin du 'thibs par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis me tog gtor nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod nas rab tu gnas par mdzad do/ /tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po phab cing / lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis kyang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / lhab lhub dang /

166rin po che'i phreng ba la sogs / 4'i rgyan du ma dang / lha'i rnga bo che dang /gling bu dang / khar rnga dang / cang te'u dang / rol mo'i tshogs du ma 'khrol zhing / lha'i spos dri zhim po sna/mas kyang / ma la ya'i rlung dal bus khyer ba ltar phyogs bcur khyab pas dri zhim mo/ /lha'i bu dang bu mo de rnams kyis sagrin gcig tu sgra phyung ste/sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa gcig bsdus pa'i//spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can//mtha' 'khob yul der bstan pa rgyas bya'i phyir//'phags pa khyed ni mi yi bdag por 'khrungs//rig gzugs yo na tan dpal gyis mngon par mtho//srong btsan sgam po sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku//chos —rgyal khyed spu/ gtsug lag khang gnyis la//sangs rgyas rnam gi kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad //byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod//lha rnams kun gyis mchod pa rgya chen phu'//nam mkha' la ni me tog char pa phab//bar snang la ni rnga/dug spos sprin bzhin gtibs // sa gzhi thams tsad rin chen gcal du bkram//sangs rgyas bsta sko pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par btsugs// dam pa chos kyi jeci chen dam pa brdung //de ring mkha' 'a/ chos kyi nyi ma shar//de ring dpal gyis sgron mes kun la khyab//de ring rgyal pos dbang bskur byin rlabs thob/ /

156 nyi ma'i 'od kyis mad+mo'i kha bye ltar//de ring blo yi mun pa rab tu bsal//dbul pos nor gyi gter kha rnyed pa bzhin// chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khyed kyis ni// thugs kyi dbang po dga' bdes tshim par mdzod//ces zer te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de ltar 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ rab tu gnas pa lhan gcig tu lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ /tshul de lta bu'i gsal la ngos bzung med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'am/ chu nang gi zla ba lta bur/ rje blon 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong bar gyur te/dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par gyur to/ /de ltar dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad nas/ bod 'bangs thams cad dang mthun par/ glu gar la sogs pa ltad mo bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad do/ /de'i dus su rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sar rin po che'i khri steng na bzhugs pa las/ yar la bzhengs te/tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu'i gsungs phyung nas/ rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs tha tsho thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum// thar pa'i lam ston spyan ras gzigs// ‘ gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs//bkra shis kyi glu le dgongs su gsol//de ring mdun gyi nam mkha' la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams//sprin phung lta bur bzhugs pa mthong //

157bkra shis rab ba/nas lhun gyis grub// rtsotshangs pa la sob/sa lha rnams kyis// sil snyan rol rma'i sgra yang 'khrol// me tog pad+ma'i zu ra bab pas//bkra shis rab ba/nas lhun gyis grub// sangs rgyas bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs//nag po'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal//bdud dpung b.reṭām pa'i mthu dpal gyis// ( —bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub// dam pa chos kyi jebyu chen brdung //dug lnga'i gti mug rang sar zhi//dkon mchog gardogam gyi rnga sgra yis// rmo bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub//de ring skyid pa'i nyi ma shar//rang dbang tre+ed pa'i dga' sems skyes//'dod dgu'i loju jus spyod char bzhin babs/ bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub// ༷—can dam lha 6/ bkra shis kyis//srong btsan sgam po bkra shis pas//bkra shis glu ru /bangs pa yin//nga yi bod 'bangs rnams la bkra shis shog/ces gsungs pa dang / btsun mo dang blon po bod 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad dga' zhing mgu la /) rangs par gyur nas// rgyal po la phyag byas

158shing mchod pa phul lo/ /de nas yang rgyal pos brag lha klu sbugs su lha khang bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo thub pa brag lha mgon po/ de'i g.yas na shā ri'i bu dang / g.yon na mong gal gyi bu/ de'i g.yas na byams pa/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs te/ gtso 'khor lnga brag la gsal bar byon na'ang/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can bsod nams bsog pa'i phyir du/ bal po'i lha bzos 'bur du brkos/ bskor khang brag la brko ba la/ bod 'bangs rnams kyis legs par brkos te/ tshwa la drug cu bed yod pa'i skabs su/ brag phye bre re phed pa la/ rgyal pos tshwa bre re brngan par byin/ /bre phyed tsam phed kyang /brag phye dang tshwa brje po byas te/ lha khang du lha'i ri mo la sogs pa legs par tshar nas rab tu genas pa mdzad do/ /lha sa rnam gnyis dang / mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa legs par tshar nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// // — bcu drug phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir/garter sbas pa dang bod 'bangs thams cad chos la bkod par mdzad pa'i skor/de nas rgya mo bza' dang b.lu mo bza' gnyis la sras ma 'khrungs par/zhang zhung bza' bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sral ma 'khrungs/ des thim bu skog pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ 'di lcags kha khong na yod/ de nas ru yong bza' bya ba khab tu bzhes/ /de la sras ma 'khrungs/ des mig mangs tshal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ 'di go sha snyidh+ra na yod/ de nagami nyag bza' bya ba khab tu

159bzhes/ de la'ang sras ma 'khrungs/ des kha brag gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/'di mkhar sna gdong na yod/ de nas stod lung mang gi nang nas/ mang bza' khri lcam bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras cig 'khrungs par lung bstan te/zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ sras gung ri gung btsan zhes pa/ rgyal po'i gdung brgyud 'gran zla dang braspru ba cig lcags mo sbrul gyi lo la brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yas khang du 'khu/ngas te/ btsas ston rgya chen po mdzad nas thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /yum sras de gnyis kyi thugs dam du yer pa'i gnas ri brag gi dbyibs ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i pang du lha khang dang mchod rten bzhengs te/ rab tu gnas pa mdzad nas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / /sgastan pa'i srog rtsa gcig par yab kyis smon lam btab bo/ /de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas par mdzad pa'i phyir du/ skrag cing 'jigs pa'i khrims ra 'chas te/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa byas pa dang / bod khrims las 'gal ba byas pa rnams la chad pa gcod pa yin no zhes bsgrags nas sprul ba mjod de/mi ma yin rnams la bcing ba dang / brdog pa dang / mig 'don pa dang /gyid pa gcod pa la sogs pa mdzad de/ don la grub pa med kyang / thams cad sngangs skrag bskyed pa'i thabs zu dzad nas/ dge bcu'i khrims la bkad do/ /de'i tshe li yul lcang ra smug po na/ dge tshul gnyis kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal lo brgyad kyi bar du bsgrubs pas/ ma 'grub par nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste/ dge tshul khyed gnyis dang 'jam dbyangs las 'brel med pas dngos grub brnyes par dka'/ khye/da gnyis kyi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ 'phags pa de da lta boju kyi kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na/ bod kyi rgyal po ru sku sprul yod/ der so5 dang lhal dngos su mjal bar yod do zhes lung

160 tshobastan te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de thos pa tsam gyis dge tshul gnyis po'i lus kyi ba spu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /lus dang srog la mi blta bar rgyags phye khur nas bod du 'ongs so/ /der stod lung mda' bgil ba'i 'phrang la slebs pa dang / chu'i 'gram na mi'i ro mgo med pa dang / mig med pa mang po bya khyis za 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der dge tshul gnyis the tshom du gyur te/ bod kyi mi la gtam byas nas/ rgyal po gang na bzhugs/ ro 'di rnams la ci byung ba yin byas pas/ bod kyi mi na re/ rgyal po lha sa na bzhugs/ ro 'di rnams khrims las 'gal ba la rgyal pos chad pa bcad pa yin zer bas dge tshul gnyis log lta skyes te/ spyan ras gzigs bdud du 'dug pa/ mi 'di tsam gsod pa/ nged rang gnyis log la 'dong zer te log go/ /der rgyal pos khong gnyis kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ blon po 'bri se ru gong ston la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rta zhon la mgyogs par song shig stod lung mda' na rab tu byung ba'i rtags mgo la skra med pa/ gos ngur smrig gru bzhi gon pa'i mi gnyis nga'i drung du 'ong rgyu yin pa log lta skyes nas phyir log song yod pas/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dir khrid shog gsung ngo / /der blon pos rjes zin te/ khong gnyis shin tu skrag par gyur pa la/ zhi ba'i gtam smras nas rgyal po'i drung du khrid 'ongs so/ /der rgyal pos dge tshul gnyis la phyag mdzad de/ de nas rgyal pos zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ dge tshul khyed gnyis kyis bod du ci la 'ong gsungs pas/ dge tshul gnyis na re/ nged gnyis li'i yul nas 'ongs pa yin te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal lo brgyad kyi bar bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par nam mkha' nal sgra byung ste khyod gnyis kyi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ /'phags pa de da lta bod kha ba ca na gyi rgyal khams na rgyal po cig tu sprul yod/ der song dang zhal dngos su mjal bar yod gsungs pas/

161nged gnyis kyis lus dang sroḥn la ma bltas par bod du 'ong ba yin/ lam kha na mi ro mang po 'dug pas /bod kyi mi la dris pas/ rgyal pos khrims las 'gal ba la chad pa gcod pa yin zer bas/ nged gnyis skrag nas phyir log pa yin zer ro/ /der rgyal spros khong gnyis la bza' btung gis tshim par byas nas/ dbu'i thod phud de/ a mi de ba'i zhal bstan nas/ nga ni bod kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po yin/ ngas rgyal srid bzung nas da lta phan la sems can la phan btags nas/ thar ji/ byang chub kyi lam la 'khod pa ma gtogs/ gnod pa khab rtse gang yang skyel ma spre/nga / bod kyi mi 'di rnams spre'u dang brag srin las chad pa yin pas/ drab/ po'i sprul pa byas pa yin gsungs te/ se gol brdab pas/ ro— rnams 'ja' yal ba bzhin song ngo / /der dge tshul gnyis dad cing gus par gyur te/ rgyal po chen po nged gnyis lam thag ring nas dka' ba spyad 'ongs pa chos ཿna sla ba'i phyir/ don gsum la 'dus pa'i gdams pa cig zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas dge tshul gnyis nyon cigachos thams cad kyi rtsa ba hri' gyis dril na don gsum la 'dus te/ lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa la sogs pa spangasartete/ dkon zu chog gsum gyi drung du phyag dang bskor ba gyis la/ bde 'gro mtho ris thob pa'i rten so tshul khrims kyi nor bu gces par 'dzin cig /bslab pa rin po che'i rgyan dang nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyis shigangag gi sgo nas rdzun phra ma/ : zig rtsub mo smra ba la sogs pa spangs te/ sangasi rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bsdus pa'i snying po/ dbe/ legs dang yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod/phan bde'i dngos grub thams 5da kyi rtsa ba/ gsung mchog yi ge drug pa la bzlas brjod gyis shig yid /kyi sgo nas brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log

162par lta ba la sogs spangs te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing /khams gsum rig drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ de rnams kyi sbrug bsngal bzod thabs med pa rnams rang gi rgyud thog tu len pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas shing / rang gi phan bde gang yod de rnams la ster la/ bdag pas gzhan gces bsgom pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan te/ mdor na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang skad cig kyang ma bral bar gyis shig chos bzang las bsam bzang lhag pa yin no/ /don 'di gsum dang ldan na tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /don 'di gsum rang rgyud la med na/ bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag thams cad blo la yod kyang / kha chos yin zhing snying po med gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos dge tshul de gnyis la thugs rje chen po'i chos skor gsum dang / mdo pad+ma dkar po dang / yi ge drug pa'i phan yon rnams gsungs nas/ thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'khod par mdzad do/ /de nas dge tshul gnyis po/ dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par gyur nas/ rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma chos rgyal sprul ba'i sku//ār+ya pā lo thugs rje can//yul du 'gro bas skyel ma zhu/ /zeratsabs rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed gnyis gigs med par skad cig la yul du sleb par 'dod dam gsungs pas/ dge tshul gnyis na re/ ci nas kyang dka' tshegs med par yul du sleb par 'dod lags zer bas/ rgyal pos khong gnyis kyi thu bar bye ma bre re blugs nas gser 'gyur gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ khong gnyis kyi mgo la phyag bzhag nas yo byad gang yod sngas su chug la/
