163khyed rang gnyis kyi yul yid la dran pa gyis la nyol cig gsung ngo / /der khong gnyis kyis de ltar byas nas nya spru bas gnyid thum pa cig song ba dang / khong rang gnyis kyi yul na sleb 'dug go/ /thu ba'i bye ma de gser du song / skye ba phyi mar de gnyis kyis dgra bathe ma pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /de nas sras gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes nas/ rgyal srid bzung btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas/ sras mang srong mang btsan bya ba me pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs so/ /gung ri gung btsan gyis rgyal srid lo lnga bzung / dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes dus/ po rtaste la ru sku gshegs so/ / gung ri gung ba na yab kyi gong du 'das//de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsig / —gral ni gnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod// ming— ni gung chen gung ri lags so skad// de nas slar skrub rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung ste/ bde skyid dang ldan par mdzad do/ / de nas —yang rgyal bo'i //gas la nga'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khing dang / rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du yon sna na dpag tu med pa dang ldan dgos te/ rin po che'i gling lta bu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma re yang tha mal pa'i gzugs su sprul nas rgyusna du gnas pa dang / bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad las mngon par mtho zhing mtha' yas pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ gdul bya longs spyod nam mkha' da nga ma 〉ma shing / gang la gang 'dod yid bzhin du 'byung ba/ mtha'i nor thams cad gnas 'dir 'du zhing / mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba/— bodartoyul / 'gran ’dang brari zhing / 'od dang 'od zer

164 phyogaso bcur khyab pa/ snyan pa dang grags pas ni sa'i steng thams cad khyab ste/byirno rlabs ni nyi zla'i 'od dang mtshungs/ rin po che dang / nor dang /'bru dang / gser dang / dngul dang / dbyig dang / rgyan dang / gos dang / zang zing gi longs spyod ni char bzhin du 'bab pa/ yon tan du ma dang ldan par byed pa la sa'i yon tan bltas nas gter sped dgos te/ de yang dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na/grong dang grong khyer ci yod kyang / de'i mthu la brten te/ 'byor pa dang ldan pa yod pa ltar/ rin po che'i gter yod pa'i gnas der yang / 'byor pa longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'ong bas/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod 'bangs rnams kyi don du gter sbas pa ni/ ka ba bum pa can dang nye ba'i sar/ dam pa chos kyi gter sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni bod kyi yul 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin 'byung ste/ dam chos la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /ka ba shing lo can dang nye ba'i sar/ gser dngul rin po che'i gter sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/d+ngha mtha'i nor thams cad dbus su 'du zhing / gser dngul la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /ka ba sbrul mgo can dang nye ba'i sar/ drag sngags mthu'i gter sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/ mtha' dmag dang / bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad mi 'byung bar 'gyurartero/ /ka ba seng mgo can dang nye ba'i sar/ byol ngo nga phyugs kyi g.yang yig rnams sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/ bzhon phyugs 'phel ba dang / dkar thog bcud dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che rat+na de ba/ gzi'i sgrom bur bcug nas dar zab sna lngas dril la dzalha la'i 'og tu sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni/ rgyan dang / gos dang / nor dang / 'bru la sogs pa gang la ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che stag sha de ba sbrul

165gyi pags pas gtums nas klu khang du sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs cing char chu du su 'bab ste/ sa bdag klu'i gnod pa mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /be+eḍūr+ya'i lhang bathed zas sna dpag tu med pas bkang ste/gnon sbyin khang par sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni/ gleza' btung gi longs spyod gang la ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung zhing / zas bcud dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang la zhig ral byung na gso ba dang / mchod pa rgyun ring por bya ba'i phyir/ gser dang dngul dang rin po che sna tshogs las zangs chen po cig bkang ste/ dkyil 'khor chenā po'i 'og tu sbas so/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la smon lam btab bo/ /gzhan yang sa cha 'od dang ldan pa dang / char chu dus su 'bab ste/ 'bru sna smin pa/ than pa dang / sad dang / ser ba ji/ nga / btsa' dang / mu ge mi 'byung ba dang /nad yamal dang / mtha' dmag gi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing / dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis shing / dge legs kyis khyab par bya ba'i phyir/rin po che gser dngul la so nas pa rnams rin po che'i sdod du dar zab sna tshogs kyis dril nas bcug tha/non sbyin khang pa dang / klu khang dang / lha khang gi nang skor thams cad du sbas so/ /'di dag ni zur tsam yin gyis/ gter sbas lugs rnams rgyas par shes 'dod na/ rgyal po bka'i thang yig la gzigs shig de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ gter 'di rnams sbas pa'i yon tan ni/nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di la rta/na pa dang grags pa ni nyi zlas spebs pa'i gnas su khyab ste/ 'dzam bu gling naji 'gran zla dang bralaspu yin no/ /gdul bya dang zhabs tog mtha' nas rgyas te/ mtha' mi thams cad dbang du 'dus nas/dpal 'byor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus su nga'i dbon sras dang / btsu na mo blon po bod 'bangs thams cad kyis gtsug lag

106khang bzhengs par 'dod na/ nga'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'dir sa phud dang / rdo phud bskyal na rab gnas lhun gyis grub cing bdud dang log 'dren gyi bgegs med par bkra shis shing yon tan du ma dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos lha sa ni'u thang du dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi dbu la phyag bzhag nas/ spang skong phyag brgya pa dang / mdo pad+ma dkar po dang / dam chos zla ba sgron ma dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub skor bshad rgyud rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa gab pa mngon du phyung ba dang /lha sar zhabs tog byas pa/ phyag dang mchod pa bskor ba byas pa/ mthong thos dran reg gi yon tan bstan pa/ phyi'i rag gso ba dang / nang gi lha la zhabs tog byas pa la phan yon yod pa rnams legs par gsungs te/ sras kyis yi ger bris nas gnon sbyin khang par gter du sbas so/ /gzhan yang nga nas gdung rabs lnga pa na/ rgyal po khri dang lde sges bya ba 'byung ste/ de'i dus su rgya gar nas paṭī ta mang po byon nas/ dam pa'i chos thams cad bsgrur zhing yang dag par gtan la 'bebs/ gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ rab tu byung ba bslab pa ga sum gyi rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes pa/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba mang po 'byung bar 'dug ste/ nga'i dbon sras rnams kyi dbu'i mchod gnas byed/'tsho ba blang(bla)nas sbyor phan bde dang dge legs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ blon po mgar gyis de ma thag tu zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas/ 'ching phu'i dkor mdzod du sbas so/ /gzhan yang phyi blon/nang blon/ bod 'bangs kyi skyes pa dang bud med/ — byis pa yan la rim pa bzhin du 'jig rten la dgos pa'i zhal gdams dpag tu med pa gsungs nas/thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rim gyis/ yi ge drugapa'i chos la bkod do/ ('di

167yang blon po 'bri se ru gong ston gyis/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod 'bangs rnams la phan pa'i snyir yi ger bris bzhag go/)gzhan yang rgyal po nyid kyi rnam thar rnams la rgyas 'bring gsum du mdzad/ shog dril gsum byas nas ka ba bum pa can gyi 'og tu sbas te/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang je/ga la smon lam btab bo/ /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo 'i mjod pa tham sa cad yongs su rdzogs te/ bod kha ba can pa'i re zhing stos pa'i pha ma lta bu/ glegrornab sgrol ba'i ded dpon lta bu/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu lta bu/ mun pa sel ba'i sgron me lta bu/ nye ring med pa'i nyi zla lta bur mdzad de/ las thabs mkhas pas phyi na dgra med/ bka' drin bzang pos nang gi 'bangs rna 5sa skyongs/ mnga' 'og gi bod 'bangs thams cad 'byor pa dang ldan zhing / dga' bde la longs spyod do/ / phan pa dang bde ba thams cad 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gter sbas pa dang bod 'bangs thams cad chos la bkod par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //bcu bdun/ rgyardusdo po lab um gyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs te/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal rgya thug ri kar thim pa'i skor/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ lha thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong baṇidi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la/ sras gung srong gung btsan gyis/ nang par nyi ma shar ba dang dbu rtse'i yang thog tu yab rgyal po chen po la rang gi na bza' la bzhugs gdan byas nas zhal zas mang po

168 drangs/ phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas zhu ba 'di skad ces gsol to/ / e ma ho//sangs rgyas kune gyi 'phrin las// snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs rje//bde ba can kyi pho nya// bod 'bangs yongs kyi skyabs gnas//bdag cag kun la thugs rjes gzigs pa yi//rgyal ba'i sku dang tha mal mjal/zab mo'i thugs dgongs snang mod kyang //chos nyid don gyi thugs rje de//rgyal ba'i thugs la mi gab par//gab pa mngon du phyung nas ni//chi rang snang yul med bstan du gsol//blo 'das byar med bstan du gsol//ma bcos ngang nas bstan nas kyang //byar med ngang gis gnas pa la//sku gsum shugs las 'char ba yi//bdag cag blo la sbyar du gsol//zhes phyag 'tshal te zhus pa dang / der yab rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lha sras chen po nyon cig tsho bdag ni sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las yin//snang ba mtha' las(yas)drung du dam yang bcas//byang chub sems kyi bod 'bangs don la 'ong //

169nga dang rgyal bsab/nyis su med// 'gro ba nga yi gdul bya yin// khyed kun 'phagaḥ5 pa'i byin rlabs yin//rgyal ba'i dgong/ci rgyud zab mo rnams//'phags pa'i la spru steg yin mod kyang // chos nyid don dzegyi thugs rje de// blo dman rnams ra bstan par mi 'os kyang // brtse ba'i sems kyis gab pa mngon phyung 'di//ma rtogs sgro dang skur ba'i gzhi//skyabs med rnam/5 la ye gsang chod//tsista snying gi dkyil du chongs// chos nyid zad paju skyel ba yang /nga yis legs par bstan gyis nyon//sna tshogs dag kyang rang snang yin//yul med de ni ṇisgyu las 'das// blo 'das de ni dra/ra med yin//ji bzhin pa yi khuci nga gnas yin//cho gnas pa med pa rdo stod pa'i mchog/ de ltar go ba'i tha/nga zag gis//mtha' bras spros pa chod pa la// lta ba'i ming du spre/tags pa yin//rang gsal 'dzin pa stong pa la //sgom pa ming du nga/tags pa yin//

170 don dang bral ba med pa la// spyod pa ming du btags pa yin// spang blang 'dzin pa zhig pa la// 'bras bu ming du btags pa yin//rtsol med 'gro don byed pa la// thugs rje ming du btags pawaṃn//de la skyo dub med pa la// chen po ming du btags pa yin//'gro don mdzad kyang skyon ma gos// —'phags pa ming du btags pa yin//snying rje dbang du 'dus pa la//rgyal po ming du btags pa yin//'gro ba'i kha lo stoms pa la /srong btsan ming du btags pa yin// blo la gang phan bshad pa la//gdams ngag ming du btags pa yin//brjed tho shul du bzhag pa la// bka' brgyud ming du btags pa yin//'gro ba dang ba 'dren pa la//gtsug lag ming du btags pa chan//rnam rtog rang sar grol ba la// sangs rgyas ming du btagaza pa yin//'arge ba lam du 'dzud pa la//

171dam chos ming du btags pa yin//byar med blo la /spyor ba la//dge 'dun ming du btags pa yin//rtsol med rang lugs gnas pa la//byar med ming du btags pa yin//tha mal rtog pa nge/sgyur ba la//bskyed rim ming du btags pa yin// blo yi khrid thabs sna tshogs pa// chos spyod ming du btags pa yin// rtsa bral nang du ce/sa pa —la// go ba ming du brta gas pa yin// don go gcig lag zad pa la / nyag gcig ming shu/ btags pa yin//du ma ngo bo gcirnga/ dzil// chos sku ming du ji/tags pa yin// dag snang lha ru sna/nga ba la//longs sku ming du btags pa yin// 9sna tshogs thabs /kyil 'dren pa la//sprul sku ming du ba/tags pa yin//rtog med rang sa zin pa la//mngon 'gyur ming du btags pa yin// btags pa thams cad ming yinaci gyis// ming gi 'dzin pa ted phaza zhog /

172 bsam pa thams cad blo yin gyis//blo yi byed pa zhog la spong // zhog ces bya ba tshig yin gyis//tshig gi 'dzin pa bor la thong //thong zhes bya ba blo yin gyis//blo yi byed pa dbyings su sbos/ / sped pa bya ba bzang rtog yin//bzang ngan med par khad de ba// gab sbas med par lha nge ba// 'gro 'ong med par gsal le ba//spang blang med par lhug ge ba//phyogs ris med par phyam me ba// btang bzung med par khyil le ba//gsal 'grib med par lhang nge ba// brjed yeng med par tur re ba// rigatang bzhag med par wal le ba// blo las 'das pa'i yul la stos//tshig las 'das pa'i don la stos//bzang ngan med pa'i yul la stos//snyi nang med par sems la sto //pho mo med pa'i sems la stos//gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i don la stos//don zhes bya ba blo las 'das//

173'das pa'i rjes su ma 'brang bar//blo tshig bral ba'i ngang la stos// bltas pa'i mthoḥsngu pa'i yul med kyis//ma bltas bzhag pas chos nyid mthong //ma bsgrub gzhag pas sems nyid grub//ma bzung ma glod rang sar grol// de ltar mthong ba'i gang zag la//'khor 'das ga//jus su ngas mar+ṣamathong //dge sdig gnyis su ngas ma mthong // bzang ngan gnyis/ su ngas ma mthong //rtag chad gnyis /rgya ngas ma mthong // pho mo gnyis su /spras ma mthong / bde sdug gnyis su ngas ma mthong // yin min gnyis su ngas ma mthong //nye ring gnyis su ngas ma mthong //mthon dman garnya/sa su ngas ma mthong // gsal 'grib ga me+es su ngas ma mthong //mthong ba med pa'i ngang nyid /nas//sna tshogs shar ba rang nyid yin//mi sna tshogs 'gag pa med par thog/snacichogs 'dzin pa med par zhogarte sna tshogs spang blang med par zhog/sna tshogs 'dzin bral chos sku zhin7/

174 ma 'gags gsal ba longs sku yin// sna tshogs bral ba sprul sku yin// citha mal rtog med chos sku yin//chos nyid 'dod pa tha mal yin//blo las 'das pa de nyid yin// —'dod pa bral na don dang bral/(gnyis 'dzin grol na ga/nas su rtogs// spang blang med na dengos grub thob//'gro don byed na phrin las rdzogs//blo thag chod no 'gro sar phyin// gyen pa med na brdol ba yin// de lta bu yi gang zag la/ /rig pa thams cad bang rig yon// shes pa thams cad rang shes yin// grol ba thams cad rang grol yin// gsal ba thams cad rang gsal yin//stong pa thams cad rang stong yin// 'dug pa thams cad rang 'dug yin//gnas pa thams cad rang gnas yin// bde ba thams cad rang bde yin//sdug bsngal thamasarketsad rang sdug yinaṣi/ thams cad rang rig rang snang yin// sgom du med pas bsam du med//

176rgyud la byar med :bangs su med—//bzhag rgyu med de btang rgyu med// brjed rgyu med de sgor rgyu med//ye shes de la rgyun chad med//ting nge 'dzin la ri /na mtshams med//dmigs pa la yang btang bzung med// rnam rtog la yang ཿbzang ngan med//yid yul la yang / ge nang med// dngos med la yajici phyi nang med//re dogs spangs zho skyon dang bral//'dod pa med pab/ thob pa med//rtsol ba med pas /skyon rnams sangs// 'bras bu la re mkhan med pas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhig bsam brjod blo las 'das pas smra ba'i ngag ཿ5nga bral/ de ltar du rang dbang thob tsa na/brgyud pa rang gis zin/ grol zumi nang nas rnyed/ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma zhigasnang srid bka' brgyud du shes/ byed spyod chos spyod du 'gro/ mthong thos sku gsum du byon/ ye shes nang na 5 brtol/ nyon mongs kun rang lar dgadad gus rang la tshud do/ /'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang rig tu shes/ skyid sdug gsal 'debs su shes/ ཿsnadag 'dzin chos spyor grol lo/ /gzhi mthong bas lta ba med/ rtsad chod pas sgom du med/ rang sa zin pas sgrub tu med/rang sems ngo shes pas sangs sbyo/sa med do/ /shes rab rang brdol du byon pas/ wal bo brjed med du 'dug pa/ sna tshogs 'gag med du grol ba/tshor ba rjes med du sangs pas/ rig pa glan sar chags pas/ chos sku

176gcer mthong du grol ba/ rige pa rkyang ded du 'dug pas gnyis su med pa'i sku/ rang snang chen po'i ngang la lus so/ /rang byung du yin pas lhun grub tu byung / rang gsal yin pas gting gsal du shar/ rang snang yin pas 'od gsal du snang / rang rig yin pas chos skur byung / rang grol yin pas zangs thal du byung ngo / /de yang rang gis ma byas par gzhan byed dam/ rang la bsam du med par gzhan la mtshon du rnyed dam/ rang ma rig par sems can thul la ma/ 'du 'bral med par btsal bas rnyed dam/ phyin pa med par bsdad pas zin nam/ dngos po med par lag tu lon nam/ bstan rgyu med par mig gis mthong ngam/ da lta nga la yod pa'i steng la tshol lam/ gsal ba'i steng la lta'am/ grol ba'i steng la bshigs sam/ dag pa'i steng la 'khru'am/ ngoms pa'i steng la 'thung ngam/ 'grang ba'i steng la za'am/ dros pa'i steng la sreg gam/ shes pa'i steng la 'thams sam/ de ltar sems la rgyu rkyen bral bas rtsol sgrub kyi blo dang bral te/ dngos med la gnyen pos bcos su 'dug gam/ long med kyi snang ba ma thos pas/ rtag chad kyi snang ba rang sar dag gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol bsad(bas)re dogs kyi mtha' spang /zhen 'dzin nang nas grol bas skye med rang sa zin/ rtog med nang nas mthong bas dgra bgegs rang sar thul lo/ /'o de ltar du rig pa rgya yan gnyen po med pa la ye shes rang snang gi spyod pa zer ba yin no/ /rtog med rang lugs gnas pa la spang blang med pa zer ba yin no/ /ye shes nang nas shar ba la rnam rtog rang grol zer ba yin no/ /yin min blo las 'das pa la dgag sgrub bral ba zer ba yin no/ /—'bad rtsol ngos zin pa la chos nyid klong brdol zer ba yin no/ /lhun grub skye ba med pa la 'bras bu rang shar zer ba yin no/ /'o de ltar du go ba dang rtogs pa dus mnyam/ shes pa dang— grol ba dus mnyam/

177gsal ba dang mthong ba dus mnyam/ 'byar dang reg pa dus mnyam/ brlan pa dang gsher ba dus mnyam/ shedi de ltar shes pa'i gang zag gis/ lta ba la phyogs ris med kyis nam mkha' gon/ sgom pa la gsal 'grib med kyis nyi ma khur/ spyod pa la thog brdug me/sko kyis rlung la zhon/ 'bras bu la blang dor med kyis gser gling stos/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ lta ba la lta rgyu gda' ye/ bsgom pa la bsgom rgyu gda' ye/ spyod pa la spyod rgyu gda' ye/'bras bu la bsgrub rgyu gda' ye/ dzha des na rig pa gshis thog tu gyil/ mtshan ma rang grol du thong / phyi nang ཿna 'dzin pa shigs/ bzang ngan gyi blang dor spangs/ chags zhen gyi 'dzin pa khrol/ bzang 'dod kyi nga rgyal thong / 'gran sems kyi phrag dog khrol/ zhe sdang gi me chen gsod/ gti mug gi ma rig pa sangs/ byar med kyi ngang la ye/ngas med du rgog gnyis 'dzin gyi blo ni nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyas thob/ k+ṇido na la bsgom rgyu med kyis rang sar zhog 'o de lta bu'i gang zag gis/ 4 bskyed rim bsgom na yi dam lha ru 'gyur//rdzogs rim dran na gzung 'dzin mtshan ma zhig/ zung 'brel 'dod na bar snang 'ja' tshon stos//don go mthong na spu mal chos mi ltos// ma mthong bar du bka' brgyud bla ma bsten//chos spyod byed na ཿri nga 'dod zhen pa spangs//mi 'jig go cha 'dod na sgo gsum lha ru bsgyur//gzhan don byed na 'gro la phan sems bskyedi//rang don bsgrubal na 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba spongs//dgra bgegs 'dur na rtsa blol snying rje bskyed//

178 phyi ma bde 'bras 'dod na da lta dka' ba spyod//'gro ba dbang du sdud na bdag pas gzhan gces gyis//stom las dran na 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom//chags zhen 'dzin pa byung na rmi lam sgyu ma bsgom//bar chad bdud kyis bred na rang sems gtan la phob//chos bzhin byed na chos min thams cad spong //nga dang 'grogs kyang de las med// sangs rgyas gzhan dang mjal yang de bas med//ces chos skyong ba'i rgyal pos dgongs pa mngon du phyung ba dang / de nas dus de nyid du lha sras rje 'bangs thams cad chos nyid rang shar rang grol chen po'i gling du 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par grol lo/ /dus de nyid du bde sdug la spang blang med/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan med/ 'di phyi la gdams kha med par 'phags pa rnams kyi zhal mthong bya mthong byed med par mi la mis blta ba bzhin gzigs so/ /de ltar mi thams cad rig pa rang shar rang grol gyi dgongs pa la/ gzhag bya dang 'jog byed med par byas par gyur to/ /de nas lha sras rje 'bangs thams cad rjes su yi rang ste phyi nang gi mchod pa rgya chen pos yab rgyal po mnyes par mdzad nas shin tu drin gzo'o/ /de nas yang dar gcig yab rgyal po nyid dgongs pa la bzhugs nas ci yang mi gsung bar/spyan bar snang la khrol khrol mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /ag sam rgyal sras chen po gson cig/lan cig dus kyi tha ma la//nga yi lha sa'i gnasakonazhi 'di//nya 'dra sbal 'dra 'jong 'dra sprel yang 'dra//

179rim pa bzhin du khyu yis gcod par byed//nya 'dra rgyal ba yudzo spru gyi rang bzhin yin// ras ris phyogs nga/cu'i sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra//rgyal bas rgyal ba'i zhabs tog mdzad pa yin//nya 'dra kha ru de ji ga su yod pa// rgyal ba'i yum la sdig dang khyad par med// de yang sngon du sbyangs pa song ba yin/ /'khor ba'i sdug nga/sngal mtha' ru phyin pa yin//'bad pa don chen yin no bod 'bangs rnams//rdo bang gseg ma 'jim pa bya sgong tsam //gang zhig de yi phyogs su spung byed pa//sangs rgyas rnams la sman ba byas pa yin//de yang bde ba'i /sprum la tshud pa yin//nga yi rig can rna sa kyis bkur ba'i tshe//nya 'dra'i dus su dzi/zhog ltar bsgron pa yisgo//sbal 'dra'i dus su zha(zhwa)ltar bkon pa yin//'jong 'dra'i du sa su gdan ltar 'ding ba yin//sprel 'dra'i dus su gzugs su gyur tsa na//rgya chen mchod pa /bshams nas ni// mos gus gsol 'debs gces pa yin//de ltar byas na cuḥri zhig gnas par 'gyur// nang gi lha rnams ba/sos na phyi yi ra ga la phan// phyi yi rag rnams /nasgong na nang gi lha rnams dgyes//

180 mchod pa bshams shing gsol ba btab byas na//bod 'bangs bsam pa thams cad 'grub pare 'gyur/ dus kyi tha ma sdig spyod mang mod kyang //nga yi lha sa mthong thos reg pa yi// 'gro ba phal cher 'khor ba'i gnas nas thar//de yang 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rje ste//nga yi bod 'bangs rnams kyi bsod nams yin//de phyir nga yi skyabs gnas pho mo rnams//rtsol ba ma zhen snying stobs bskyed mdzod la//nga yi lha sa mthong thos reg par mdzod//de yang thar pa'i lam la btsud pa yin//skyon rnams thams cad sel bar 'dod pa dang //yon tan gang zhig bsgrub par 'dod pa yi//nga yi lha sa zhabs tog mos byas pas// skebasam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur//ji ltar 'dod pa rgyal ba rnams la zhus//zhes yab rgyal po chen pos lha sras la bka' stsal pa/ lha sras chen po pa/ dus lan cig lha sa la chus nyen nas/ gso dgos pa yod par 'dug pas/ de'i zhig gsos kyi theb la/ gser dngul la sogs dkor nor rnams gter du sbos shig gsungs pa dang / de nas lha sras kyis kyang lha sar zhabs tog bya thabs dang / gser dngul dang dkor nor la sogs pa nor mang po dus de nyid du/gnod sbyin na ga ku be ra'i brla g.yas kyi dar sham 'og tu gter du sbas nas las dang skal par ldan pa'i gang zag la gtad rgya smon lam btab bo/ /des

181kyang lho dang nub kyi phyogs su 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gab pa mngon phyu:rnga du gdams pa'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po de/ dgung lo bdun cu tham pa spre /la sa bzung/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad/ 'dod yon dang longs spyod kyi char pa phab/ bod 'bajici sa thams cad bde ba la bkod/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis pa lcags pho /k+ṇi'i lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu la 'phrul snang gi btsan khang byang mar 'phaḥnas pa spyan ras gzigs kyi drung du/ sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgom po rje/ 'i g.yas su bal mo bza'/ g.yon du rgya mo bza'/ rgyab tu mang bza' khri khri/ma/ zhabs drung du dbon sras mang srong mang btsan/ mdun du blon po thon chi/ dang mgar gnyis/ lha khang phyi'i sgo srung la/zhang blon sna chen po dang / sbus lcang dpal gyi pags bzang gnyis kyis sgo bsrungs/ mchod rdzas du ma thogs te/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi drung du mchod pa phul nas smon lam btab bo/ /ཿshe nas rgyal pos dbon sras la bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu ngas ni rgyal khrims skyos khrims su bsgrur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod pa yin no/ /khyod kyis kyang nga'i rgyal srid 'di ma nyams par chos bzhin du skyongs shig nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di gnyis kyi zhabs tog khyod kyis gyis la/ dar du chug ciganga'i pho brang lha'i gnas dang 'dra ba 'di'i 'dzin skyong gyis shig nga'i btsun mo dang / blon po pod 'bangs thams cad re zhing stos pa'i pha ma lta bu gyis la/phan pa dang bde bas khyab par ji/sa shig —nga nas gdung rab sa lnga pa la// 'jam dpal dbyaji sa kyi sprul pa ste//rgyal po sde(lde)zhe bya ba 'byu nga //ca4 —

182des kyang dam chos rgyas par byed//de nas gdung rabs gnyis pa la//phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste//rgyal po khri zhes bya ba 'byung //des kyang dam chos rgyas par byed//de nas bdud kyi sprul pa ste//rgyal po dud 'gro'i ming can 'byung // (glang dar ma yin/)de yi thugs la gdon gsol nas//lha khang skyel zhing dam chos bsnub//sde sgod 'dzin pa'i srog kyang gcod//chos mdzad thams cad bsad cing bcom//glegs bam thams cad me la bgregs//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dkrug shing des//bla ma slob dpon bran du bskul/ rab byung btsun pa chos dang phral // dge bshes rnams la shan pa bcol // sangs rgyas na spuzablo chu la bskur//rten gsum mchod cha rdo yis brdungs// chos kyi ming kyang med par byed/ /de nas yer pa'i brag khung na// phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste//dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gis//sdig can rgyal po sgrol bar 'gyur/ /

183de nas lo skor ba /da kyi bar// sangs rgyas bstan pa med par gyur//ma ma sems can snying re rje//nga yi yi dam 'di rnams kyang //gtsug lag khang 'dir gter bzhin sped//de nas lnga brgya tha ma la//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i me ro zhig/mdo khams sgang nas longs par 'gyur//kha ba can pa'i sezu/sa can la//mar me 'chi khar /gsal ba bzhin//bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur// dad can mchod pa 'bul ba dang //phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed par 'gyur//rab byung btsun pa mang po dngarna//sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar 'gyur//zhes gsungaso te byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /'di dag na zur tsam yin gyis/ ma 'ongs (/nga bstan gyi zhal gdams rgyas par jo bo rjes gter nas thon pa'i ka khol ma /) ba na gsal lo/ /de nas dar cig lon pa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i /smi nang gi blon po bod 'bangs rnams nga rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang mjal ji/ra 'dod do zer du 'ong gi nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob cig nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /yang bal mo bza' khri btsun gyis kyang /zhal phyir log mdzad nas/ casnad 'bangs blo nye ba rnams nga bal mo bza' khri

18 — ——btsun dang mjal bar 'dod do zer du 'o nga gi nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na jo mo khro gnyer can la gsol ba thob cig nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /yang rgya mo kong jo zhal phyir log mdzad nas/ bod 'bangs nga la zhen che zhing dga' ba rnams la/ rgya mo kong jo dang mjal bar 'dod do zer du 'ong gi/ /nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba thob cig /nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /der blon po mgar gyis rgyal po chen po 'di tsam pa'i zhal gdams gsungs pa yab yum gsum gar 'byon zhus pas/ nged gsum po thag rings su mi 'gro gsungs te/rgyal po yar la bzhengs nas/ phyag g.yas pa bal mo bza' khri btsun la reg pas/ khri btsun me tog ut+pa la dkar po cig tu gyur nas/ rgyal po'i sku phrag g.yas su thim mo/ /phyag g.yon rgya mo kong jo la reg pas/ kong jo me tog ut+pa la sngon po cig tu gyur nas/ rgyal po'i sku phrag g.yon du thim mo/ /de nas rgyal po rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du phyin te/ 'phags pa la bstod pa/chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las// 'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i sku //zhi ba'i zhal thabasgo khro zhal bdun// bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo//rtsa ba'i zhiri zhal dkar po gsum//rab tu 'dzum zhing mdzes pa ste//las dang nyon mongs zhi mdzad pa//chos sku'irte zhal la phyag 'tshal lo//de steng btso ma gser mdog can//

tsho 185rngams pa'i zhal gsum bzhad pa'i dpal//tshe dang bsod na mas dpal 'byor gsum//rgyas pa ra mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//de steng byi ru ltar dmar ba'i//dbang gi las mdzad zhal gnyis po(/ rnam par gtseg ci pa'i khro gnyer can//longs sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo//de steng drag po'i las mdzad pa//dud sprin mdog 'dra zhal gnyis po// 'jigs shing rngazusprus pa'i spyan gsum bgrad//sprul sku'i zhal la phyag 'atsāl lo//de steng bla ma spru sga pa'i sku//sangs rgyas kun 'dus li khri'i mdog/'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba yi//gtsug rgyan can la phyag 'tshal lo// mi pad+ma4'dab 'arngokyi dang po yi//phyag gnyis thugab/ gar thal sbyar nas//sangs rgyas kun gyi thugaso rje rnams0 bskul bar mdzaḥkyi la phyog 'tshal mo/༈g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rim padzisazhin// bgrang phreng 'khoḥri lo mchohwasbyinadzhadab /r+ghaṃ dro — dus gsum sang cas zlod3dzig med/༈ pa 4 legs par bsna /sa la myabata'azhe la lo//chi bye

186 g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin//pad dkar spyi blugs rin po che//thabs shes zung 'jug mda' dang gzhu//legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo /g.yas kyi yan lag bcu dgu na// rin chen zhags dze+e lhung bzed gri//rdo rje me shel chu shel gzhu//lhug ma bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rnga yab phub dang bum pa bzang //dgra sta phreng ba pad+ma sngo//spyi blugs nyi ma chu skyes dkar//snye ma bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//g.yon gyi yan lag bcu dgu na//sprin dkar spyi blugs pad+ma gri//dung thod phreng ba dril bu dang //rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tsha la lo// lcags kyu khar gsil sprul pa'i sku// khang bzang glegs bam 'khor lo dang //sku gzugs shing thog ge sar bcas//rin chen bsnams la mig 'tshal lo//chos sku'i ca phyaga'irna rdzopo bcu// sto longs sku'i yan lag sum cu brgyad// sprul sku'i nying lag stong mnga' ba'i//

187nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod 'khu'adud//pad+ma lta bu'i phyab/ mthil la//ut+pal 'dra ba'i spyan mig gis//rgyu skar bzhin du rnam bkra ba'i// —nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud// dbu la rgyal ba'i gtsug rgyan bcas//phyag zhabs gse pa gyi gdu bu 'khrol//sku la dri zhim spo sa ngad ldan// nam mkha'i rgyal sgo khyod la 'dud// sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' gsol// rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras//blta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku//nam mkha'i rgyal /sgo khyod la 'dud// ri dwags spags pas nu ma bkab// yan lag rigs /bzhi'i sbrul gyis brgyan// mtshan dpe gzi brjed 'bar ba'i sku//nam mkha'i rgyal lhaspro khyod la 'dud// gangs ri'i ngogab/ ltar mdzes pa la//cung zad dmardo rnga/'i mdangs dang ldan//thugs rje'i 'od ཿshekar 'asbo ba'i sku// nam mkha'i rgyal spre 4 khyod la 'dud// lha rgyal gtsug gi nor bu yis//rna legs par bzhengs pacanalha ba bganyis po//

188pad zla'i steng du 'gying ba'i sku// nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis(kyi)// thugs kyi sprul pa rin po che// thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa khyed// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol//— 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas khyed// sdug bsngal du mas gtses paskab// nyam thag phongs pa'i sems can la//thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams// las ngan bsags pas lus ngan blang // ngan song gsum du snang ba rnams//thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol//zhes gsungs te/ /dbu'i la thod phud nas/ yi dam gyi thugs kar gtugs nas/ 'phags pa khams gsum 'khor ba na 'khyams pa'i sems can nyam thag pa rnams la gzigs shig ces dad pa'i shugs kyis spyan chab phyung nas/ gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i ngang la/ rgyal po 'od du zhu nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim mo/ /('phags pa'i thugs kar phyag gnyis thal mi sbyar ba la/ kha phye nas yod pa de'ang de dus su byung ba yin no//) de ltar thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong yang bya thabs med par gcig gdong gcig la blta zhing / mig hu re lus so/ /de nas mang bza' khri lcam gyis/ rgyal po yabo yum gsum de ltar mdzad nas mi bzhugs na/ da ji ltar byed/ su la re thugs rjes gzung du

189gsol zhes zhus pas/ rang nyusnyen gyi thugs ka nas rgyal pos dbu nyug mdzad de 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /khyed rnams nyon cig skyes nas 'chi thag chod pa dang gcig 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin pa dang gnyis/ tshe la long med pa rtswa kha'i zil pa lta bu dang gsum/ da lta'i spyod lam 'di rnams rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /bal mo bza' khri btsun kyang / nu ma g.yas pa'i steng nas dbu nyug mdzad de 'di skad gsungs so/ /tshe la nges pa med pa nam mkha(sde 'ja' tshon lta bu dang gcig ngag la nges pa med pa bar snang gi 'brug lta /rirgya dang gnyis/ lus la nges pa med pa sos ka'i me tog lta bu dang gsum/ ཿkyi lta'i spyod pa 'di me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /rgya mo kong jo nu ma g.yon pa'i steng nas dbu nyug mdzad de 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lus mi rtag spra sdong rgan rtsa ba rul pa lta bu dang gcig tshe mi rtag pa nam mkha'i glog sprin lta bu dang gnyis/ nor mi rtag pa sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi lta bu dang gsum/ da lta'i spyod pa 'di chu'i lha ba lta bur shes pashāri mdzod cig gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas blon po gnyis kyis rgyal po chin po de ltar mdzad nas mi bzhugs na/nged phyi nang gi blon po/ bod ‘sgyubangs rnams ci ltar byed/ thugs rjes gzung du gsoX zhes zhus pas/ yang rgyal pos dbu nyug mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs so/ / legs por nyon ṭīg bdag gi 'khor lke'abangs rnams//tshe 'di mi rtagasgyu/ / kha'i zil pa 'dra/de la stom las 'e/ lo ma byed cig / 'chi bdag bdung ni ri gzar chu dang 'dra//de la long yod rtag par ma 'ardzon cig/

190sgro lus phung po sos ka'i rmedzitogasmo'adra//me tog sad kyis nam khyer nges pa med//tshe 'di'i bya ba spang la dam chos nedzod// mi rtag 'chi bar bsams la brtson 'grus bskyed//nga dang khyed rnams 'bral medartertag tu 'grogs// gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der khong rnams gcig la gcig lta zhing /yab yum gsum sprul pa'i skur 'dug pa la/ bzhugs pa'i dus mos gus chung 'dug ces smra zhing yod pa la/ zhang blon sna chen po dang / sbas lcang dpal gyi legs bzang gnyis byung ste/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gar bzhud ces lan gsum zer ba la/ yab yum gsum de ltar mdzad/ yi dam la thim pa bshad kyang yid ches mi 'ong bsams te/ 'chad ma shes nas gcig gdong gcig la blta zhing mig hu re lus so/ /der khong gnyis khros te/ rgyal po yab yum gar bzhud lan gsum dris pas mi 'chad par ngan pa khyed gnyis gsod pa yin zer nas ral gri phyung bas/ der mang bza' na re/ rgyagopo yab yum sprul pa'i skur 'dug pa/ yab yum gtsum kha rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim nas bzhud do zer nas ngus pas/ /de la yang yid ma ches par dbon sras la zhus pas/ der dbon sras kyitshos/ dang por zhal gdams rgyas par gsungs pa/ de rjes btsun mo gnyis rgyal po la thim pa/ de nas mes rgyal po yang yi dam kyi thugs kar thim pa sogs rgyas par gsungs pas/der khong gnyis kyang yid ches so/ /der blon po thon mis rgyal po sprul ba'i skur 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khru 'brug tu ban sprang la a mi de ba'i zhal bstan pa dang / li yul gyi dge tshul gnyis la a mi de ba'i zhal bstan pa/ lha sa'i rab gnas mdzad dus rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ skad cig la sangs rgyas

191dang byangarkachub sems dpa' rnazu sa mngon sum du nam mkha' la byon pa la sogs pa bshad pas/ der thams cad yid ches te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos yin par 'dug pa/ yab yum gsum bzhugs pa'i dus su mos gus chung 'dug zer te/ chos ཿ spyol sprul pa'i sku zer zhing thams cad mya ngan gyis sa la 'gyel lo/ /der yang lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste/ sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rje / nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa brgyad byung ste/ 'od ther gcig jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i thugs kar thim/(li ma ) 'od zer gcig byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kar thim/(li ma/) 'od zer gcig sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim/ 'od zer gcig sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar thim/'od zer gcig khro rgyal smi ba ཿsgartsegs kyi thugs kar thim/ 'od zer gcig sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po'i thugs kar thim/ /('og khang shar sto'i g.yu rung khug na yod bris sku/)'od zer gcig rta mgrin dkar po'i thugs kar thim/ (bris sku bar khang na yod/) 'od zer gcig rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs kar thim/ /(bris sku bar khang na yod/)de rnams ni 'od zergyu ri 'phros pa'i lha brgyad yin no/ /yang lha de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od ze pa 'phros pas lha khang nang gi lha thams cad la phog nas/ 'od zer gyi dra bas 'brel bar gyur to/ /de ni 'phrul snang gi gsang ba'i rab gnas lhun gyiru/ rgyab pa yin no/ /de nas dbon sras dang /btsun mo blon po la sogs de zu/ yod pa thams cad mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal zhi nas/ zag med kyi bde ba la ཿkanas par gyur to/ /de nasu blon po thams cad gros byas te/ sras gung ri gung— btsanaci ni yab kyi god du 'das/ dbon sras ni chung bang so brtsigs dgos pas/ hwamabalhum gsum pho rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim pa gas rnga stekhrispyo skephanachi yul stol dzemo lhang du 'das pa yin

192 no zhes phyogs bcur bsgrags nas/ yar lung 'chong po'i nang du yab yum gsum ga'i bang so/ 'gran zla dang bral bar brtsigs so/ /rgyal po yab yum gyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs te/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// // 6 de ltar sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po de//dgung lo bdun cu tham pa rgyal sa bzung //lha khang bzhengs shing dam chos rgyas par mdzad//dkon mchog zhabs tog bka' khrims chos la bsgyur//dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhes pa na//le lo can rnams brtson 'grus bskyed pa dang //stom las canatsho rnams chos la bkod pa dang //rtag par 'dzin pa skyo ba bskyed pa'i phyir// rī'aphrul snang nang gi btsan khang byang ma ru//rgyal po yab yum 'od du rab zhu nas// yi dam lha yi thugs kare thim par gyur//sangs rgyas mi ru sprul pa'i 'gro don can//spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis su med pa'i sras//sdig can chos la 'khod pa'i thuskus rje— can// mtha' yas sems can rnoms kyi mgon gcig po// lke chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku la skyabs —su mchi// ri'aphages pa thugs rje can gyi/skurin gyis rlobs4// de yi bang —so 'a chong po'i —nang du btaspu// che chung tshad ni dpag tshad gcig tsam la//

193bang so gru bzhi dkyil du re mig byas//dar dang shog sdo/ bsres pa'i 'jim pa la//de la chos rgyal chen po'i sku bzhengs nas//shing rtar spyan ja ngas rol mor bcas nas ni/ /sku de bang so'i nang du bzhugs pa mdzad//nang gi re mig thams cad nor gyis bkang // bang so nang rgyazu/ can du grags par gyur//ljarwang du lha khang lnga yang bzhugs sto zer// rtse— chi bangarī so grudzo bzhi sdu brtsigs pa de na sa byung // ming yang sku ri smyug po lags so skad// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang nyan thos dang //byang chub sems dpa' dam can chos skyong rnams//gnas der lhags nas —bang so de la ni/ /bkra shisagirab / rme gnas paldi phrin las mdzad//ci dbon sras —meng srong mang btsan la sogs pa'i// blon po bod 'aḥbangs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//mchod pa'i yo ཿsgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa// gnas der khyer nas phyag dang mchod pa phul//de ltar 'gran 3/da rgyal po'i bang so de//yul de'i lha sruḥrī rnams la phrin bcol mdzad// gsol ba btab nas slar yang yul du byon//phan bde'i 'od kyis phyogs bcur khyab par mdzad//ces so// —

btso brgyad pa/ dbon sras mdi srong — —mang bcan gyi skor/ de na dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyis/ dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus rgyal srid bzung / btsun mo — 'bro bza' khri ma lod bya ba khab tu bzhes/rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ 'di'i dus su rgya'i rgyal pos rgyal po srong btsan sgam po mi bzhugs par shes/ mgar gyis rgya yul phyang bar byas pa rnams dran nas/ rgya'i dmag 'bum tsho lnga btang nas bod 'joms pa dang / jo bo shākya gdan 'dren zer ba la sogs kyi gtam byung ba la skrag nas/ jo bo ra mo che nas lha sar gdan drangs/ lho sgo me longu can du bzhugs nas/ sgo la zha la bgyis te/ 'jam dbyangs bzhengs so/ /rgyal srid lo bco lnga bzung ste/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du 'das so/ /mang srong bang so de yi g.yon na yod//bang so de yang rin chen nor gyis bkang // ming ni sngo gzhe hral po ther po lags//

195bcu dgu pa/ 'dul srong mang po rje rlung nadzo spru 'phrul gyi skor/mang srong mang btsan gyi sras la/ 'dur('dul)srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po yin te/ yab 'das zhag bdun lon dus chu pho byi ba la sgrags phu ru 'khrungs/ mgar gyi sras gnya' btsan ldem bu dang / stag ra khong lod gnyis kyis blon po byas nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ mchims bza' btsun mo tog bya ba khab tu bzhes/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su blon po rtsal po che mi bdun byuboste/ rngog ngeng la nag pos glang po che theg /rngog gling khams kyis g.yag grus po che khyag snan rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste'u kha mas bya khru rked par bcad/ dbas 'dong sgong gis mig rgyang gsum re la mda' rgyang res sleb/ 'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rlud phur bye mas bkang ste glad la bskor nus/ co ro 'brong ce/ra gyis/ 'brong mthur la rgyug pa gyen la 'then thub/ sdon khri bdun g.yu byin gyil rta g.yang la mchong ba gyen la 'then thub pa rnams byung / mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni lha dang mnyam/ stobs dang mthu rtsal gyis ni mtha'’bzhi las rgyal te/ lha sar mes srong btsan sgam po'i dgongs dus kyi mchod pa btsub/ mtha'i rgyal po yang dbang du 'dus pa tsam byung nas/ snga gong bod kyi rgyak+ṣ-i5 po rim par byon pa rnams las mthu stobs che ba cig byung ste/ dgung lo k+ṇi shu rtsa dgu rgyal srid bzung nas ljang gi yul du 'das so/ / bhe

196 'phrul rgyal bang so mang srong g.yon na yod//bang so lha ri can zhes grags par gyur// de ni hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs pa lags//ming ni seng ge brtsig pa zerda ro skad//nyi shu pa/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gye skor/rgyal po 'dur('dul)srong mang po btsan gyi sras/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom du grags pa ste/ lcags pho 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu la rgyal srid bzung / blon po skyi bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal shugs steng / 'bro chu bzang 'or gsum gyis blon po byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ ljongs(ljang)mo khri btsun bya ba'i btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ rgyal po des 'phyin phu nas/ mes srong btsan sgam po'i zhal chems zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa rnyed de/ gzigs pas nga nas gdung rabs lnga na rgyal po khri dang lde zhes bya ba'i dus su dam pa'i chos dar/ paṇ+ḍaṃta mang po byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur zhes pa de/ rgyal po khong rang yin dgongs nas/ bran kha mu le sho ka dang gnyags snya nam ku ma ra gnyis pho nyas brdzangs te/ gangs ri ti se la paṇ+ḍaṃta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis spyan 'dren du btang bas gdan ma drangs pa dang / theg rnga/ chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs te/ yi ger bris

tsho 197nas glegs bam lnga bzhengs na de rnams kyi bzhugs sa la lha khang lnga brtsigs te/ brag dmar ka ru/ kha che 'brin bzangs/ lha sa kha brag 'phyin phu nam ral/ mang gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul ke ma shi nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang / 'ju la ba las rnam par 'byed pa bsgyur ro/ /pe tsi tsan+d+ra shrīs sman dpyad mang po yang bsgyur ro/ /de rnams kyi yon tan gyis btsun mo smongs(ljang)mo khri btsun 'a/ sras ljongs(ljang)tsha lha dpon zhes bya ba lha'i gzugs byad lta bu shin tu mtshar ba cig 'khrungs so/ /de la bod na khab 'os pa ma rnyed nas/ mes srong btsan sgam po'i lugs su bya zer/ rgya nag gi rgyal po dzung dzung rgyal po'i sras mo gyim shing kong jo la rin dang skyes bskur nas len du btang ngo / /der bod kyi blon pos rgya rje la rin dang skyes phul bas/rgya rjes sras mo la 'gro'am mi gigro gsungs pa dang / kong jos legs nyes ston pa'i me long cig yod pa nga/ dmod bor te legs par phyis nas bltas pas/tshe 'di'i grogs skal bod na yod par shes shing / rgyal bu de yang mtshar zhing yid du 'ong ba cig mthong nas bod du 'gro bar mos so/ /der yang rgyal po des rdzongs dpag tu med pa bskur/ rgyal po yang 'khor mang po dang bcas pa bu mo sems la 'phreng bas/ ging pheng nyen zer ba'i mkhar rtsig chen po gcig yod pa'i sa cha bar du skyel thuji mdzad do/ /der gur chen po phub cing / bod kyi gser yig pa rnams la ston mo chen po byas te/ rgyal po'ang spyan chab mang po phyung nas/ sras mo la bslab bya mang po mdzad/ mkhar de la gtogs pa'i nyes pa can thams cad thar du bcug go /slo gcig gi bar la dmag dang 'dab nor thams cad med par mdzad de/ mkhar de'i ming kyim shing hen bya bar brtags(btags)so/ /de nas blon po che ba gnyis dmag dang bcas pa'i skyel ma btang stetsho bod du shedings so/ /der rgya bod kyi mtshams su sleb pa

198 — ridang / bod du blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu gdan drangs te/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od la thams cad kyis rta rgyugs pa la der rgyal bus kyang rta rgyugs pas/ rtas bskyur te 'das so/ /de ltar btsun mo sleb khar/ rgyal bu grongs nas thams cad mya ngan gyis non no//ljang tsha lha dpon bang so mes kyi mdun//zum por brtsigs nas gter yang sbas so skad//de nas kong jo dpon g.yog rnams kyis/ rgya bod kyi mtshams su slebs pa dang / kong jo la glo bur du snying la mda' phog pa'i sdug busngal 'dra ba cig byung nas/ de ma khad me long phyis nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi rgyal bu gzugs byad mdzes pa de med par rgad po bzhin mi sdug pa byad spus khengs pa cig 'dug nas shin tu yi mug par gyur te 'di skad zer ro// me long gi brda chad mthong ba na// bu mo'i snying la gcong cig zhugs//rang yul du log pa shul thag ringe // 4 bu mo'i pha ming snying ring po/ bod du 'gro ba'i re thag chad//bod kyi blon po sdig po che// dze cha med yul du rgyus med 'khyam// rilas kyi me long bslu ba mkhan//zer te me long la brdeg cing ngus so/ /de nas bod kyi rgyal pos pho nya btang ste/ rgya mo dpon g.yog rnams la khyod kyi skye pa'i 'os nga'i bu lha dang 'dra ba cig yod pa de/ rkyen ngan pas 'das/ da de khyed ra—nga yul du log gam/nged la bltas nas 'ong zhes yi ge btang bas/ der rgya mo na re/ bu mo'i

199'dun ma len(lan)gcig yin / 4 skyid sdug ci byungarteyang bod du 'gro zer 'ongs so/ /der bod du slebs pa tha kying / rgya mo na re/ nga'i a ne+e'i lha khang blta'o zer te/ ra mo cher phyin pas/ de na jo bo mi bzhugs par 'dug nas 'phrul snang du 'ongasi pa dang / —jo /spro sto sgo me long can na bzhugs par shes nas sgo phye ste/ jo bo de nas bton rgyuskyis/ btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/lha zhal mthong gi mchod pa bcu ga /jo bo gdung rabs gsum gyi bar la mun khang du bzhugs pa la/ rgya mos mchod pa btsugs pa yin no/ /de nas 'phyin phur byon te/ mes rgyal po'i ‘sgatsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas lo dus 'khor ba tshon/ rgyal bu lus la zhugs ngakhadang / btsun moriche ba sna nam bza' bzhi stengs zer ba cig yod spu phrag dogaskyes nas/ nga la'artu rgyal po'i gdung brgyud lus la yod do zhes rdzun smras te/ der rgya mo la rgyal po khri srong lde btsan lcags pho rta'i lo la brag dmar du sku 'khrungs pas/ sna nam bza' rgya mo'i rtsar byung / shin tu blo nye ba ltar byas nas/ rgya mo'i bu chung phrog ste/nga rang la skyes pa yin no zer bston byas so/ /der rgya mos rang gi nu ma bstan/ smre sngags bton/ cho nge sa bos kyang bu chung ma btang bas/ blon po rnams sbran/ rgyal po la zhus / 4sa/ der sna na ma bzas kyang rang gi nu ma la rang babs kyi rdzas byug ste/ nu tho 'ongs gabyas nas blon po rnams la bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyang : tshom du rgyur nas ma shes so/ /der rgya mo'i bu chung btsun mo che bas grogs rnga/sa/ dbang shed mos ni ma thub/ byed thabs med par song ngo/ /der tre mo'i sems la da de bu chung 'dis nga la phan pa dka'/ bod 'di phung ཿ kyu'i las cig byed dgosartebasams nas ri'i dpyad bltas pas/ rgyal po'i gdung rabs chad pa'i phyir/ rje'i bla ri seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba'i mgo la/ mngal sbug gis 'khor lo gris nas mchod rten

200 gyis mnan/ blon po rig pa can mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ blon po'i bla ri la khro chus sna bcad/ stag ri sing(seng)ri gnyis gzhug ma sbrel ba'ang bcad/ mu ge 'ong ba'i phyir/ yar lung me —sna'i ri 'bras kyi ljang pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba bcad/bod du mdze 'ong ba'i phyir/ mang mkhar gyi ri khyung chen gnam la sding ba 'dra ba'i mchu bcad do/ /de rnams zin pa dang / sras kyis lo 'khor te/ zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rgya dang sna nam nas bos so/ /der sna nam pa rnams kyis bu chung dga' bar byed pa'i yo byad/rgyan dang / gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba rnams khyer 'ongs so/ /der rgya dang / sna nam gnyis nasab btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rnams bod dubyuslebaspo so/ /der rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal pho gser khri'i steng du gung la bzhugs/g.yas na sna dam pa rnams kyis bsdad/ g.yon na rgya rnams kyis bsdad/ der yab rgyal pos sras rgyan du mas brgyan te/ gser skyogs 'bras chang gis gang ba sras kyi lag tu gtad nas/ yab na re/ma gnyis las skyes pa'i bu gcig po// lus chung yang lha yi rnas 'phrul can//sdod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di// bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu gtod//ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed// gsungs te/ dmod bor nas sras gom pa thub tsam de btang nas/ der sras kyi gom pa bor nas byon pa dang / sna nam pa rnams kyis gos dang / rgyan dang / me tog gi phreng ba la sogs bstan nas bos kyang / 'gror ma nyan par rgya rnamal kyi rtsar byung ste/ gser skyogs rgya la gtad nas 'di skad zerī ro/ /nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin//

201sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal// zer te/ zhang po rgya'i pang du song ngo/ /der yum rgya mo shin tu dga' ste 'di skad zer ro/ /tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis//nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo lari// dzo rje 'dren med rgya ra po'i sras ceg 'khrungs//las gang yang sri/da pa'i sngon chad la//bu rang 'khaskyes pa gzhan gyispo phrogs//— sto dhe —gtame hwabadene pa'i citshig la ma nyan zhing // ske sna — brang nu ma bstan kyang ma gtang rupas // — nga rgya mo'i lus sku/mas gzhob citu thal// sems khong khro'i sko tsha ma bzod par//yul bod kyi ri nga/ pyad nyams su bcug / dus di(de)ring tshorto yi snya ma shaṛ// bu khyod kyis zhang ngo shes pa lages// — nga a ma'i lus ri/mas mal du bde//yul bod kyi ri nga pyad nyams pa de// ri de rnams skyorna med bcos su yod// ces zer ro/ /der rgya mo'i sra yin par ngo shes nas/ dga' ston gyi ston mo chen po byas so/ /der sras dgung lormelnga lon dus yum 'das so/ /yab rgyal po mes ag tshom ni/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum la yar 'brog sba tshal mkhar gshegs so// tsho— d+ku de'i bang so mu ra ri la brtsig sa // — ci

202 gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i g.yon na yod/ /ming ni lha ri gtsug nam bya ba lags/ /zhes so/ / nyer gcig pa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi skor/de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis dgung lo brgyad lon pa dang /rgyal srid bzung nas rgyal khams la dasprung bsgyur/ rgyal po sku nar ma son pa'i dus su ma zhang khron pa skyes lu sogs pa blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis chos byar mi gnang ba'i khrims bcas nas/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che slar rgya yul du skyel grabs byas pas/ mi stong gis kyang ma drangs/ mkhar brag tu sa thams su bcug pas/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba la la ni smyo 'bog byung nas shi/ la la rgyab gas nas shi/ (mkhar rna gdong /)mu ge dang / nad yams dang /bkra mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung bas/ ltas mkhan thams cad kha mthun par —rgyari lha bye thams su bcug pas lan 'dug zer nas/ sa 'og nas bton te/rgya gar du skyel bar bsams pas dre'uganyis kyis theg nas mang yul du phebs pa'i dus su/ lam la ma thar zhes glengs nas/ jo bo mang yul du lo bcu bzhi bzhugs/ (yar lung jo bos bsgrigs pa'i rgyalatshorabs dang / gzhan na'ang 'di ga 'dug)jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje rgya yul du skyel rgyu la/ shar phyogs do mo'i thang la bskyal/der zhag bdun lus pa(khong rang gi jo bo min pa ngo shes nas gzhag pa yin 'dug)'o rgyal thang zer(chos lung mda'/)slar ra mo cher bzhugs su bcug go /rgyal po chos la dga' na'ang / blon po ma zhang khron pa skyes dang / stag ra klu gong la sogs

203dbang ches pas/ gzhan gyis ca/la ma nus so/ /de nas rgyal po sku nar son te/rje blon rnams chos bya bar blo ma sprun te/ thabs sna tshogs kyis mgo bskor nas/ma zhang stod lung brang phu ru gson por bang sor bcug/ stag ra klu gong byang 'khabacug(sprugs)go /de nas :/mas cad la chos bya ba'i bkal gnang nas/ thog mar mang yul nas jo bo shākya shing rtar gdan drangs bsu ba rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te ra sa'i btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/dus der kha che skyes bzangs kyi bu ā nardo zer ba de ra sa dang ra mo che gnyis kyi bar na/ dar tshags dgung gib kyi tshong dus sar/ tshong byed kyin yod pa bos nas lots+tsha bcolartete/ chos dang bon gnyis rtsod pa 'gran pas/ bon khungs ngan par byung nas/ sgyusgon gyi chos thams cad brag dmar la sogs par gter du sbas so/ /la la chu ‘5 bskyur/ 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen bzlog pa tsam min pa ma gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal blon thams cad gros bgyis te/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du/ khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthu la brten nas/ sba gsal snang / rgya gar du mkhan po bo dhi sa ta gdan 'dren du btang bas/ gsal snang gis mkhan po gdan drangs te pho brang du phebs pa dang / rgyal pos sku rag ma bcings par/ gser phye bre gang phyag tu bsnams nas mkhan po'i bsu ba la byon pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la la thod gsol pas/ stod du mnga' ris zha(zhwa)tsam cig la khrims shig chags/ zhabs la chasku gsol bas smad du mdo khams lham tsam la khrims shig chags/ sku lus 'a/ sku rags ma bcings pas/ bar 'dir rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas cho sa byar btub gsungs so/ /de nas kha che ā nardos lots+tsha bgyis te/ rje blon rnams la chos gsungs pas/ zu/ ga po'i phyobakha 'dre srin gdug pa can ma dga'

204 bar/ thog dang / lo nyes/ nad yams byung bas/ 'dre srin dam la 'doṭa pa'i phyir du u rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs te/bod kyi 'dre srin dam la btags te/ rje blon chos byed pa la 'gal rkyen med mar mdzad do/ /slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rig 'dzin gyi tshe chu gnang bas/blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po la mon gyi smyo chu dug yin pas/ mi gsol bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyamu po yang the tshom du gyur nas ma gsol/ nad du mdze mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ klu'i rgyal po mal gro gzi chen dam la btags nas rdo rje bsnun pas gzi chen gyis khye'u cig tu sprul nas/ rgyal po la grogs po bcol lo/ /rgyal po la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar khas blangs nas/ rgyal pos klu'i ngo chen mdzad nas thugs dam blang ngo / /yang slob dpon gyis ngam shod kyi bye thang thams cad ne+e'u thang du gtang bzhed pa la/ blon po ngan pa rnams kyil rgyal po la zhus te/ slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul yin pas ring du mi gnas shing mi rung ngo zhes zer te mdzad par ma zhus/ gzhan yang(slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i btsun mo mkhar chen ba 'a 'tsho rgyal dbang man du khab tu bzhes pas/blon po thams cad ma dga' bar/ rgyal po la snyan 'phra zhus na / rgyal pos sprob dpon gyi zhal la ma nyan pas mdzol pa chen po gsum byung ther ba la sog dang /) slob dpon mthu che bas rgyal srid la gnod par nges/ slob dpon yul la gshegs par zhu zhus so/ /(bas ya kyi ka 8gas(bka' ga gas)na/ sprob dpon ra byu rgyan yul du brgyad zer ba 'dug ste/ rgyal po dang gros mdzad na / tsa ri la sog su brgyag ma ging khron ba bsad rting /spar bsam yas su byon ther/) de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams bsags te/ snga gong bod du rab tu byung ba'i dpe mi 'dug pas/ bod du rab tu byung ba e 'ong blta ba'i phyir/ blon po dang 'bangs kyi bu blo rno ba bdun/ bo dhi sa tā'i drung du rab tu byung ste/ de'ang sba sang shi'i bu rat+na/ mchims a nu'i bu

———— 205shākya bra ba/ pa gor rat+na'i bu /kri ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog / gikhon klu'i dbang po baspungs pa/ (slo rgyus cig na/'khon 'i dbang po sad mi mi bdun la mi the zer ba'ang 'dug) gtsang legs grub ste/bdun gyis rab tu byung bal/ sad mi mi bdun zhes grags so/ /de bzhin du btsun mo dang / blon po 'bang sa la sogs pa'i bu sum brgya rab tu byung ste/rgya gar du blo no ba rnams brdzangs te/ sgra dang lots+tsha slob tu btang ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la dpal rnga/sam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ blon po 'gos la sogs pa'i chos blon rnams dang gros mdzad de/dka' ba'i las rnams ma bsten na//sla ba'i las la ju/ba pa med// gsungs te/ mnga' 'og gi blo sko po bod 'bangs rnams bsags te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas sngon chad bod kyi rgyal po byon pa la nga che/ ngas lag rjes chen po cig 'jog dgos/ rgyu shel laza/ grub pa'i mchod rten shar ri dang mnyam pa cig 'chos sam zhang po rgya'i yal mthong ba'i mkhar cig brtsig gam/ has po ri cuzangs kyis 'thum mam/ dka9 bcu thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dgu bcu yod pa 'bru'am/ wa lung grogs mo gser phyes 'gengs sam/ gtsang po spubs su 'jug gam/ dekon mchog gsum kyi rten bzhugs pa'i lha khang bre tshad tsam cig bzhengs sam 'doms shig gsungs pas/ der thams cad kyis rgyal po'i bka' de gser gyi pha bong bzhin sems thog tu lji bar byung nas/zhu ma shes par mig hu re lus so/ /der blon po 'gos dang / zhang nyang bzang dang / gnyir stag btsan 'dong gzigs la sogs pa'i chos blon rnams bzhengs te/ rje gcig lags/ shel gyi mchod rten shang ri dang mtho dman

206mnyam pa rmeni skye ba 'di la grub pa mi srid/ rgya yul mthong ba'i mkhar bsam pas 'grub pa mi srid/ bod mnga' rigs kyi zangs thams cad bsdus kyang /has po ri 'thums pa med/ wa lung grog mo gser phye bas bye mas kyang mi khengs/ khron 'dom dgu brgya bas brgya yang 'bru mi thub/ gtsang po sbubs su dgun tshud kyang dbyar mi tshud/ de bas rje'i thugs dam/ 'bangs kyi skyabs gnas/ phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi ma/ gtsug lag khang bre tshad tsam cig bzhengs pa lags zhus pas/ der thams cad kha 'cham par de bzhin legs so zhes gda'o/ /de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ slob dpon chen po nga'i pha ma gnyis po gang na 'dug zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/rgyal po khyed kyi yab ni/ rgya gar gyi yul na/ paṭī ta chen po cig tu skyes 'dug ste/ khyed kyi dbon sras kyi dus su/ (pas+t+ri ta dā na spyi la yin par lung bstan/)bod du 'byon par 'dug khyed kyi yum ni/ zung mkhar na dbul po bza' mi gnyis kyi bu mor skyes 'dug ste/ ming dang rus ni 'di ltar ro zhes lung bstan/de nas rgyal pos btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa la/ tshe spang bza' me tog sgron/'khar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ (btsun mo 'di slob dpon la dbang yon du phul slo//)'bro bza' byang chub sgron/ 'chims bza' lha mo btsan rnams so/ /yang yum gyi drin bsab pa'i phyir/ dbul po rbaza' mi'i bu me khab tu bzhes te/ pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun zhes grags so/ /(lo rgyus shig na/ rgyal po'i yum gyi skye ba bu mo de/ 'phan yul zur chu nas rnyed zer ba 'dug ste/ gang ltar na'ang pho yong bza' na par don mthun no/ /kye de nas slob dpon gyis gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i sa dpyad gzigs pab/ shar ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra de bzang / ri chung bya mas bu la sgab pa 'dra de bzang / sman ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra de bzang /has po ri btsun mo dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba 'dra de bzang / ri nag

207lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra 3di bzang / me yar dre'u chu 'thung ba 'dra de bzang / del thang dar dkar // yol ba 'then pa 'dra de bzang / sa gzhi ni gser gzhong gur gum kyis ba /nga ba 'dra de bzang bas/ rje'i thugs dam 'dir bzhengs shig gsungs na phyag bris mjod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'dre srin gdug pa can rnams dam la btags nas 'gal rkyen med par mjod de/ ya rabs rigs btsun (/nga pha ma drug ldan gyi bu dang bu mo rgyartsa du mas brgyan pa lnga bcu/ rin po cheḍi bum bar bkra shis kyi chus gang ba thogs te/sa phur btaba'i sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs so/ / de nas rgyal pos blon po dang / bod 'bangs thams casprekyi las la bskul te/ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab la dpe blangs nas/ dbu rtse chen mo rmang bting tsam na/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas lung bstan nas/ snga sor ār+ya pa lo gling bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ de'i g.yas su sgrol ma/ g.yon du 'od zer can/ yang g.yas su yi ge drug pa/ g.yon du dpal rta mgrin la sogs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs so/ /steng du 'od dpag meng gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs so/ /de nas slongasadapon gyis rgyal po la rta mgrin sgrub pa'i lung gnang nas sgrub pa mjod pas/ rgyal pos rta mgrin grub nas/ rta skad lan gsum bton pas 'dzam bu'i tsho /4sum gnyisamyisu thos te/ rgyal po'i chab srid kyang 'dzam gling sum gnyis la::skobang bsgyur ba yin gsungs/ de nas yos kyi li la dbu rtse chen po'i 'og kha/rnga bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la has po ri nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo'i thub / pa rang byon la rin po che'i 'jim bas g.yogal te/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pasnari bzhugs/ g.yas gral la byams pa spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying po/ dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'o/ /g.yon gral la zhan tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/

208 sgrib pa rnam sel/ dge bsnyen dri ma med pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dang / gtso 'khor bcu gsum rnams bod kyi lugs su bzhengs/ lte ba'i phyi lha'i ri mo mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ kha natha lta la tog gi rgyud —ris/ sngar khang rje'i thugs dam gyi —rgyud ris rnams bzhengs/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i mgo can la gtad/de nas bar khang bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad/ g.yas phyogs la mar me mdzad/ g.yon na byams pa/ mdun na shākya thub pa/ sman gyi lha/ snang ba mtha' yas gsum bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon na byang sems nye ba'i sras4brgyad/ dge bsnyen dri masgyumed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo4 kang dang king / bzo rgyarinag gi lugs su bzhengs/ rgyud ris la yum rgyas pa gleng gozhi'i le'u gdong la rgyal chen bzhi/bskor khang kha phyir lta la mchod rten brgyad pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud ris/ kha nang lta la sprin chen po'i rgyud ris/ sngags khang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs/ bsam yas kyi chos skyong rnams kyi 'bag chos skyong rgyal po shing bya can la gtad/ steng khang gi gtso bo sangs rgyas rna4par snang mdzad kun du zhal re re la 'khor gnyis re/ sne byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ nad gi lha byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dang phyag na rdo rje/ bzo rgya gar gyi lugs su bzhengs/ rgyud risamado sde sa bcu pa/ chos skyong rgyal po zangs ma'i 'be log can la gtad/thog rgya phub za 'og ris su byas/ spyog bzhi na sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal la 'khor byang chub sems dpas bskor ba/ chos skyong lag na rdo rje gos sngon can bzhi la gtad/ de nas 'khor sa bar pa brtsigs te/ sto phyogs klu'i bang mdzod rol chas bkang / gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs pa mched gsum

20trel gtad/ nub phyogs mdo rgyuni chos kyi bang mdzod sum brgya dang / bod dang rgya'i dpe cha glegs bam gyis bkang ste/ a tsa ra lag na spu gri thogs pa gsum la gtad/ byang phyogs rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod gsum ga radangul zangs la7sogs pas bkaji ste/ gshin rje gshed lag na bo con can gsum la gtad/ rgyud ris la zu/ cher rol pa bris/ de'i bar la sangs rgyas stong dang khri la sogs pa bris so/ /de nas 'khor sa chen po bskor te/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad ngan song sbyoḥrī ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs so/ /mda' yab kyi ngos gsum na rigs lnga'i lder so zhal phyir blta ba/ nang du sdug po brgyan pa/ nor bu bzang po chos skyong ( 9'i rgyal po ā nardo la gtad/ rgyabatwa rdo ring btsugs skyos skyong siX ha mu kha 9 gtad/dbu rtse'i sgo gsum hūṃ/ma par thang pa'i sgo / / gru skas drug ni pha rol phyin pa drug / 'og khang rdo la bar khang so phag yin/ kasteng khang gzhal yas rin chen shing laswā grub/ /bzo rnams thams ca 5 'dul ba'i lugs dang bstun/ /rgyud ris thams cad mdo sde'i lugs dang bstun/ /lder so thams cad ba/sang sngags dag dang bstun/ /zhes so/ /de nas shar lus 'pha/nas po'i gling gsum zla gam ris su yod pa la dpe blang sa nas/ shar du lha kha‘cho gsum brtsigs te/ de mang rnam dag khrim sa khang gling na rten gyi gtso bo shākya zub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ / mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong tshangs ma dung gi thor tshugs can la gtad/ mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na/ 'pha nasu pa 'ardzam dbal gtso 'khor bdurna/ sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis 'ja/ba dpal rtsaṣergyud dang /skub nasgyusong spyong ba'i rgyud

210gnyis/ chos skyong gshin rje'i 'khor lo can la gtad/ brda sbyor tshangs pa gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bdun/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud ris/chos skyong 'brug gi glog ba can la gtad/ sto 'dzam bu gling gi gling gsum sog khar yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ sto phyogs su lha khang gsum bzhengs te/ de yang bdud 'dul sngags pa gling na/ thub pa bdud 'dul lugs gtso 'khor lnga/ lte ba la mdo sde sa bcu pa'i rgyud ris/ 'khor sa la nam mkhasdo snyingapo'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la gtad/ ār+ya pa lo gling na/ kharma pa ṇi gtso 'khor lnga/ steng na snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor lnga/ blo 'bur na tsardon la dngul g.yogs pa'i rgyal po'i sku 'dra gcig mchod rten gcig rgyud ris/ za ma tog lha mo stong rtsa gnyis chos skyong drang srong t+tarma rā jo la gtad/ sgra sgyur rgya gar gling na thub pa rgya gar lugs ma gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris la tshe dpag med dang / lo paṇa sgra bsgyur ba'i gzugs so/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin rā hu la la gtad/ nub ba lang spyod gyi gling gsum thum por yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ nub tu lha khang gsum brtsigs te/ de yang dpa' bo betsa gling na rnam par snang mji da zangs la bzhengs pa/'khor gsang ba yum bzhi/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong gnon sbyin glang gi mgo can la gtad/ dga' ldan byums pa gling na/ mgon po byams pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis/ rgyud ris la gnas pirtan bcu drug bsam yas bzhengs lugs dang /'jig rten gtan gzhag rnams bris/ chos skyong khro bo gos sngon can la gtad/mi’g.yo bsam gtan gling na/ rnam par snang mjod rigs lnga/ nyan thos bcu drug rgyud ris la gser 'odaram dzonas khye'u chu 'bebs kyi ri mo/ chos skyong rgyal po dngulda lgego can la gtad/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi gling gsum gru

211 bzhir yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ byang du lha khang gsum bzhengs te/ de'ang rin chen sna tshogs gling na shākya byeb pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris la dga' ldan du bcom ldan 'das kyis yum la chos gsungs pa/ drin len(lan)bsabs pa rnams bris/ chos skyong rgyal po :/gas kyi sder mo can la gted/ sems bskyed byang chub gling na sangs rgyas pad+ma can/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ phyag na rdo rje/bdud rtsi 'khyilu pa/ rgyud ris zu do sde dkon mchog sprin dang / rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stsal(btsal)ba rnams bris/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i mgo can la gasgyuta da/ pe dkar dkoratshomadzod gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu/ yab sra mjal ba'i rgyud ris/ glo 'bur rnams na bsam yas bzhengs pa'i nor lhan ma/ 'di na 'di yod kyi rtsis yig de'i srung ma khrum khang gi rgyal po la gtad/ lha khang spyi'i bstan srung la/ slob dpon gyis za hor gyi yul nas/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po/ bdud kyi dmag dpon chen po/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la dbang byed cing / skye 'gro thams cad kyi dbugs len/ srog bdag chen po pe ha ra la gtad cing /pe dkar gyi gling du rten btsugs so/ /nyi ma lha khang yag sha gong mi(ma)gang ba bzang po'i lha khang na shā kya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ zla ba lha /spang yag sha 'og ma nor bu bzang po'i lha khang na/ lha khang rgyud ris gong dang mthun/ tshang mang ke'u gling na steng na ba so lha khang / dag byed khrus khang rdosgong na khron pa tsardon gyis gang ba/ mthu gtad klu khang gling na/ se ba phyang bo yalag brgyado yod pa gcig la/ klu chen brgyad/ dbus na phyag na rdo rje/ zhi ba 'dul byed rgyud ris/ rus sbal nya chu srin ṣ+kasogs pa'o/ /de nas mchod rten— dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyan thos kyi lugs seng ges brgyan pa/ rtsa shād pya napal gyi seng ges lag

212 dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin skar mda' can la gtad/(mchod rten dkar po'i srogajishing rgyal chen bzhis btsugs nas bzhugs sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel ma ga dha'i bre'i khal gcig gnyen po galang ba yab kyi yi dam/ mdo sde lnga rnams bzhugs pas byin rlabs che/3mchod rten dmar po chos —kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i lugs pad+mas brgyan pa/ sna nam rgyal tsha lha gnang gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gza' mig dmar la gtad/ sachod rten nag po rang sangs rgyas kyi luskekas/ ngam stag sgra klu gong gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs/ lha khang sgo mo bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ mchims rdo rje sprel chung gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong la gtad/ de'i tshe 'dre mo 'od can mas mi thams cad la gnosbru 'tshe byas pas/ slob dpon gyis byams pa gling du6 mchod rten 'od 'bar ba brtsigs te/ 'dre mo mnan/ gnod 'tshe med par mdzad do / /de nas lcags ri zur mangs rdo rje 'gros ni/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul du bzhugs nas re re la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re re bzhugs so/ /de nas btsun mo gling gsum ni/ 'bro bza' byang chub sgron gyis dge rgyas bye ma gling bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor bdun li ma ru bzhengs/ g.yas na rigs gsum mgon po/ g.yon na sman gyi bla/ kun du bzang po/ mi g.yo ba rnams bzhugs/ sras med pha ming thag ring bas/ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lha khang la zhig ral byung na/ gso mkhan ma byung dogs nas/ rtsig pa so phag la zhaḥnye'i chus sbyar/ zangs kyis thog phub/ rol (mor jang btag mar me'i tshab tu nor bu 'od kha gdung mar btag yon chab tu khron pa bcos so/ /tshe yang bza' me tog sgron la sras gsum 'khyungs te/

213mu ne+e btsad po/ mu rug btsang/ po/ mi mug btsad po sad na legs dang gsum yod pa'i yab kyi dbu rtse :sdigs gsum la dpe blangs nas/ khams gsum zangs khang gling gi lha khang bzhengs so/ /pho yang bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bu tshal gser khar gling rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs/ lha bzo la sogs pa bzo bo rnams slo/ dus re la zas sna bcu gsum re drangs pas/de'i bzang lan du bzo khyad bcu gsum byas pa la/ snyi na rtsig pa med de/rdo rje lta bur sra ba bzo'i khyad/ nang na ka ba med di/ gur —lta bur mdzes pa bzo'i khyad/ sa gzhi ra gan byas pa/ gaspu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug pa/ gser gyi gdung ma la g.yu'i 'brug yod ba/ rgya phub kha phyi lta dang nang lta yod pa/ nang gi lha rnam 5 la spyi gdugs re dang / sgos gdugs re yod pa/ sgo 'byed gcod la ga gir gyi bye rus skad 'don pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du dod pa sogs/ bzo'i khyad ngo mtshar can bcu gsum byas so/ /de ltar dasprol bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sde skor legs par bzhengs ba'i bzo phud la/ lha sar shing bzo'i phud la/btsan khang dbus ma'i mdun du sgo mo che rta babs kyis brgyan pa dang / sa'i phud la sgo srung rgyal chen bzhi ba gings su gsol/ de ltar yos kyi lo la bsam yas kyi rmang bting nas yos kyi ṭī5 la yongs su rdzogs par tshar te/ lo skor gcig 'gor ro/ /de nas rab tu gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ bza' btung gi longs spyod dpag tu med pa bsags/ mnga' zhabs kyi mi thams cad 'dus te/ dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos slob dpon dang bo dhi sa ta la gser gyi phyag rten phul/ rgyal pos kyang rin po che du mas brgyan pa'i na bza' gsol te/ dbal bsam yas minga'agyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sde skor dang bcas pa spru/ rabaganar rdzo mtshar che ba'i rnam grangs

214 yod pa lan bdun mdzad/ sprul ba'i skur bstan no/ /de'i rgyud ris༄nga /dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab dang / 'khor sa'i sgo 'gram gnyis la bris yod do/ /(bka'i thang yig che mo las/) de ltar dpal gyi bsam yas la// mi rab gnasabyudaga' stonaci mdzad spru'i dus // mtsho cimo gur gyi dkyil drung der//pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa'i gnas// rgyal po gser khri'i steng4du bzhugs/ yid 'ong btsun mo lnga po yang //mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas te bzhugs//—mchod gnas lo paṇa thams cad kyang //dgyel shing chos —kyi sgrog gling mjod//chos blon gtso bo thams cad kyang //rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mtha' la bskor// de ltar mnga' 'oga'ispyod pa'i 'bangs//dbus gtsang sde rigs thams cad nas// ma 'tshogs bya ba gang yang med// bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs kyis//gang la ci 'dod thams cad tshim// dga' ba'i bro brdung skyid pa'i glu//sto nyin re bzhin du rgyun chad med// kā gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs// gung la nyi ma'apeb pa tsam// sgyu chi

215'dab chags bya la 'phur sa med//mgo nag mi yis sa gzhi khengs// —sil snyan rol mo 'brug bzhin sdir// gyi ling rta la rgyug sa med// khye'u bu mo thams cad kyis// chas brgyan lag na rnga ma thogs// rnga brdung glu len gar stabs bsgyur// g.yag seng dar seng stag seng dang //'brug dang seng sbug gar mkhan dang // dpal mdzes rnga thogs 'cham po sogs//rgyal po'i sku la mchod pa 'bul// de ltar rje 'bangs thams cad kyis/ / dga' ba'i lus la rang dbang med// bro brdung nam mkha'i charardzipa 'dra1 / skyid pa'i sems la dran 'dzin med// rang rang mos pa'i glu re len// de ltar mi rje lhas mdzad ba// lke ri chos rgyal khri srong lde batshan des// rin chen khri las bzhengs nas ni / rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa// nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'a6// — rin chen lnga las grub pa ste// spre cho ci brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa mchakhri tshe ji tsho nga

216nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che//mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'// de phyir bsam gyi blo re bde /lus 'phags gling la dpe blangs nas//shar gyirnalha khang gsum po 'di//rin chen lnga las grub pa ste//brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra//nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che//mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyi blo re bde//'dzam bu gling la dpe blangs nas// lho yi lha khang gsum po 'di//rin chen lnga las grub pa ste//brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra//nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'// stor+sha de phyir bsam gyi blo re bde// ba glang spyod la dpe blangs nas/ / nubapaṃ lha khang gsum po 'di/ka rin chen lnga las grub pa ste// brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ she she — rte —nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che// rī snye d+kumathong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'//

217de phyir bsam gyi blo re bde//sgra mi snyan la dpe blangs nas//byang gi lha khang gsum po 'di// rin chen lnga las grub pa ste//brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra//nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che//mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'//de snyir bsam gyi blo re bde// nga yi yasbu gong 'og 'di//mkha' la nyi zla shar ba 'dra//lke nga mi btsun mo gling gsum 'di// g.yu yi marnal bkod pa 'dra//nga yi mchod rten dkar spa 'di//dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra//nga yi mchod rten dmar po 'di// me lce gnam la bsnyeg pa 'dra//nga yi mchod rten sngon po 'di//g.yu yi ka ba btsugs pa 'dra // nga yi mchod rten nag po 'di//lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra//nga yi mchod rten ngo mtshar che /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'// de phyir bsam gyi blo re spude //

218 de la sogs pa dgyes pa'i glu/—/ sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang gis//lha yi glu la dpe blangs nas//g.yu khang gser khri bya ba blangasu// lha sras mu ni btsan po yis//'jig rten sgron me bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu tig btsan po yis// seng ge 'gying pa bya ba blangs// btsun mo rnams kyis glu blangs pa//g.yu mtsho 'khyil pa bya ba blangs// g.yu7 lo lhug phran bya ba blangs// mchod gnas rnams kyis thu blangs pa// mkhan po bo dhi sa ta yis// sgam phreng dkar po bya ba blangs// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas༄kyis// lha 'dre zil gnon bya ba blangs// mkhas pa bai ro tsa na yil// dbyangs yig khug pa bya ba blangs// gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis//mkha' la khyung lding bu ba blangs//ngan lam btsun pa rgyal mchog gis//rta mgrin 'gying dbyangs bya ba blangs// — mkhas pa rtsag ro dpal bzang gis//

219skyid pa'i dpal dgu khya ba blangs// tshoblon po rnams kyis glu blangs pa// chos blon chen po 'gosnyarinan gyis//drang shing dkar ba bya ba blangs//de srasak+ṣeyab lhag khri bzangs kyis// mdzangs yig 'phrul gyi ldo mig blangs//shud pu dpal gyi seng ge yis//ngur chung g.yu rings bya ba blangs//dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal gyis//zar chen zar chung bya ba blangs//nyang bzang zhang po khri rgyal gyis//seng ge 'grel chen bya ba blangs// sbas kyi bstan bzang dpal legs kyis //'dod pa re brgyad bya ba blangs// mgar gyi khyungari po dugatshugs kyis//bya rgod lding ba bya ba blangs// mchims kyi rdo rje sprel chung gis//mchims kyi brjed glu bya ba blangs//sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis// lha shug gong ma bya ba blangs//khri 'bring lha 'od khug chos kyis//mdo chod rab 'bring tha gsum blangs//gnyags kyi khri bzang yang bon gyis//

shā/rdo/skye//// — zla 'od khyab gdal bya ba blangs//li ngam stag sgra klu gong gis// lcags sprel gdong drug bya ba blangs//gtso bo rnams kyis glu blangs pa//ya mtshan gser gyi me tog blangs//stag shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa // stag ri dgu brtsegs bya ba blangs//mo btsun rnams kyis glu blangs pa//me tog phreng ba bya ba blangs // sman shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa//grong zer ring mo bya ba blangs/ /gzhan yang brjod kyis mi long ste// lo skor gcig gi bar du ni// mi res glu re blangs pa yin// skyid pa'i dus su dpal gyi 'dom brkyang ste//dga' bde skyid pa'i dpal la longs spyad de//phan bde nyi zla'i 'od lta bur/ lo skor gcig gi bar du phyogs thams cad du khyab par mjod do/ /de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ tshe 'dir thar pa byang chub don du gnyer 'dod bas/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dis kyang nges par bslus gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bzhed nas/rgya gar gyi yul nas paṇ+ḍaṃ ta bai ma la mi tra la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po spyan drangs/ sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba be+e ro tsa na dang / kha che ā nardo dang /'dan ma rtse mangs dang / gnyags ku mā ra dang / rma ā tsār+ya rin chen

221mchog dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang sna nam ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas lo ts+tsha byas te/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling du gzhi bzung nas/ sde sgodartegasum kha bod du bsgyur/ (yots+tsha ba snga tshar gsum/ bar tshar gsum snyi tshar gsum mangs su grag ba pots+tsha ba dgu/)dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangasatsārgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas bod 'bangs thams cad dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas te/ bde —skyid dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas sakhan po bo dhi sa ta'i zhal nas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags pas/ bod du mu stegs pa mi 'ong gis/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su nang pa dang lta ba mi mthun pa'i dus shig 'ong / de'i dus su nga'i slob ma ka ma la shrī la bya ba yod kyis de gdan drangs —shig des lta ba phyogs gcig tu mthun par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te/ mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal pos chos kyi ring lugs ye shes dbang po la bskos/ /nge nas mkhan po ji ltar gsung ba bzhin/ rgya na / gi yul nas ha shang ma hā ya na bya ba bod du byon nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba la ston min pri bya ba dang / — tsen min pa bya ba gnyis su byung nas/ nang pa dang lta ba ma mthun par rtsod pa byed do/ /de'i tshe mkhan po'i zhal chems bzhin/ — ye shes dbang pos mkhas pa ka ma la shrī la gdan drangs te bod du byon/ bsam yas kyi thad ka'i pha ri'i chu 'gram du phebs pa dang / ha shang na re/ bdag gis kyang paṭī ta byon pa la bsu ba byed do gsungs te tshu ri'i chu 'gram du byon no/ /der ha shang byon pa ka ma la shrī las gzi gas te/ ka ma la shrī la'i thugs la ha shang 'di rigs pa dang ldan na bdag gis nges par thul gyis rigs pa dang mi ldan na mi thul dgongs te/ ha shang gi rigs pa badheg pa'i tshophyirathadu/ khamaso’gtsum 'khor —bair 'khyam

222pa'i rgyu ni gang yin zhes 'dri ba'i brda ston pa'i phyir du/ ka ma la shrī las khong rang gi dbu la phyag shing lan gsum bskar bas/ do ha shang gis gzigs te/ 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rgyu gzung 'dzin gnyis las byung zhes len(lan)'debs pa'i phyir du/ ber gyi thu ba nas bzung ste/ lan gnyis sa la brdab bas/ ka ma la shrī la'i thugs la ha shangadzo rigs pa dang ldan pa cig 'dug pas/bdag gis thul bar 'dug go dgongs nas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas bsam yas su phebs pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu mos nas/ gtsug lag khang sde skor dang bcas pa bzhengs/ rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍaṃta gdan drangs/ sde sgod gsum gyi chos thams cad bsgyur zhing yang dag par gtan la phab/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/chos la dgongs pa gcig tu mthun pa cig yin na'aja / rgya nag nas ha shang byon te/ chos la lta ba ma mthun par so sor bye bas/ mkhas pa ka ma la shī la gdan drangs pa yin/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'ongs pas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa mthun par sgrogs gling gi rtsod pa mdzod la nga rgyal ma mdzad par rtsod pa su rgyal de la pham pa des me tog gtor cig gsungs so/ /der soms bskyed byang chub gling du gdan khri che na po bshams te/ rgyal po gung la bzhugs/ g.yas phyogs su ha shang dpon slob rnams bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs su ka ma la shrī la dpon slob bzhugs/ rtsod —pa byas pas mkhas pa ka ma la shrī la rgyal bar gyur te/ ha shang gis pham blangs nas me tog gtor ro/ /de nas ha shang slar rgya yul la bzhud pa dang / lham ya cig bod du lus pas ha shang gi zhal nas da rung bod du nga'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'ga' re yod par 'dug gsungs so/ /de ltar yang rgya gar nas pa’ ta mkhas pri byon/ rgyal pos yon bdag mdzad/ lots+tsha ba mkhas pas bsgrur zhing

223gtan la phab pa'i chos la 'jug par gyis shig ces rgyal pos bka' stsal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams dgongs pa gcig tu mthun cing / dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mjod/ sras mu de btsan po la rgyal srid gtad nas/ yab zung mkhar smyug ma mkhar gyi pho brang la byon te bzhugs so/ /'di dag ni zur tsam bsdus pa yin gyis/ rgyas par 'dod na bsam yas kyi ka tshigs(bka' gtsegs)chen mo la gzigs shig de ltar chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan de dgung lo lnga bcu nga drug pa shing mo glang gi lo la zung mkhar du gshegs so/ /de'i bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs// —gral ni yab kyi rgyab ngos g.yas na yod//de ni ma grongs pa nas nyid kyis brtsigs//ming ni 'asbul ri btsug snang bya bar btags//de yi rtsa na rdo rista cig kyang yod// bang so phyi rgyan can du grags par gyur/ zhes so// nyer gnyis pa/ sras sku ne btsan po'i skor /sras mu ne+e btsan po ni/ chu pho stag gi lo la brag dmar du kyi 'khrungs/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la rgyal srid bzung/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/btsun mo ru yong bza' mdo rgyal khab7tu bzhe4sa/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung/yab kyi thugasartedagongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du 'duzha ba/dang mngon pa dang / mdo sde gas ma gyis mchod dzibatsugs/ rmichogarnyen cachen tho bgi'i gdugs dang / rtegi 4 tre
