224 dbu rtse'i bya 'dab lcags thag gis sbrel/ dar po che/ 'phan chen ngo/ rnams phyar/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga'i yab kyi gtsug lag khang 'di rnams la/ khyed bod 'bangs thams cad kyis rta phyugs dang / mtshon cha ma gtogs pa/ gzhan gser dngul/ g.yu mu tig la sogs pa'i dngos po gang 'dug phul cig gsungs pas/ rje'i bka' btsan pas/ la las ni gser dngul rin po che mang po phul/ la las ni g.yu dang ber dar zab phul/ la las ni gos dang rgyan phul/ la las ni gos rgyal po dang / ras slag la sogs pa phul bral/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed bod 'bangs rnams dad pa che chung khyad re che/ la las ni nor dpag med 'bul/la las ni re rgyal dang ras slag min pa mi 'bul lo zhes gsungs pas/ bod 'bangs rnams na re/ dad pa che chung yod pa ma lags te/ phyug po rnams la 'bul rgyu yod/ dbul po rnams la 'bul rgyu med pas len(lan)zhes zhus pas/rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga'i mnga' 'og 'dir’mi rnams la stogs phyug khyad 'di tsam 'ong ba mi 'os gsungs te/ stogs phyug lan gsum stoms pas/ lo re tsam ma gtogs phyug po rnams ni sngar ltar phyug dbul po rnams ni sngar bzhin stogs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ stogs phyug lan gsum stoms kyang / skyid sdug la khyad 'di tsam yod pa ci yin/ gang gis len(lan)zhes gsung pas/mchod gnas rnams na re/ 'di dag ni sngon gyi sbyin shugs yin zhes zhus pas/las rgyu 'bras la rgyal po thugs ches so/ /de ltar rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ mchod gnas rnams dang / rab tu byung ba rnams ni dbu'i la thod bzhin khur/ 'tsho ba blang(bla)nas sbyor/ chab srid ni phan pa dang bde bas bskya ngas so/ /btsun mo pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsu na zer ba de/ yab rgyal po'i yum rgya mo bza'i skye ba yin1pos/ yab kyi

— 225thugs la 'phreng bar gyur te/ yab zung mkhar du byon dus sras la gtad mnyer mdzad pas sras kyis khab tu bzhes/ yab rgyal po grongs dus/ pho yong bzas rgyan ma bkrol/ mya ngan ma byas zer ba la bsnyad btags nas/ yum tshe spong bza' phrag dog skyes te/ gshed ma bskos nas gsod du btang bas/ sras rgyal pos bskyabs pas/ yum log lta skyes te sras la gsol ngan drangs te/sras rgyal po mu ne+e btsan po lo gcig dang zla ba dgu la rgyal srid bzung nas/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la pho brang yum bur grongs so/ /sras mu ne+e btsan po'i bang so ni/ ci.ag tshom bang so'i g.yas ngos mdun na yod//ming ni lha ri ldem po zer ro skad// ces so/ nyer gsum pa/ sras mya tig btsan po dang khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing yom gyi sgor/de nas sras 'bring po mu tig btsan po la rgyal dz+rad gtad rgyu la/ mu tig btsan pos kyang snga gong yab bzhugs dus/ blon zhang dbu ring nyes med du bsad pa'i ngan len(lan)du sna nam pas bkrongs so//de'i bang so don 'khor mda' ru brtsigs//ming ni kya ri kyang ldem lags so skad//de nas sras chung ba khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing yon la rgyal srid gtad/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sngar med

226 pa'i mdo dang sgra bsgyur/ mchod gnas preṇ+ḍi ta bai shā ka ra/ be+e ro tsa na mchog ces/ ka ma la shrī la sogs pa'i mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog byas/snga gong yab kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa dang mar me phul/ dgung lo bcu dgu lon dus btsun mo lha rtse bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras gcig 'khrungs pa/ dgung lo bcu gsum lon das yab 'das/ bang cuso don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ nyer bzhi pa/ sras ldeng khri'i skor/sras ldeng khri dgung lo bcu bzhi la rgyal srid bzung—/ btsun mo chen ma la gsum/ btsun mo chung ba gcig la/ sras lha rje lhun grub gnyis te lnga 'khrungs so/ /dge 'dan gyi sde btsugs/ yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug culag khang rna mas la zhabs tog rgyas par mdzad do/ /rgyal po de dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes dus/ me mo byamalo la sgra/gasdi kyi phur 'das so//de yi bang so 'phrul rgyal gamesno na yod//bang so de yang rin cin nor gyis bkang //yum gyi chab gang bskang pas mtho ba yin//ming ni rgyal chen —bang so zer ro skad// waces zer ro//

227nyer lnga pa/ ṭanga' bdag ral pa can rgya skor/der sras che ba gtsang ma ni chos la dga' ste rab tu byung / dar ma ni sdig la dga' ste rje'i 'os min/ bar pa ral pa can la srid gtad do//rgyal po mnga' bdag ral pa can de/ me pho khyi la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyil la yab 'das te/ rgyal sar bton/ bka'i blon po bran kha dpal gyirmo yon tan gyis byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul la sogs pa btsun mo che chung lnga khab tu bzhes/tsho dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung / rgya gar gyi patsā ta dzi na mi tra/ shrī laspre bo dhi/ dā na shī la la sogs pa spyon drangs/ lots+tsha ba ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ ban+de ye shes sde rnams kyis chos bsgyur te/ chos thams cad skod gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bka' bcas(bcad〉rnam pa gsum du mdzad dopu tha na bre srang/ tho la sogs pa bams cad kyang rgya gar dang bstun/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgom grwa btsugs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ chos the sum cu tham par dge 'a dun gyi sde btsugs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'dul grwa btsugs/ rab tu byung ba re re'i zhabs tog la 'bangs mi khyim bdun cu phulgo/ rgyal po gungu la bzhugs pa la/ dbu'i ral pa g.yas g.yon gyi sne 'khridarwa yug btags/ dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i gral g.yas g.yon7la bting / de'i steng du dge 'dun bzhugs par mos la dge 'dun dbu sde gnyisartezhes grags so/ skyothuganyakhadamakhadu 'u shang rdo/ dpe med

228 bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ li'i yul nas rig byed la mkhas pa'i bzopyibo bos/ bal po'i yul nas lha bzo dang /rdo bzo ba mang po bos nas lha khang dgu thog tu mjod pa la/ 'og gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa3 rdo las grub/ bar gyi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa so phag las grub/ steng gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa shing las grub/ rgya phub dgu brtsegs yod pa/ rgya phub re re'i bya 'dab bar na/ rab tu byung ba chos nyan bshad byed pa bzhugs/ steng gi rgya phub gser 'brug g.yu 'brug dang bcas pa/ rlung gis bskyod dus gdugs ltar 'khor ba/bar gyi rtsig pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu la/ mda' yab dang pu shu/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas mdzes pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / dar gyi cod pan dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/rgya phub rtse'i gser 'bru rgyab ri dang mthod man mnyam ba/ bod yul kun na 'gran zla dang bral zhispumathong ba tsam gyis dang bar byed la/ rlung chen rgya phub kyi phyogs bzhir lcags thag btang ste phyogs bzhir rdo'i seng ge dang sbrel/ de la steng gi thog gsum na rje'i thugs dam bzhugs/ bar gyi thog gsum na mchod gnas dge 'dun bzhugs/ 'og gi thog gsum na rje blon 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs so// de lta ra 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i phud la/ lha sar sa phud/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ shing bzo'i phud la gnam yas ka ba bzhi rin po ches brgyan pa dang /ri mo'i phud la rnying pa gso rgyu nyan pa/ be bum brgya rtsa brgyad lugs ma'i phud du ljong la sogs pa rnams phul lo/ /gzhan yang rgyal pho'i mchod gnas/ nyang sha'i spyan dang / blon po 'ga' zhig gis/ lha sa'i shar du/ ka ru dang tshe ru/sto ru dga' ba dang / dga' ba'i 'od/ byang du bran khang dang / bran khang

229tha ma la sogs pa'i lha khang bzhengs so/ /de ltar rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can de/ mkhyen pa ni 'phrul gyi tshul chags/ mdzad pa ni lha'i lugs dang mthun/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang mnyam/dbang dang mthu stobs kyis ni bdud sdig can skrag par byed pa/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal te/ 'dzam bu gling sum gnyis la dbang mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar yang snga gong nas rgya bod kyi 'brel tshul/ btsan po dbon zhang rim bzhin byon pa rnams kyi lo rgyus mthun nas skyes 'bul res mdzad pa dang /'khon nas dmag 'dren res mdzad pa'i rnam grangs mang du mdzad de/ de'ang rgya'i deb ther chen po zhu thu han chan bya ba na/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya drug cu rtsa drug lon pa'i dus rgya nag gi rgyal po thang zhes bya ba byung ste/ bod kyi rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang dus mnyam/nide'i sras tha'i dzung rgyal po'i dus/ bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang dus7mnyam ste/ bod kyi rgyal pos rgya rje'i sras mo slong ba'i pho nya btang bas rgya rjes bu mo ma byin par bod du log ste/ rgyal po la rdzun zhus nas/ rgya rje de nged rang la shin tu dga' nas bu mo ster bar yod pa la/ hor ser thu lu hun (skos rgya rje la phra ma zhus pas lon(lan)zhes zhus pas/ bod kyi rgyal po khros nas bod dmag 'bum phrag gcig khrid de/ zung ci'u bya ba'i sa cha bar du byon/de nas blon po g.ya' thung bya ba la dmag bskur nas/ thu lu hān gyi yul 'joms su bteng ba la/ thu lu hān rnams gtsang kha'i mtsho sngon phan la bros/shul du lus pa'i mi nor thams cad bod kyis khyer ro/ /de nas bod kyi rgyal pos/ blon po se le stong btsan la rin po che sna tshogs bskur nas/ rgya rje'i sras mo slong du btang bas/ 'un shing kong jo/ jo bo shākya/ rdzongs mang po dang bcas pa bod du smreb/ lhags pho khyi'i so la/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam

230po 'das nas/ rgya yul nas bang so mchod pa la nor mang po khyer ba'i pho nya byung ngo // (rgya'i dmag bod du byung ste/ po ta la me la sgegs/ jo po rin po che btsal bas ma rnyed mi bskyod rdo rje snga gro(dro)gcig gi bar khyer zer ba sogs rgya'i deb lhar na 'dug go/ /rgyalapo 'di'i dus/)de'i dbon po mang srong dgung lo bcu gsum la rgyal srid bzung bas na so gzhon te/ rgyal srid bya ba cher ma byung kyang / blon po mgar gyis mtha' bzhi'i khrims baspungs/ de'i dus su rgya'i dmag bod du byung nas 'joms pa dang / bodo kyis kyang blon po mgar gyis dmag dpon byas nas/ bod be+emag 'bum tsho gnyis khrid de/ rgya rnams pham par byas/ yul 'khor rnams bcom nas/ blon po mgar kyang dmag thog tu 'das so/ /rgyal po de'i sras 'dur('dul)srong 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i dus su/ yab kyi bang so mchod pa la/rgya yul nas nor mang po khyer ba'i pho nya byung ngo/ /de rjes mgar gyi sras snyan btsan ldem bu dang / /thu lu hun gyi blon po ngo log gnyis dang bcas pas dmag khri tsho gsum khrid nas rma chu'i 'khris na yod pa'i mkhar dong / mi sde 'joms su phyin pas/ rgya'i li kying tī na chen gyi dmag dang phrad nas/'thabs pas rgya rnams pham/ de ma khad ling kying gyis rgya'i dmag sum stong bsnan nas/ bod dang 'thab tu 'ongs pas/ bod kyi dmag phyir bros so/ / bod kyi rgyal po 'dul srong mang po rje de'i stobs dang / mnga' thang da nga /dbang phyug ni gzhan las che ba yin no/ /rgyal po de'i sras/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gyi dus su/ rgya rje dzung dzung rgyal po dang dus mnyam ste/rgya rje de'i sras mo kyim shing kong jo bod du byon pa yin no/ /bu mo'i rdzongs la dar zab khri tsho mang po dang/ bzo'i rigs byed sna tshang dang/ rgyal po'i mdun la 'gro ba'i lag cha'i rigs gang yin byin nas za ya tha'i byang kun/g.yang gu'i lhan zer ba'i mi dpon gunyis kyi(kyis)mgo byas dmag mi mang po

231skyel du btang ste mthun pa'i gtam byas so/ /byang ngos dang lha'i sa cha yang lo sum cu'i bar du bod kyis bdag byas/ de'i sras rgyal po khri srong lde btsane gyi dus su dbon zhang ma mthun par dmag rgyag res mang du byas 'dug cing / zhang rgya tsha lha gnang / dmag dpon lha bzang klu dbal la sogs pas bod dmag 'bum tsho gnyis tsam khrid nas/ shing kun dang / ce'u mkhar dang / sman tse'i yul rnams bcom/ dbon zhang mthun pa'i skyes phul/ 'khon med par chad na'ang bod kyi rgyal pos kha la dzharang re dang mthuno par bya zer kyang / sems shin tu gnag par byung zer ro/ —/de ltar sras mu ni btsad po dang / sad na legs kyi dus su yang/ skabs re mthun rdogoskyes 'bul ba dang / 'khon nas dmag 'dren res byas pa mang du 'dug go /de ltar/ mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis kyang / datren zhang dang ma mthun par bod dmag khri tsho mang po khrid nas/ rgya'i yul mkhar thams—cad bcom/ rgya'i ha shang dang / bod kyi mchod gnas rnams kyis bar dang gna' dpang mdzad nas dbon po dgyes pa'i skyes phul/ da phyis 'khon med pagachad nas/ rgya yul rmi ru bya gyuba'i so mtshams su btsan po dbon zhang gnyis kyis lha khang ri brtsigasi/ pha bong la nyi zla bris nas/ gnagol nyi zla zung gcig sa la btsan po dbon zhang / rgya'i rmi ru man la bod kyi dmag mi drangs/ de yan la rgya'i dmag mi drangs/ phan tshun dus(du sa)mtshams bsrung ste/ sa sa mal/ rdo rdo mal du gnas nas/ bod bod yul na skyid/ rgya rgya yul na skyid pa'i khri'is mdzad nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang / nyi zla dang / gza' skar dang / lha gnyan rnams dpang du btsugs te/ dbon zhang gnyis kyis dbu bsnyung dang bro bor ro/ /de ltar chad mol gyi yi ge rdo ring gsum la byas te/ rdo ring gi zheng che ba gnyis la btsan po dbon zhang gnyis kyis chad mol la bgyis pa'i mna' tshigs kyi yi ge

232bris/ zheng chung ba gnyis la bod dang rgya'i blon po/ bka' la gtogs ba'i rtsis pa rnams kyi ming rus bris nas/ rdo ringabacug lha sar btsugs/ rdo ring cig rgya rje'i pho brang mdun du btsugs/ rdo ring gcig rgya bod kyi mtshams be+e ru ru btsugs so/ /gal te chad mol bgyis pa'i yi ge 'di la ma bsam por bod kyis rgya la dmag drangs na/ rgya rnams kyis rgya rje'i pho brang gi mdun gyi rdo ring gi yi ge lan gsum klog na bod thams cad phung bar 'gyur la/ rgya rnams kyis bod la dmag drangs na/ lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge lan gsum klog na/ rgya thams cad phung bar 'gyur ro zhes btsan po gnyi kyis ni phyag rgyas btab/ bod dang rgya'i blon po bka' la gtogs pa rnams kyis ni dmod btsugs so/ /de dag ni zur tsam yin gyis/ bod dang rgya'i chad mol gyi yi ge zhib par 'dod na/ lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge la gzigs shig— de rjes sog po'i dmag dpon bod du byung ste/ blon po khyung zhags bsad pas des rkyen nas bod dang rgya gnyis 'brel chad pa yin zer ro/ /rgya bod lo rgyus deb ther 'di/ rgya nag tha'i dzung rgyal po'i dus kyi yig mkhan su khye han gyis bsgrigs pa las rim pa bzhin du bcos te/ dus phyis rgya'i losmo ba 'u kyang dzus/ shi nga khun sde chen du bod skad du bsgyur ba la/ lo grangs mi mthun pa 'ga' re dang de dus kyi mi'i ming rnams la 'dra min re 'dug na'ang bla ma gu shrī rin chen grags rgya yul na bzhugs dus/ rgya bod kyi 'brel tshul 'di rnams gtan tshigs su bzhed nas/shing mo bya'i lo la shing kun sde chen du par du btab ste kun la rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /'di ni zur tsam yin gyis/ bod dang rgya'i 'brel tshul dang /dbon zhang gi lo rgyus rnams zhib par 'dod na/ par ma de nyid la gzigs shigade ltar rgyal po mnga' bdag ral pa can des/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs nas/ dbang da ge 'dun la gtad/ chos khrims dang / rgyal

233khrims gnyis gtan la phab/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ dkar chung la sogs pa'i yab mel kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang rnams la zhabs tog mdzad/ bod 'bangs thams cad dge ba bcu'i khrims la bkod de/ rku dang / jag dang / g.yo zol sogs byed pa med par gyur nas/ blon 'bangs chos la mi dga' ba thams cad spyod pa shin tu dog par gyur to/ /de nas 'bangs rnams kyis nged rang rnams 'di tsam pa'i spyod pa dog pa 'arda gang gis lan zhes gcig la gcig gis smras pa dang / de dag ni 'di snarnams kyis lan no zer te/ btsun pa rnams la mdzub mo gtad nas/ mig ngan bltas sprasati rdzirgyal pos gsan te/ nga'i rab tu byung ba rnams la sdigs mdzub gtad nas mig ngan lta bar mi rigs pas/ da phyis sus byas na'ang mig phyung la mdzub mo chod cig gsungs so/ /de ltar rgyal po chos la shin tu dkar ba de la/ sbas stag rna can la sogs pa sdig blon rnams shin tu ma dga' nas/ chos khrims 'jig pa'i gros byas nas/rgyal po ma bkrongs na chos khrims 'jig chimi thub zer/ la la na re/ rgyal po bkrongs kyang / lha sras gtsang ma dang / blon po bran kha dpal yon gnyis chos la dga' bas chos khrims 'jig mi thub zer/ der snga sor lha sras gtsang ma dang / bran kha dpal yon gnyis med pa byas/ de rting la rgyal po bkrong bar thag bcad/ mo rtsis pa rnams la brngan pa byin nas/ thams cad kha mthun par lha sras gtsang ma 'dir bzhugs na/ sku tshe la bar chod 'ong zhing /rgyal srid 'jig par 'gyur zhes glengs nas/ lha sras gtsang ma dpal gro mon la bcug(sprugs)/ de'i rjes la rgya' po la spas stag rna can gyis phra ma zhus te/chos blon chen po bran kha dpal gyi yon tan dang / btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul gnyis mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byas so zer nas/ chos blon chen po nyes med la skyon phab nas( bkrongs so/ / de rjes la rgyal po dgung lo sum

234 cu so drug pa lcags mo bya'i lo la/ rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa la/ sbas stag rna can dang / cog ro lha lod gnyis kyis rgyal po ltag pa bskor nas bkrongs so/ /'di yan la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum dang / shin ta skyid po'i gdang rabs lnga zer/ring ——de 1(/ ———mnga' bdag ral pa can gyi bang ni// — chi don mkhar mda' yi g.yon zur de ru brtsig/ bang so de'ang rin chen nor gyis bkang // ming ni khri steng oṃng ri zer ro skad—// de nasi rje'i mnga' thang ni dgun kha'i 'bab chu bzhin gri/ dge bcu'i rgyal khrims ni sog rul gyi phon thago bzhin zhig bod 'bangs kyi bsod nams ni snum zad kyi mar me bzhin song / chab srid phan bde ni nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yal/ nag phyogs kyi spyod pa ni yul ngan gyi 'tshub ma bzhin longs/ bzang byed kyi bsam blo ni mdang sum gyi rmi lam bzhin brjed/ de ltar du gyur te/lo paṇa dang mchod gnas la zhabs tog med par so so'i yul la bzhud/ chos bsgyur 'phro rnams bskyur/ blon 'aspungs chos la dga' ba rnams ni mya ngan gyis non te bya thabs med par gyar to// — ༄ nyer drug pa/ khri glang dar ma dbya dum btsan gyi skor /de nas sbas4stag rna can la sogs pa'i sdig blon ngan pa rnams dbang ches pas rgyal poge'i glang dar ma dbu dum tsa na bdude kyi sprul pa/ chos la mi dga'

235zhing / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa de/ rgyal sar brkos(bskos)te rgyal khams la dbang byas so/ /dus der paṇ+ḍi ta dān shrī las lha sa'i shar rme ru lha khang du mtshams bcad nas/ dzam lha bsgrubs pas dka' bar byung ba dang /paṇ+ḍaṃ ta khros te/ dzam lha 'jim gzugs de'i grod par mkharasel gyi rting pas brgyab pas/ ( gas kyi rdo rje yin ther ba'ang 'dug) grod pa nas gser mang/ po byung ba dang / de la rgyu byas te sku'i rten du kha sar pa ṇi/ gsung gi rten du gser khri/ thugs kyi rten du dngul bya khun bu can rnams bzhengs/ de'i nye gnas kha che ut+pa las dngul gyi byams pa bzhengs/ dgongs dus kyi mchod pa btsugs/dus der sad dang ser ba dang / btsa' dang / mu gerkadang / mi nad phyugs nad la sogs pa byung bas/ de la snyad byas/ rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs so/ /rab tu byung ba rnams la la shan pa bcol/ la la rtags dang phral/ la la ri dwags bshor du bcug ma nyan pa rnams srog dang phral/ lha khang 'jig pa'i sngon ma lha —sa la byas te/ jo bo rnam gnyis chu la bskyur gsungs pa chos blon rnams kyis thabs byas te/ rang rang gi khri'i 'og tu sbas/ byams pa'i sku ras kyis dril nas/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram du sbas/ nang gi 'der(lder)sku rnams chu la bskyur ba sams nas/ phyag na rdo rje'i mgul la thag pa btags pas/ 'dogs mkhan skad cig la khrug skyugs nas shi bas lha khang 'jig 'phro bcad/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs pa'i sgo rtsig ( ru ma gtoṭa/)gzhan lha khang chung ba thams cad bshig glegs bam la la chu la bskyur/ la la me la sregs/ la la gter bzhin sbas so/ /blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol bar shes nas khye ngan drag tu byed cing mgrin gcig tu rgyalta po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che smad par mi riṭa/ sngar srol bzang po la dgongs nas/

236 riyab mes kyi yig tshangs la gzigs shig ces ngus so/ /dus der chu bo ri'i sgom gra na/ goyo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum sgom gyin yod pa la/ btsun pa cig gis sham thabs brjes lag tu mda' gzhu thogs/ mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas 'phral du khyi khrid nas ri dwags bshor kyin 'dug pa g.yo dge 'byung gis mthong nas/ ban rgan 'khrul lam/btsun pa smyo zer ci byung dris pas/ ri dwags pa de bstan nas khong gnyis na re/ khyed cag ma 'khrul/ btsun pa smyo 'dug zer te/ btsun pa de rtsar bos nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ btsun pa na re/ khyed cag gsum po rgyal po'i chad pa ma phog pa nyen re che zer nas/ chos snubs pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par bshad pa dang / khong gsum po shin tu skrag par gyur nas/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs med par 'dul ba'i pu sti drel rgyab gsum khyer nas/ byang lam la phyin khams su bros te/ dan tig shel gyi brag phug tu bzhugs so/ /de'i rjes la ka 'od mchog grags pa dang rong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mngon pa dang mdzod kyi pu sti mang po khyer nas khams la bros te/ san chung gnam rdzong gi brag khung du bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes yer ba'i brag khung na/ sgom byed kyin yod pa la nam phyed na lha rnga 'i bstan spung dpal lha mo byung nas da lta bod na grub thob khyed las mi 'dug rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar gcod byas/ rgyal po sdig can gsod ran kho mos grogs bya yis/ snying ma chung cig zer ro/ /sang nye gnas la rgyu mtshan dris pas bden par 'dug nas rang gi srog blos btang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsam ste/tsho rgyal po gsod pa'i spobs pa bskyed nas thabs sna tshogs byas te/ rta dkar po la sol ba byugs nas nag po byas/ ber phyi nag pa nang dkar ba byas te gon/ mgo la zhwa nag po gon/ gdong la sol snum

237byug phu thung du mda' gzhu bcug rta nag la thon te/ bdud nag po bkrag med yin no zhes zer te lha sar 'ongs so/ /der rgyal pos rdo ring gi yi ge gzigs kyin 'dug pa'i drung du phyin te/ phyag byed pa ltar byas nas yi dam la dmod btsugs te/ phu thung nang nas mda' gzhu bton/ phyag dang po la mtheb sprud/ gnyis pa la mda' bkang gsum pa la rgyal po'i dpral ba la mda' brgyab nas bros so/ /der rgyal pos phyag gnyis kyis dpral ba'i mda' la 'jus te mod la drangs(grongs)so/ /(rgyal po glang dar ma glang lo la 'khrungs / bya lo la rgyal sa bzung / lo lnga'i bar du chos sdubs/ dgung lo sum cu so brgyad lon pa'i stag lngo la grongs pa yin no/ /) der ram mnga' bos nas phyogs bzhir rgyugs pas/ shar phyogs pa rnams na re/ zin la khad yod pa la dga' mo gdong nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer ro/ /lho phyogs pa rnams na re/ grib kyi chu 'gram nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nub phyogs pa rnarmes na re/ shun gyi 'brang nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor ther/ byang phyogs pa rnams na re/ mdong mkhar gdong nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nges pa can du grib kyi mdar gdong gi chu la ste nyal byas pas/ rta la sol ba byugs pa dag ste dkar por song / zhwa nag bskyur/ gdong gi sol snum bkrus/ ber dkar po phyir bstan nas gon te/ nga ni lha gnam thel dkar po yin no zer nas song ngo /der phyogs bzhir rgyugs pa'i ra mda' ba rnams kha ma 'cham par so so'i mdun du sprul pa re re byung bas/ 'di ni lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yin nges zer nas yer ba'i brag la 'tshol du btang ngo / /der dpal gyi rdo rjes brag khung der/bsam gtan la yod pa'i lugs su byas/ phug ron cig bzung nas sa rdul 'bebs su bcug de'i steng du mug ma dang grog sbur la sogs pa btang bas de rnarmes kyi rjel mis mthong ba dang zhin bar shes nas log go /mi rig pa

238 dang ldan pa cig nang du byung ste/ khong gi snying gar lag pa bzhag pa dang /snying 'dar ba shes te/ spyi'i tha ba la/ sgos su gshol mi bcog zer nas song ngo / /de nas shin tu skrag par gyuthe te/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs mad par khams la bros so/ / nyer bdun pa/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang mnga' bdag yum brtan gnyis kyi skor/der rgyal po sdig can bkrong ba'i rjes su btsun mo chung ba cig la gdung brgyud kyi sras stor cig byung ba dang / btsun mo che ba'i bsam pa la 'dis bdag gi mnga' thang la gnod par nges bsam ste/ lus la gos kyis dkris nas nga la'ang sras stor cig yod do zhes bu chung che rdzun byas so/ /der btsun mo chung ba'i zla dus them pa dang / gdung brgyud yin nges kyi sras 'khrungs te/sku shin tu gces pas nyin mo ni mis bskor/ mtshan mo ni mar me 'od kyis bsrungs pas na mnga' bdag 'od srungs zhes zer ro/ /der btsun mo che bal kyang sprang po'i bu chung skyes ma khad cig nyos nas sha la sbyar te/ nga la'ang 'di skyes pa yin no zer bas/ thams cad the tshom za bar gyur kyang / yum btsun mo dbang che bas smra ma nus te/ yum ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brtan du bcug pas/ mnga' bdag yum brtan zhes zer ro/ /mnga' bdag 'di gnyis thu nar ma son kyang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis zhus te/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang / byams mgon rnams sa 'og nas bton nas/ rang rang gi khri la

—239bzhugs nas mchod pa byas/ lha khang zhig pa rnams slare gsos so/ /de nas srid la ma 'cham pas/ 'od spyong gis g.yo ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas so/ /sa mo glang la khen(gyen)log byung / me mo bya la bang so rnams bshig go/maba' bdag 'od srung sa kyi sras/ rje dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i chen ma'i sras skyidacasde nyi ma mgon/ ('di nas ya tshe dang mnga' ris kyi rgyal po byung /)chun ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa/ ('di nas la stod pa dang yar lung jo bo byung /) 'di gnyis kyi srid gang yod rnams yum brten gyis phyogs pas/ mnga' ris la bros nas mdza' ril rgyalazhepo mjod pa yin no/ / sprang phrug gces par gsos pas mnga' bdag yum brten byung tre//rigs ngan dpon du bskos pas dge bcu'i rgyal khrims med//sha gong nyung mas bcad pas phan bde'i nyi ma 'gribs//rgyal brgyud mtha' la phud pas rje yi gdung rabs chad//ces pa'o// r+yā /nyer brgyad pa/ yum brtan gyi rgyal brgyud rnams kyi skor/yum brten gyi sras la/ khri de mgon snyan/ de la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i che ba rig pa mgon/ chu nga ba nyi ma mgon/ nyi ma mgon gyi zas nyi 'od dpal mgon/ 'di'i brgyud rlung shod/ 'phan yul/ mdo khams na mang ngo// khri rigs(rig)pa mgon la sras gnyis 'khyungs pa'i che ba lde bo/ chung ba rdo rje 'bar lde po'i brgyud bug partacan pa dang / thang la brag pa rnomagaso/ /rdo

//rdo44 /// tsho 4 —rje ribar gyi sras khri dbang phyug btsan/ de'i sras tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan/de'i sras mnga' bdag khri pa/ yab sras 'di gnyis kyi dus su bstan pa'i me — ro mdo khams nas lang ba yin no/ /mnga' bdag khri pa la sras bzhi 'khrungs pa/ a tsa ra/ dge slong / bla ma/ lha btsun bo dhi ra tsa'o/ / a tsa ra'i rgyud/ 'phrong po ba/ lcang rgyab pa/ glag pa lam pa/ grib pa/ snye thang ba/lus pa gtsang bo la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /bla ma la brgyud med/ dge slong bi brgyud dpe bzhi pa/ 'on rdo mong mkhar pa rnams yin no/ /bo dhi/ra tsa'i brgyud la/ lha btsun sngon mo snyug rum pa/ lha 'bri sgang ba la sogs pa bsam yas na da lta yod pa rnams yin no/ /de rnams kyi brgyud phyogs thams cad du so sor 'phel bas kyi g.yor kun na yod pa'i jo bor ming btags pa rnams yin pas/ rigs shin tu ma dag pa yin zer ro/ /nyer dgu pa/ khams nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i skor/de ltar rgyal po glang dar mas lcags mo bya la chos snubs/ lcags mo bya la bstan pa'i me ro langs nas/ lo skor dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang na chos med do zer kyang / nges pa can du lo skor brgyad/ lo dgu bcu go brgyad kyi bar chos kyi ming tsam yang med do/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar chu bo ri nas bros pa'i g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu de gsum khams subyubros so/ /de'i rjes la ka 'od mchog grags pa dang / rong ston

241seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang gsum snga rting du bros so/ /de'ang thog mar khams su slob ma byung ba ni/ bon po'i bu sma za gsal gyis phyugs 'tshor phyin pas/ chu bo ri nas byon pa'i dge slong gsum po dang mjal te/ las 'phro'i dbangagyigis dad pa skyes nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas gnang ste/ mkhan slob song ste gsum kha'i mtshan nas dras te/ shākya dge ba gsal du ba/tags/ /sde sgod gsum la mkhas par gyur to/ /de la brten nas khams pa'i mi bal rdo rje dbang phyug snubs dpal gyi byang chub/ yang gong ye shes g.yu ru/ sbar rin chen/ lcang ye shes seng trege co rdo shes rab bya6nga chub/gzhan yang shod chung ba shes rab gragal/ an 'bar ba byang chub/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gnubs dpal gyi byang chub/ 6sgro mañtsa shrī la sogs pa'i mkhas btsun mang po byon no/ /de'i tshe rgyal po sdig can gyis chos sdubs nas lo drug cu lon pa na/ 'phan yul zhog na skyi gsal gshen 'bar bya ba'i bon po'i bu/ skyi za 'phan bya ba'i byis pa cig gis/ snang gsal lha khang bya ba'i nang du phyin pas/ rab tu byung ba chos nyan band byed pa 'dra ba'i gzugs rgyung ris la 'dug pas ci yin dris pas/ de na 'dug pa'i rgan mo cig na re/rab tu byung ba bya ba'o gzugs yin byas pas/ byis pa de sngon gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis dad pa skyes nas mchi ma phyung ste/ rab tu byung ba da lta e yod dris pas/— rgan mo na re/ rne bu mo'i dus na yin te/ rgyal po glang dar mas chos snubs pa'i dus/ rab tu byung ba rnams ba pas/ rtags dang phral/ la la bsad/ la la shi/ da lta dbus gtsang na rab tu byung ba med do/ /chu bo(ra)ri dang yer pa la sogs nas khams su bros pa'i rab byung mang po da lta khams na yod thag chod 'dug zer bas/ rab tu dga' ste/ 'is dang srog la ma bltas par byis pa des khams su phyin pas/ci lhasnalu nga dpal gyi rdo rje dang mjal

242nas/ dad pa skyes nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ bdag gis rgyal po sdig can bsad pas nga la sdom pa med/ ngas grogs bya yis gsungs nas/ mkhas btsun de rnams dang mjal rab tu byung bas/ ming yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de ltar khams na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / bod na chos med par mun pa'i smag rum du gyur pa na/ rgyal po sdig can gyis skyos bsnubs nas lo brgyad cu lon pa na bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag rkyen mdzad nas khams su sdome pha len pa'i zog mar/ ḍadabus gtsang gi mi bdun du grags pa ni/ klu mes shes rabasgyutshul khrims/ 'bri ye shesadzhayon tan/ tshong ge shes rab seng ge rilo sto—na rdo rje dbang phyug sum pa ye shes blo gros/ rgya blo gros shes rab/ gathon ban chos mchog dang bdun gyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la mkhade po zhus/ co ro shes rab byang chub la slob dpon zhus nas bka' drin mnos so/ /de'i rting la phyin pa lnga ni/ mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags/rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba btsun blo gros dbang phyug skyes legs nyang bran chos skyabs/ grum shing shes rab smon lam mo/ /de ltar sngon la khams su sdom pa len phyin pa'i mi bdun po des sdom pa blangs nas phyir 'ongs pa dang / rting la phyin pa'i mi lnga po dang lam la 'phrad de/ gar 'gro dris pas/ khams su sdom pa len du 'gro zer bas/ sngon ma rnams na re/ nged rnams kyi sdom pa gsum ldan du blangs yod pas nged kyis sdom pa phog pas chog thag ring la 'gro mi dgos zer ba la ma nyan par khams su phyin te/ sngar gyi mkhas btsun rnams dang mjal/ sdom pa blangs te phyir dbus gtsang du slepha nas bsam yas kyi btsad po tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan grongs 'dug na'ang /de'i sras btsad po khri pas bdag rkyen mdzad de/ klu mes la sogs pa rnams

243kyis dbus gtsang thams cad du lha khang bsam gyis mi khyab pa brtsigs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che slar shing skam gyi phung po la me 'bar ba lta bur phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa na/ bstan pa'i srog rtsa legs par bzung / me ro bslangs nas bod mun pa'i gling du sgron me 'bar bar mdzad pa/ gong du bshad pa'i khams dbus kyi mkhas btsun rim par byon pa de rnams dang mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan yab sras rnams sku drin shin tu che bar 'dug go/ sumasto cu pa/ 'od srungs kyi rgyal brgyud rnams kyi skor/de ltar bstan pa rin po che la bka' drin che ba'i bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar/ rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chen ma'i sras/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ spu rangs la'ang dbang bsgyur/ de la sras gsum che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mar(mang)yul bzung /('di nas jo bo ras chen gyi bar du brgyud/) bar pa bkra shis /gon gyis spa rangs — //// /sgyu / /111 ///rdo ri blo bzung / chung pa btsun ma na snes zhang zhung bzung / 'a gsum la stod na bzhugs pa'i mgon gsum zer/ lde btsun mgon la sras gnyis te/ 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis so/ /srong nges sku tshe'i stod la btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i na ga ra tsa dang / dhe ba ra tsa'o/ /sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung nas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ mthon mthing dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ lorngo ba rin chen bzang po dang / rngog legs

244pa'i shes rab la sogs pa blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob pa la gnang / paṇ+ḍaṃ ta shad+ngha ka ra dang warma ta gnyis spyan drangs te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi po bsgrur zhing gtan la phab/ 'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad do/ /gcen po 'khor res kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha lde pos paṇ+ḍaṃ ta su bha shid dang pash+lau ta rme ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba zhi ba 'od/ 'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/chung ba 'od lde'o/ /'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren byon pas lam du mu stegs pa'i dmag gis bzung / dge phyogs kyi yon tan skyed pa'i rtsa sgo thams cad me btsas bsregs te rmongs par byas so/ /de'i gtam lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gsan te/ nor dpagartswad bskur nas bslu(blu)ru btang bas/ gser dang ljid mnyam pa dgos zer ba dang / yang gser gang yod bskur bas rgya ma la bteg dus dbu'i cha tsam cig gser gyis ma long par khong na re/ da ni khyed rnams kyis bdag bslus(blus)kyang yon tan med/ nga'i rtsa sgo me btsas bsregs nas dud 'gro lta bu yod pas bdag shi na'ang bla'i/ nga bslu(blu)ba'i gser rnams khyer la rgya gar na rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras bai kra(bṛ ka)ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag khang na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍaṃ ta lnga brgya pa rnams kyi rinang nas gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ jo bo rje dī paṃ kā ra zhes bya ba bzhugs yod par 'dug de la gser phul bod du gdan drangs la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzod cig gsungs te grongs pa dang / pur yul du spyan drangs nas mchod rten du bzhugs so/ /

(lha46 so gcig pa/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od —kyis jo bo — rje gdan drangs pa'i skor/ der khong gis lung bstan bzhin/ jo bo gdan 'dren pa la rgya brtson seng la sogs pa la gser bskur nas btang ngo / /bod du 'byon pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ rdo bos kyang bod mnga' ris kyi gdul bya la dgongs/ — rje btsun ma sgril mas kyang lung bstan pa bzhin bod du byon nas/ slob ma nag tsho dang khu rngog 'brom gsum/ losmo ba rin chin bzang po/lo chung legs pa'i shes dab la sogs pa mkhas btsun du ma byon te/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad pas na/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od de bod la bka' drin che ba lags so/ /so ṅgenyis pa/ la —tshe'i rgyal brgyud kyi skor/lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi gcung po 'od ldes paṇ+ḍaṃ ta kha che dwa na sri spyan drangs/ de'i sras btsan lde/ de'i sras bha sde/ de nas rim pa bzhin du bkra shis lde bha re na ga lde rnams byung ba 'di rnams kyis gu ge/ spu rangs mang yul(la sogs pa'i rgyal khams la dbang pya pa yin no/ /spung na ga lde'i sras btsan phyug ldes ya tsher byonartsotekorgyal po mngod/ci de'i gras bkra4shis lde/

lha46 tsho de'i sras grags btsan lde/ de'i sras grags pa lde/ de'i sras a rog lde/de'i sras a sog lde/ de'i sras dzi dar smal dang / a nan ta smal gnyis so/ /a nan ta smal gyi sras/ ri lu smal gyis lha sar jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu gser thog sbyib / de ltel zas gnyis sang snya smal dang / 'dzi thar spal gnyis so/ /'dzi thar smal gyi sras a 'dze smal/ de'i sras ka len smal/de'i sras bar rti4 smal/ de nas ya tshe'i rgyal brgyud chad nas pu(spu)rangs nas mnga' bdag bsod nams lde ya tsher gdan drangs nas rgyal sa bzung / pu ṇi smal bya bar mtshan btags/ de'i sras bri ti smal dang / blon po dpal ldan grags gnyirme kyis lha sar bcu gcig zhel gyi steng du gser thog phub/ stod da/ bzhugs tre'i rgyal brgyud 'di rnams/ gser thog pa rin rdor gyis(gyi)yigodangardzo tshang las zur tsam bris pa yin gyis rgyal po re re bzhin gyi mdzad pa phrin las rnams zhib par shes 'dod pa de nyid kyi yig tshang la gzigs shig so gsum pa/ yar lung jo bo'i rgyal brgyud skor/yang bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chun ma'i sras/ ('di nas la stod dang / gtsang stod btsong kha mdo smad yar lung rngo bo la sogs bod kyi rgyal brgyud min nges rnams min no//) bkra shis brtseya/sa pa la sras gsum byung ba dpal —lde 'od lde skyid lde gsum yin te/ 'di gsum la smad du bzhugs pa'i lde gsum zerakhri sras che ba dpal lde'i sras ni sngon po tshom por thugs te/ khab gung ba klu rgyal ba spyi pa lta rtse glang lung btsad 'khor

247ba rnams te/ la stod man chod pa rnams yin no/ /sras chung ba skyid lde shangs rta nag tu phog sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te/ 'bro'i btsad po dang / g.yasabyuru ru lag gi gtsang(btsad)po pam dang / mus pa dang 'jang nyang stod na yod pa rnams so/ /sras 'bring po 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba/pha ba de se khri lde khri chung nyag lde'o/ /pha ba de be'i brgyud snub yul dang rong dang / g.yag sde nyang stod stag tshal na yod do/ /khri lde'i rgyud ni shar btsong kha'i rgyal po spyan mnga' don chen la sogs pa mdo smad kyi btsad po da lta bzhugs pa rnams yin no/ /nyag lde'i rgyud gtsang g.yas ru na yod/ skyin mkhalnge btsad po'i bar du'o/ /khri chung gis/ (yar lung bo'i mang 3yar lung du byon nas sku mkhar 'phying nga stag rtse bzung / de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/de la sras bdun byung ba'i che ba zhang rje tsha khri 'bar/ de'i gcung po btsad pa tsha spun drug zhang rje tsha khri 'bar gyi srar drug la g.yu thog gi brgyud sna mo spu 'phying nga ba don mkhar ba thang 'khor ba rnams so/ /gcung po btsad pa tsha spun drug ni lha spyad dang / (brgyud med)g.yu spyon gnyis('di nas mir lung jo bo byung /)dar dang(brgyud da)lhun po gnyis(brgyud medaste'od lde dang gung btsan gnyis te drug go /'od btsan dang gung btsan gyi brgyud ni khru 'brug pa bying ba byar ba chu mig gog po na yod pa rnams so/ /g.yu can ni gar mi yon tan g.yu rung gis gdan drangs nas byas sar byon te bzhugs/ de'i sras jo dga'/ de la sras gsum yod pa'i sras che ba bya sa lha chen/ ('dis bya sa'i lha khang zazhengs/kyekhri dar ma gcung por rab tu byung/ khri dar ma la sras bzhi byung ba gtsug lde/(zas thed/)khri gtsuba'ijo bo rnal 'byor('ditsho'aban tshegs cu brgyagasastejo bo smon lam mo/ /('di rab tu byung sa rgya gu'i gasgrimargokhang dkar po ba ga te bzhugs/ste khri gtsug gis byas dang dos rjon— bzung / de'i 3yis khri/btsana3 ji+ode 'i srasastan kha khri /

248 de'i sras lha khri la sogs pa yar mda' ba rnams yin no/ /jo bo rnal 'byor la sras gsum byung ba che ba ja 'bag byung ba/ 'bring ba lha chen no/ /('dis spyil phu'i gdan sa mdzad/kyechung ba lha ngam shod pa'o/ /('di rab tu byung nas zas med/)jo 'bag la sras lnga 'khrungs pa'i jo bo shākya mgon po/ lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/('dis spyi la phu'i gdan sa mdzad pas gdul bya che/)lde po('dis 'ban tshigs bzung)/ sde chung('di grongs gras med/)jo rgyal rnams so/ khu'adis mid bzung/)lde po'i sras jo bo shākya rgyal/ de'i sras jo bo shākya dpal/ ('dis 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung du rab tu byung nas zas med/kyejo rgyal gyi sras jo 'bar/ de'i sras gnyis pa'i che ba lha zur khang pa/ ('dis kyang spyil phu'i gdan sa mdzad/)chung ba khrom po ba rnams kyis dpon du gdan drangs te lha khrom po par grags/ jo bo shākya mgon pos gcung po rnams tha thang du phog nas/ khong rang gi pho brang gnas tshung btab/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor nam mkha' dang mnyam/ de'i sras jo bo shākya bkra shis kyis pho brang rnying ma btab/ de la sras gnyis byung ba che ba lha brag kha pa/ chung ba mnga' bdag grags pa rin chen gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i chag phyi la rgya yul du byon/ se chen rgyal po'i lung blangs nas pho brang brag kha la sogasatsopa'i pho brang mang du btab thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor nam mkha' dang mnyam/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba blo gros 'od/gnyis pa mnga' bdag shākya mgon po/ ('dis snyil phukai gdan sa mdzad/ shākya mgon po rtong ma yin pas/ dpal 'byor che/kyechung ba lha btsun tshul khrims bzang po/ /(gdan sa thil du rab tu byung /kye'adi rnams nas bzung ste/ yar lungs kyi jo bo da lta yan 4rim par byon pa 'di rnams bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud zam ma chad pa yin pas rigs gzugs yon tan khyad par 'phags pa yin/ 'di dag ni zur tsam bsdusar+yā yin gyis/ yar lung jo bo rim dzir byostopa rnams kyi mdzatre

249pa phrin las rgyas par 'dod na/ lha btsun tshul khrims bzang pos bsgrigs pa'i rgyal rabs la gzigs shig/bodi gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgya dkar nag gi rgyal po dang / hor dang mi nyag gi rgyal rabs dang / khyad par du'ang bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam thar bsdus te zur tsam yin no/ /'a di dag ni gzhan gyi kha rgyug dang rang gi blo tshod dang rnam tog gis kun nas bslangs pa'i yid dpyod rnams spangs nya/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mdo brgyud dang / rgyal po'i bka' 'bum lha sa dang bsam yas kyi bka' gamigs chen mo/ jo bo rje'i gter yig che chung / chos 'byung gi yi ge che chung / rgyal po bka'i thang yig hor gyi yig tshang / gzhan yang tshal pa la sogs pa'i sde dpon/ bstan bcos la mkhas pa'i gang zag rnams kyis bsgrigs pa'i rgyal rabs kyi yi ge mang po bsags nas/ re re bzhin zhib mor bltas/ yin min gyi the tshom rnames bsal/ snang skad dang /gda'(brda)skad go dka' ba rnams bcos te gsal bar byas/ snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan gyis ma bsgrigs par rang gzhan thams cad kyis go sla bar byas nas dad ldan bstan pa'i rgyus 'dod pa rnams mogagus dang / spro ba skye ba'i phyir du legs par bkod pa 'di bden par shes par mdzod cig gzhan yang dus phyis kyi gang sdog 'di dag la don gnyer byed pa rnams kyis yin min gyi cha mtshon gle tshome du gyur na/ sngar gyi yi ge rnying pa rnams la zhib mor gziṭa la 'jug tu rung ngo / /mi shes pa rnams kyis 'chos shig/'di ni gangs can bstan pa'i dar tshul te//bstan pa rgyas matsād chos rgyal mes dbon gyis//ston pa'i bstanayapa phyogs bcur spelab 'dis// bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gasgos par skag/

250tshogs gnyis lhun po'i khyon ltar mngon mtho zhing // khrims gnyis chos bzhin skyong ba'i dgongs pa can/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong rje rnams kyis// chab srid phan bde'i dpal la spyod par mdzod//chos rgyal rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di//lha btsun rin chen dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor//rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis// — 'gal 'khrul spangs te legs par bsgrigs pa yin// 'di yi dge bas sprin med nam mkha' la//thub bstan rgyas pa'i rta bdun 'od stong gil//gsung rab phan bde'i pad tshal kha phyes nas //dad ldan bung ba'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod// bod yul mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi smongs 'dir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des zhabs kyis ma bcags kyang gsung gi 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug des/ gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can thams cad thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god par mdzad cing / khyad par 'phags pa de'i thugs kyi sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la sogs pa bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis thabs du ma'i sgo nas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rnam thar/ chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di bstan pa dar tshul gyi rgyus 'dod dang / dad ldan rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir du sa skya ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ sa pho 'brug gi lo la dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen por legs sdor bsgrigs pa 'gis/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig /

deb 'di ni sde dge'i shing par gzhir bzung ste legs bsgrigs par 'don byas pa yin/sgo༈za lke.oṃ/oṃ ༅ lngaloX rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sa skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams/rgyal sras ngag dbang blo bzang dang mgon po rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis bsgrigs/:mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/1981lo'i zla 5par par gzhi 1po bsgrigs pa/2002lo'i zla 3par pe cin du par thengs 5pa brgyab pa/deb rer spyor 10 00 ci
